game.content.one-evade-roll-for-the-whol: One evade roll for the whole sweep. Shields subtract damage and stay up.
game.content.one-reactor-bar-the-cap-is: One reactor bar. The cap is 25.
game.content.9-6-hp-per-second-crew: 9.6 HP per second. Crew can heal in an airless medbay.
game.content.empty-chair-keeps-50-of-eng: Empty chair keeps 50% of engine evasion.
game.content.empty-chair-keeps-80-of-eng: Empty chair keeps 80% of engine evasion.
game.content.see-interior-of-all-rooms-o: See interior of all rooms on your ship and the enemy ship.

game.content.improved-blast-doors-impede: Improved blast doors. Impedes boarders more.
extras.augments.weapon-charge-speed-rise: Weapon charge speed rises 10% per copy. Charge time is divided by 1 + copies / 10.
extras.augments.a-missile-has-a-50-chanc: A missile has a 50% chance not to be spent.
extras.augments.after-a-jump-enabled-wea: After a jump, enabled weapons that have power start fully charged.
extras.augments.scrap-gain-repairs-2-hul: Scrap gain repairs 2 hull and is cut 15% while the hull is not already full.
extras.augments.50-chance-to-ignore-an-i: 50% chance to ignore an ion hit. Two or more ignore every ion hit.
extras.augments.one-copy-makes-ftl-charg: One copy makes FTL charge take 80% as long. Two take 67%. Three take 57%.
extras.augments.scrap-gain-is-10-higher-: Scrap gain is 10% higher per copy, applied before a weld cut, then rounded down.
extras.augments.15-chance-to-ignore-hull: 15% chance to ignore hull damage. Systems still take the hit. Not a store item on the wiki; 50 scrap is invented.
extras.augments.15-chance-to-ignore-syst: 15% chance to ignore system damage. The hull still takes the hit. Not a store item on the wiki; 50 scrap is invented.
extras.augments.the-backup-battery-coold: The Backup Battery cooldown is cut in half.
extras.augments.suffocation-damage-is-ha: Suffocation damage is halved, including while boarding. A Crystal takes a quarter.
extras.augments.fires-on-your-ship-die-d: Fires on your ship die down faster than a person can put them out.
extras.augments.at-sector-start-before-s: At sector start, before sector 8, the fleet falls back one jump.
extras.augments.adjacent-beacons-show-an: Adjacent beacons show an environmental hazard and possible ship presence. Selling or swapping the scanners hides that again.
extras.augments.enemy-ships-take-twice-a: Enemy ships take twice as long to charge FTL.
extras.augments.a-powered-defense-drone-: A powered defense drone gives its part back when the jump starts. A powered combat drone gives it back only after the fight. Boarding, ion, crew, and hacking drones do not.
extras.augments.everyone-in-a-room-durin: Everyone in a room during a hacking pulse is stunned for that pulse.
extras.augments.a-waiting-body-stays-in-: A waiting body stays in the clone bay queue even when the clone bay is off or broken.
extras.augments.a-person-sent-through-th: A person sent through the teleporter is fully healed.
extras.augments.living-crew-show-up-even: Living crew show up even when sensors do not.
extras.augments.the-ship-can-jump-to-any: The ship can jump to any previously visited beacon, including beacons later overtaken by the Rebel Fleet.
extras.augments.enemy-defense-drone-i-de: Enemy Defense Drone I, Defense Drone II, and Anti-Combat drones cannot acquire or shoot down targets. Your own defense drones still fire.
extras.augments.crew-teleportation-bomb-: Crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control work through Zoltan Shields.

game.hulls.this-class-of-ship-was-decomm: This class of ship was decommissioned from Federation service years ago. After a number of refits and updating, this classic ship is ready for battle.
game.hulls.available-from-the-start-it-i: Available from the start. It is the only layout that does not need an unlock.
game.hulls.this-modified-kestrel-class-s: This modified Kestrel class ship was created by a laser weapon aficionado.
game.hulls.earn-at-least-two-of-the: Earn at least two of the three Kestrel Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.this-model-was-modified-by-pi: This model was modified by pirates to utilize newly discovered technology. It can clone lost crewmembers and stun enemies.
game.hulls.reach-the-final-sector-with-k: Reach the final sector with Kestrel layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.although-it-may-look-like-a: Although it may look like a pile of junk loosely held together, this well designed ship relies on drones and ion weaponry.
game.hulls.reach-sector-5-with-any-kestr: Reach sector 5 with any Kestrel layout.
game.hulls.heavily-understaffed-this-shi: Heavily understaffed, this ship relies on drones to keep the ship running.
game.hulls.earn-at-least-two-of-the-2: Earn at least two of the three Engi Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.the-engi-were-quick-to-adapt: The Engi were quick to adapt to the sudden surge of hacking technology — this ship is the result of their research.
game.hulls.reach-the-final-sector-with-e: Reach the final sector with Engi layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.this-ship-features-the-latest: This ship features the latest in federation technology: an advanced beam weapon that pierces through shields!
game.hulls.defeat-the-flagship-prototype: Defeat the Flagship prototype in the Rebel Stronghold sector, or defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Engi Cruiser.
game.hulls.this-ship-features-additional: This ship features additional Artillery power, encouraging heavy reliance on the beam.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-federat: Earn two of the three Federation Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.with-a-flak-artillery-weapon-: With a Flak Artillery weapon and an improved Clone Bay, only the most suicidal of infantry chooses to fly on this ship.
game.hulls.reach-sector-8-with-federatio: Reach sector 8 with Federation layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.the-zoltan-s-advanced-shields: The Zoltan's advanced shields technology give this ship an edge during each battle.
game.hulls.see-the-unarmed-zoltan-transp: See the Unarmed Zoltan Transport, or defeat the Flagship with the Federation Cruiser.
game.hulls.this-ship-starts-with-a-weake: This ship starts with a weakened Shield system and must rely on its Zoltan shield.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-zoltan: Earn two of the three Zoltan Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.the-designer-of-this-ship-was: The designer of this ship was not willing to spend the money for a decent reactor. Instead it relies on its Zoltan crew and Backup Battery.
game.hulls.reach-sector-8-with-zoltan-la: Reach sector 8 with Zoltan layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.designed-for-use-inside-nebul: Designed for use inside nebula, this cruiser lacks sensors and relies instead on the guile and cunning of the Slugs.
game.hulls.see-the-slug-home-nebula-surr: See the Slug Home Nebula Surrender event, or defeat the Flagship with the Mantis Cruiser.
game.hulls.this-boarding-ship-has-no-med: This boarding ship has no medical facilities and must manage its explosives carefully to keep the crew alive.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-slug: Earn two of the three Slug Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.slugs-are-often-skilled-in-th: Slugs are often skilled in the arts of misdirection and manipulation. With Hacking and Mind Control systems, this ship capitalizes on that fact.
game.hulls.reach-sector-8-with-slug-layo: Reach sector 8 with Slug layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.similar-to-its-designers-this: Similar to its designers, this super dense behemoth uses brute force to overwhelm its foes.
game.hulls.see-the-rock-war-vessel-encou: See the Rock war vessel encounter, or defeat the Flagship with the Slug Cruiser.
game.hulls.with-no-airlocks-this-ship-mu: With no airlocks, this ship must rely entirely on its rock crew to put out fires.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-rock: Earn two of the three Rock Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.contact-has-been-made-with-th: Contact has been made with the Crystalline race and this cruiser was offered to the Federation as part of diplomatic discussions between the sister species.
game.hulls.reach-sector-8-with-rock-layo: Reach sector 8 with Rock layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.constructed-for-the-federatio: Constructed for the Federation by the Engi, this ship is designed to use cloaking technology and speed to get behind enemy lines.
game.hulls.see-the-engi-fleet-discussion: See the Engi fleet discussion event, or defeat the Flagship with the Rock Cruiser.
game.hulls.built-like-a-glass-cannon-thi: Built like a glass cannon, this ship is hard to handle. If its cloaking can keep it safe long enough to charge its weapon, few cruisers can withstand its might.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-stealth: Earn two of the three Stealth Cruiser achievements.
game.hulls.this-ship-was-part-of-an: This ship was part of an Engi experiment to make a power efficient version of the Zoltan shield. Unfortunately this required the removal of the Cloaking system.
game.hulls.reach-sector-8-with-stealth-l: Reach sector 8 with Stealth layout B, Advanced Edition on.
game.hulls.the-sharp-knife-like-structur: The sharp knife-like structures make Lanius ships a sight to behold. This cruiser was adapted to support the other races of the Federation.
game.hulls.the-racial-ability-of-the-lan: The racial ability of the Lanius make them fearsome combatants in small quarters. Combine that with a Mind Control system and this ship is a force to be reckoned with.
game.hulls.earn-two-of-the-three-lanius: Earn two of the three Lanius Cruiser achievements.

wiki.achievements.destroy-a-ship-before-: Destroy a ship before it gets through the Zoltan Shield.
wiki.achievements.givin-her-all-she-s-go: Givin' her all she's got, Captain!
wiki.achievements.with-the-zoltan-cruise: With the Zoltan Cruiser, have 29 power in systems at the same time.
wiki.achievements.get-to-sector-5-withou: Get to sector 5 without upgrading your reactor in the Zoltan Cruiser (in Advanced Edition if you get a reactor upgrade from a random event you can still get this achievement).
wiki.achievements.destroy-an-enemy-ship-: Destroy an enemy ship with a shard from the Crystal Vengeance augment.
wiki.achievements.while-using-the-crysta: While using the Crystal Cruiser, trap 4 enemy crew inside a single room using the crystal being power or Lockdown Bomb.
wiki.achievements.destroy-10-rock-ships-: Destroy 10 Rock ships using the Crystal Cruiser.
wiki.achievements.have-hacking-mind-cont: Have Hacking, Mind Control and the Battery all active at once.
wiki.achievements.have-at-least-600-scra: Have at least 600 scrap in your ship storage.
wiki.achievements.get-to-sector-8-withou: Get to sector 8 without your ship's net oxygen levels exceeding 20 percent (starts after the first jump).
wiki.augments-missing.each-time-the-ship: Each time the ship takes damage there is a 10 percent chance to fire a crystal shot that does 1 damage, has a 10 percent chance to breach, has a 20 percent chance to stun for 3 seconds, ignores shields, is affected by evasion, and can be shot down by defense drones.
wiki.augments-missing.more-than-one-can-: More than one can be held at a time with each copy in an augmentation slot, each can be acquired only from the Dense asteroid field distress call, and each Zoltan research facility opens a single pod to yield a Crystal crewmember.
wiki.augments-missing.crew-drone-movemen: Crew drone movement speed is increased by 25 percent, from 50 percent of regular crew speed to 62.5 percent.
wiki.augments-missing.it-heals-1-6-healt: It heals 1.6 health points per second when the medbay is powered, medbay upgrades do not affect it, it does not heal crew on another ship, and it does nothing with a clone bay.
wiki.augments-missing.crew-movement-spee: Crew movement speed increases by 25 percent on your ship and while boarding an enemy.
wiki.augments-missing.it-fixes-all-breac: It fixes all breaches simultaneously at 75 percent of regular crew speed and stacks with crew repairs.
wiki.augments-missing.it-has-5-points-of: It has 5 points of energy shielding that are completely recharged on an FTL jump, enemy shields are replenished on revisiting the beacon, only the initial boarding party of a boarding event passes through it, and Zoltan Shield Bypass lets crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control pass through it.
wiki.bonus-item.no-weapon-is-left-to-giv: No weapon is left to give.
wiki.bonus-item.no-augmentation-is-left-: No augmentation is left to give.
wiki.bonus-item.no-drone-schematic-is-le: No drone schematic is left to give.
wiki.bonus-item.no-free-weapon-slot-is-s: No free weapon slot: {{name}} is stowed in cargo.
wiki.bonus-item.no-room-in-cargo-for-cho: No room in cargo for {{name}}: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.bonus-item.no-free-augmentation-slo: No free augmentation slot for {{name}}: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.bonus-item.no-room-in-cargo-for-the: No room in cargo for the {{name}} schematic: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-jump-i: You jump into a sector of the nebula beset by a plasma storm. An automated Rebel scout stationed at the beacon moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.an-advance: An advanced Rebel automated ship remains stationed near a small Rebel space-station. Sensors indicate it's a storage vessel for military goods.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.attack-the: Attack the automated ship to get to the storage cache
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.it-appears: It appears that an automated Rebel scout was positioned within the nebula to warn of your passing.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.fight-an-a: Fight an Auto-ship that is running away
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-receiv: You receive a weapon with low scrap
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-are-to: You are too late - whatever once was emitting the distress signal from this system drew a Lanius ship as well as your own. Having consumed the original target, the Lanius turn their attention to your vessel.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.this-beaco: This beacon appears to have been set up within an asteroid field to access a mining settlement. However, half of the settlement has been disassembled by a number of Lanius scavengers. Their military escort moves in to scare you off.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.there-appe: There appears to be some sort of research station near a pulsar, although it's hard to tell since a portion of it has been melted. The Lanius ship that has been working at it moves in to intercept you, totally oblivious to the threat of EM pulses.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-arrive: You arrive at the beacon to discover a civilian ship fleeing from a lone Lanius craft. The civilian messages you, "Help! The metal monsters are coming to melt down our ship!" Strangely, no active weapon signatures are detected.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.try-to-con: Try to contact the Lanius ship.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.continuing: Continuing may open a store, start a Lanius fight, or do nothing.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.a-lanius-c: A Lanius crewmember opens a store.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-have-p: You have picked up a Lanius vessel drifting in this sector. There is no damage to the hull, and it appears to be powered down.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.they-wake-: They wake and fight, or stay silent.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.ignore-str: Ignore, strip the hull, send a Lanius, or use level 2 piloting.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.the-distre: The distress signal from this system is coming from a Slug vessel under attack by the Lanius! The Slugs beg for assistance as the Lanius tear into their hull plating.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.leave-the-: Leave the Slugs to their fate
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.you-see-a-: You see a small station nearby and feel the shudder of shots ringing through the ship. You can't be sure without sensors, but it seems there may be intruders on the ship!
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.2-4-human-: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.there-appe: There appear to be a number of small stations nearby. Before you have time to scan them, warnings go off. A Rebel teleporter was used in one of the stations. You've been boarded!
wiki.cited-events-civilian-al.3-4-human-: 3-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.once-you-a: Once you arrive, your screen lights up with warnings. A nearby pirate seems to have advanced hacking tools and they have tried to shut down our engines. Your crew manages to keep them operational and you move in to attack.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.a-pirate-s: A pirate ship was lying in wait inside this asteroid field. It immediately moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.this-beaco: This beacon has been placed too close to a super-giant class M star! The ship will gradually overheat until you get out of here... or die. A pirate, apparently oblivious to the danger of the sun, moves in to engage.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.upon-compl: Upon completing your jump, you receive a message from a nearby ship. "Greetings and welcome to our beacon! For a small fee, we'll let you continue on your way."
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.your-ship-: Your ship emerges quite far away from the beacon. You see a rebel ship waiting nearby, undoubtedly stationed to look for you.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.you-stumbl: You stumble across a forward scout of the Rebel fleet.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.fight-a-re: Fight a Rebel ship that is running away
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.you-detect: You detect a refueling platform near the beacon, although its broadcast signal is garbled, and you can't make out the message.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.hail-the-p: Hail the platform and attempt to communicate
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.scans-show: Scans show a remote settlement being blockaded by a pirate ship. The ship hastily messages you, "Stay out of this, or you'll be next!...Concentrate fire on..."
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.show-the-p: Show the pirate how to intimidate settlers: burn their crops!
Show the pirate how to intimidate settlers: start fires in their crude dwellings.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.you-see-a-: You see a small station fitted with hundreds of Repair drones. You receive an automated message, "We don't know who you are and we don't care, but this is the right place for some ship repair!"
wiki.cited-events-civilian-mz.thank-you-: "Thank you for your business, no refunds!"
wiki.cited-events-civilian-next.a-ship-w: A ship without life forms within a nearby dense asteroid field is giving off the distress call. Shall we investigate? It could be dangerous.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-next.hull-and: Hull and engines, random scrap, or the remains.
wiki.cited-events-civilian-next.make-a-t: Make a thorough search for the ship without fear of stray asteroids.
wiki.cited-events-crystal-next.branched-: Branched crew and weapon rewards are not granted.
wiki.cited-events-crystal.you-re-greeted: You're greeted by an unwelcome sight - a Rebel advance ship is laying down fire on a Crystalline vessel in the distance.
wiki.cited-events-crystal.a-pirate-ship-: A pirate ship jumps in right after you arrive at the beacon. It must have followed once the Long-Range Beacon was reactivated. It almost charges a small Crystalline transport ship, weapons armed.
wiki.cited-events-crystal.as-soon-as-you: As soon as you arrive, a Rebel ship jumps in after you; they must be really hot on your tail.
wiki.cited-events-crystal.you-arrive-nea: You arrive near a small settlement and a lone guard ship moves to intercept you. You try to contact them but they are refusing all hails. Suddenly you hear lasers ricocheting from within the ship. You've been boarded!
wiki.cited-events-crystal.2-3-crystal-bo: 2-3 crystal boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-engi.there-must-have-b: There must have been rich pickings for pirates around here up until war broke out. The pirate you encounter here looks worn down, but hungry. You'll have to fight!
wiki.cited-events-engi.the-rebel-fighter: The rebel fighter here would seem to suggest elements of the rebel fleet are already making incursions on Engi space. You move to engage.
wiki.cited-events-engi.as-soon-as-you-ju: As soon as you jump into the system, you receive a hail from a nearby civilian Engi vessel. Their Captain appears on your screen: "Strange bug. Can you assist in debugging?"
wiki.cited-events-engi.explain-that-you-: Explain that you can't do any programming and leave.
wiki.cited-events-engi.you-arrive-just-i: You arrive just in time to see an unusually well-armed Engi ship destroying a small pirate craft. A teleporter signal is detected...intruder on deck!
wiki.cited-events-engi.side-with-the-fug: Side with the fugitive and fight the Engi ship.
wiki.cited-events-engi.agree-to-offer-up: Agree to offer up the Mantis in exchange for a bounty.
wiki.cited-events-engi.high-scrap-hull-a: High scrap, hull and fire, or a boarder and an Engi ship.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.you-detect-a-da: You detect a damaged vessel docked with the jump beacon. It appears the Lanius are absorbing metal from the beacon, risking destroying it and becoming stranded.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.a-lanius-ship-o: A Lanius ship, or the translator.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.lanius-crew-ask: (Lanius Crew) Ask if they require assistance.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.hull-repair-dro: (Hull Repair Drone) Send a drone to help.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.you-notice-a-nu: You notice a number of Lanius ships absorbing a forward Rebel base and its automated scouts. They don't seem to be aggressive. Perhaps their desire for metal could prove to be useful?
wiki.cited-events-lanius.try-to-use-them: Try to use them to delay the Rebels.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.medium-scrap-an: Medium scrap and a fleet delay, a Lanius ship, or nothing.
Medium scrap and a fleet delay.
wiki.cited-events-lanius.a-merchant-ship: A merchant ship is docked with a Lanius transport. You message them to see if they need any help. It turns out they have been studying the Lanius's ability to reshape metal.
wiki.cited-events-mantis.who-knows-why-t: Who knows why the Mantis would venture so close to a sun. Perhaps it makes for more of a challenge?
wiki.cited-events-mantis.you-are-immedia: You are immediately hailed by an impressive-looking Mantis ship, "Your ship would make a mighty fine prize. Prepare for battle!"
wiki.cited-events-mantis.you-arrive-to-f: You arrive to find yourself extremely close to a star. You receive a message from a pirate ship, "I'm glad you arrived; our ship is damaged and we were getting desperate... I hope you don't mind if we take yours." Hostiles detected on board our ship!
wiki.cited-events-mantis.2-4-human-board: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-mantis.a-derelict-and-: A derelict and still smoking Mantis vessel floats by. The battle must have been recent; its surviving crew beam aboard. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events-mantis.2-4-mantis-boar: 2-4 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-mantis.you-detect-and-: You detect and retrieve an escape pod floating nearby. You consider returning it to space when you learn it's Mantis.
wiki.cited-events-mantis.a-mantis-boarde: A Mantis boarder and a lost crewmember, or nothing.
wiki.cited-events-pirate-next.what-appea: What appears to be a civilian ship sends a friendly hail. As you approach the vessel, you detect a teleporter signal but it's too late... intruders have beamed aboard!
wiki.cited-events-pirate-next.3-5-human-: 3-5 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.your-sensors-ha: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.a-trade-or-a-pi: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.you-have-encoun: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.you-arrive-to-f: You arrive to find a small research station putting out a distress signal. There is no response to your hails.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.dock-with-the-s: Dock with the station and investigate.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.send-your-battl: Send your battle drone in to help.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.nothing-or-medi: Nothing, or medium scrap with resources.
wiki.cited-events-pirate.medium-scrap-wi: Medium scrap with resources, or nothing.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.you-follow-th: You follow the distress beacon to a tiny asteroid belt. You find a small ship struggling to maneuver through the field.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.you-arrive-to:
You arrive to find a number of ships convening around a station. There is some unencrypted chatter between the ships, you tune in and listen for anything interesting.

Overhearing their conversation, it seems that they need to take possession of an enemy ship intact.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.offer-to-burn: Offer to burn the crew out.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.a-federation-: A Federation encrypted signal is being broadcast from a nearby planet.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.send-an-away-: Send an away party to investigate.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.it-could-be-a: It could be a trap, let's move on.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.you-receive-a: You receive a distress call from a nearby Engi ship. "Assistance requested. Danger present. Imminent destruction."
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.respond-to-th: Respond to the call and move in to assist.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.you-arrive-at: You arrive at a populated sector. One merchant seems to be mass-broadcasting a request for a mercenary ship to aid him. Shall we respond?
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.this-nebula-l: This nebula looks like it's recently seen two ships exchange fire... with mutually-assured destructive results. Wreckage drifts by your screens and tumbles into the depths of the nebula to be lost to sight. It's hard to determine who the combatants were without closer investigation.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.ask-your-slug: Ask your Slug crew to scan for survivors.
wiki.cited-events-quests-b.leave-the-bat: Leave the battlefield before other ships arrive.
wiki.cited-events-rebel-next.reject-his-: Reject his offer. You can never trust these Rebels.
wiki.cited-events-rock.a-mantis-ship-her: A Mantis ship here is adorned with Rock body parts! It would be a gorier display if they had internal organs, but the message is clear enough: this is a hunter of a very specialized kind.
wiki.cited-events-rock.put-your-rock-cre: Put your Rock crewmember on the comm.
wiki.cited-events-rock.as-soon-as-you-ar: As soon as you arrive you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter and shouts reverberating through the ship, "Prepare to burn, fleshy meat-sack aliens!"
wiki.cited-events-rock.2-3-rock-boarders: 2-3 rock boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events-rock.you-find-a-disabl: You find a disabled rock transport floating near the beacon. You consider stripping it of useful parts but are uncertain why it's there in the first place.
wiki.cited-events-rock.random-scrap-or-t: Random scrap, or that scrap and a Rock ship.
wiki.cited-events-rock.check-for-lifefor: Check for lifeforms and keep a lookout for ships while looting the wreck.
wiki.cited-events-rock.you-find-a-slug-c: You find a Slug Cruiser and Rock ship at a standoff, both with weapons armed and ready to fight. You could intervene before this gets out of hand.
wiki.cited-events-rock.hail-them-to-see-: Hail them to see what's wrong.
wiki.cited-events-rock.pay-the-debt-dema: Pay the debt, demand payment, or leave.
wiki.cited-events-rock.a-curious-sight-g: A curious sight greets you at this beacon: a disabled Rock freighter drifts in space while two Mantis craft battle it out - presumably over who deserves the spoils.
wiki.cited-events-rock.wait-then-attack-: Wait, then attack the surviving Mantis.
wiki.cited-events-rock.a-weakened-mantis: A weakened Mantis ship, or a Mantis ship.
wiki.cited-events-rock.the-burnt-out-hul: The burnt out hull of a Rock mine layer drifts by. Behind the wreck drifts a live mine; an automated drone that drills into ships' hulls before exploding. It locks onto your ship's signature and heads your way!
wiki.cited-events-slug-next.you-arrive-n: You arrive near the distress beacon's signal.
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-intercept-com: You intercept comm chatter from an incoming Mantis ship. "Look. This ship appears not to be owned by the squishy ones. Maybe they won't smell so bad when we cut them open." They move in on your position.
wiki.cited-events-slug.navigating-the-fo: Navigating the fog blind, you practically bump hulls with a Mantis ship. They hail you: "Pah! This transgression will be overlooked. Nebula, very dangerous. Next time, humans all die."
wiki.cited-events-slug.there-won-t-be-a-: There won't be a next time. Open fire!
wiki.cited-events-slug.this-place-is-dan: This place is dangerous enough. Move on.
wiki.cited-events-slug.the-mantis-attack: The Mantis attack ship here looks to have been hunting Slugs on their home turf - a rare test of honor for the mightiest Mantis crews. Weapons up!
wiki.cited-events-slug.the-distress-call: The distress call appears to be emanating from a Slug ship caught in open space by a Mantis raider. They contact you on emergency frequencies: "Please, we'll give you all we have if you sssave ussss!"
wiki.cited-events-slug.of-all-the-specie: Of all the species in the galaxy, these two deserve one another. You power up the jump drive.
wiki.cited-events-slug.there-appears-to-: There appears to be a pirate ship nearby.
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-re-surprised-: You're surprised to find a ship without Slug markings stranded all the way out here, and move in to provide assistance. When you see the pirate insignia on the hull you quickly reconsider.
wiki.cited-events-slug.keep-your-distanc: Keep your distance and hope they haven't seen you yet.
wiki.cited-events-slug.as-you-arrive-at-: As you arrive at the beacon, a hostile ship immediately registers on your scanners.
wiki.cited-events-slug.this-is-the-slug-: This is the Slug Cruiser ship unlocking event.
wiki.cited-events-slug.it-s-rare-for-the: It's rare for the Slugs to stay exposed in open space for long periods - the ship here may be lost, or just passing through, but either way he moves in to attack!
wiki.cited-events-slug.your-sensors-are-: Your sensors are no match for the Slug's telepathic abilities - a ship you never even saw opens fire from astern!
wiki.cited-events-slug.the-ion-storm-her: The ion storm here threatens to deactivate your core systems, a fact made all the worse for the largely unaffected Slug ships circling like space-vultures.
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-spot-a-rebel-: You spot a rebel ship in the nebula ahead and stay off their radar. Try to engage?
wiki.cited-events-slug.a-rebel-ship-doub: A Rebel ship, doubled pursuit, or nothing.
wiki.cited-events-slug.try-to-track-them: Try to track them as you move to engage.
wiki.cited-events-slug.use-their-life-si: Use their life signatures to follow.
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-detect-life-s: You detect life signs on a nearby moon - a lone Slug marooned on its surface. "Ah, a sssentient ssspecies, after all this time. I am Slocknog, a wandering hero ssseeking adventure. You may hire me for a ssmall sssum."
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-arrive-to-fin: You arrive to find a Slug ship in the middle of boarding a disabled Rock freighter.
wiki.cited-events-slug.your-sensors-have: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
wiki.cited-events-slug.a-trade-or-a-pira: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.
wiki.cited-events-slug.you-have-encounte: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.an-engi-ship: An Engi ship in the vicinity, seeing you jump in armed to the teeth, immediately broadcasts its surrender. "Subject goal: wealth. Engi motivation: survival. Transfer of goods acceptable?"
wiki.cited-events-surrender.not-too-far-: Not too far from the beacon, you detect a destroyed cargo ship with its cargo scattered nearby, intact.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.leave-it-alo: Leave it alone, this looks suspicious.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.run-an-advan: Run an advanced scan on the boxes.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.you-are-imme: You are immediately contacted by a settlement, "Hello, travelers. Your ship seems to be outfitted for combat...care to take up a bit of mercenary work?"
wiki.cited-events-surrender.as-you-jump-: As you jump in, you immediately see an impressive Slug pirate ship with "The Black Raven" painted on one side. They hail you, "Greetingsss. I am the dreaded pirate, Captain Nights. You mussst be full of fear, no? You have heard of me... no?"
wiki.cited-events-surrender.what-appears: What appears to be a Zoltan science ship requests permission to dock.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.you-arrive-t: You arrive to the sight of two Slug ships in communication range. They don't see you.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.a-quest-mark: A quest marker is added to your map.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.you-arrive-n: You arrive near a small fleet of civilian Engi ships. A simple decryption and translation of their comm frequency tells you that they are having a frantic discussion about something obviously troubling them.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.message-them: Message them and ask if you can help.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.have-your-en: Have your Engi crewmember contact them.
wiki.cited-events-surrender.two-quest-ma: Two quest markers are added to your map.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan-next.something-: Something strikes you as odd about a moon in the distance.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan-next.the-moon-h: The moon has more than one result.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan-next.your-senso: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan-next.a-trade-or: A trade, or a Zoltan ship.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan-next.you-have-e: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-jump-into-a: You jump into a debris field that used to be a Zoltan cruiser. Unfortunately, its Engi escort takes you for the attacker and retaliates! They refuse all hails.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-pick-up-the: You pick up the last broadcast from a rupturing Zoltan freighter: "The Mantis, they're here, please-" You're interrupted by fire off the port bow!
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-spy-two-pir: You spy two pirate ships lurking in the nebula here. They remain unaware of your presence; you're able to get your scanners to at least identify their cargo: One is carrying the fuel supplies, the other the ammunition. They begin to drift away from each other in the storm.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.this-nebula-tur: This nebula turns out to be the hiding place of a terrified rock crew taking refuge from the Zoltan border police. They don't seem prepared to risk your leaving with their co-ordinates, and open fire!
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.there-are-few-m: There are few more zealous in their customs checks than the Zoltan. A team of border police beam on board. There's just a little confusion over your weapons licences, but things escalate rapidly from heated discussion to gunfire!
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-arrive-in-a: You arrive in an asteroid field and are greeted by a Zoltan guard, "By attempting to access these closed mining fields, you are in violation of the Natural Mineral Protection Act. Your weaponry will be confiscated for processing." You don't have time for this.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.a-zoltan-academ: A Zoltan academy sits docked just outside the beacon perimeter. They're happy to show you the fruits of their labor, and offer something to take home with you.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-receive-an-: You receive an augmentation with low scrap
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-arrive-at-t:
You arrive at the primitive planet that you heard about at the cantina and are surprised to see a Zoltan ship facing off against a Rebel assault craft.

You tap into their frequency and hear the Rebel captain yelling, "We are liberating this planet in the name of the new Galactic government! These aliens will not be left in ignorance where they cannot be of use!"
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.interfere-make-: Interfere - make first contact with the primitive aliens
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.protect-the-ali: Protect the aliens' way of life - Attack the Rebel ship
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-arrive-at-a: You arrive at a Zoltan security checkpoint set up in a perimeter around the beacon. "Traveling vessel, you will submit to crew profiling to identify fugitives of the empire."
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-don-t-have-: You don't have time for this nonsense. Attack!
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.your-jump-inter: Your jump interrupts a Zoltan security ship as it follows a Mantis pirate into an asteroid field. They message you, "Your presence here will continue to be tolerated - but please, do not interfere."
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.interfere-and-s: Interfere and save the Mantis ship
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.interfere-and-h: Interfere and help the Zoltan ship
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.you-catch-a-gli: You catch a glimpse of a strange signal coming from a space station before your sensors shut off unexpectedly. As you discover that your sensors are being jammed, you hear hostiles beam onto your ship.
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.inside-this-neb: Inside this nebula you detect a rogue planet drifting through space, on its surface a huge monolith visible at this distance even to the naked eye. A Zoltan elder hails you from the planet. "Through luck or intent, you have discovered the Great Eye. Look into its depths and receive your just deserts."
wiki.cited-events-zoltan.lose-a-crewmemb: Lose a crewmember, a Zoltan ship, high scrap, or Healing Burst.
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-rebe: You come across a Rebel automated scout ship pursuing a civilian ship, weapons engaged.
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-an-automate: You detect an automated Rebel scout attacking a small refueling outpost.
wiki.cited-events.your-arrival-is-greete: Your arrival is greeted by numerous computer alerts. The nearby automated Rebel scout has deployed a virus and disrupted your shield system. Hopefully it won't cause further problems before you can destroy it.
wiki.cited-events.the-rebels-must-have-s: The Rebels must have sent their automated scouts to find you. One jumps in and immediately moves to attack.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-an-aster: You arrive in an asteroid belt to discover that a Rebel automated-scout has been stationed here. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-beac: You arrive at the beacon to find yourself dangerously close to a star. An automated Rebel ship, impervious to the heat, moves in to engage.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-automated-ship: A Rebel automated ship sits dormant near a Rebel forward radar station.
wiki.cited-events.keep-your-distance-and: Keep your distance and wait for the FTL to charge
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-a-rebel-aut: You detect a Rebel automated ship nearby. It does not engage and seems to be patrolling around a long-range sensor station.
wiki.cited-events.attack-the-automated-s: Attack the automated ship to get to the sensor station
wiki.cited-events.an-advance-sic-rebel-a: An advance <!-- [sic] -->rebel automated ship remains stationed near a small Rebel space-station. However, without functioning sensors it is impossible to tell what is inside.
wiki.cited-events.attack-the-automated-s: Attack the automated ship to get to the station
wiki.cited-events.fight-an-auto-ship-tha: Fight an Auto-ship that is running away
wiki.cited-events.you-find-two-heavily-d: You find two heavily damaged ships floating nearby, the remains of a battle. You begin to harvest some usable debris when you hear the sounds of someone beaming aboard followed by the shouts of a boarding party.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-medium-scr: You receive medium scrap with resources
wiki.cited-events.crystal-shards-fly-pas: Crystal shards fly past your ship as soon as you jump. You scan to find the assailant and discover a Crystalline ship carrying a number of humans in it's cargo bay. It must be hunting the intruding ships!
wiki.cited-events.a-large-convoy-of-lumb: A large convoy of lumbering civilian ships appears to be passing through this region. You show no hostile intentions, but they are taking no chances, immediately sending their escort to attack!
wiki.cited-events.there-appears-to-be-a-: There appears to be a fight going on nearby. A Crystalline border guard is chasing a small Federation ship!
wiki.cited-events.the-moment-you-arrive-: The moment you arrive you notice a Crystalline ship in the vicinity keeping its distance. They message you, "The 'Rebels' that are trying to hunt YOU down are creating havoc everywhere they go." "To minimize their impact on our people, we would like you to give them your flight path out of our sector. We would like to remain civil and are willing to pay you in 'scrap' for the increased danger it poses.
wiki.cited-events.accept-the-scrap-but-g: Accept the scrap but give them false flight plans
Accept the scrap but give them falsified flight plans.
wiki.cited-events.you-find-a-rebel-autom: You find a Rebel automated scout floating near this beacon. Despite its pristine condition, it appears to be de-activated.
wiki.cited-events.don-t-risk-activating-: Don't risk activating it, and just strip the ship for any useful scrap
wiki.cited-events.the-distress-signal-or: The distress signal originates at a small Engi ship under attack by a rebel fighter - but when they see Federation markings they turn to attack!
wiki.cited-events.what-appeared-to-be-a-: What appeared to be a single damaged ship is in fact two ships that have smashed into each other... there is a flurry of comm signals and damage, and it's hard to determine what occurred. The vessels appear to be... Engi? They look locked together by the impact and can't free themselves.
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-help-the-sh: Attempt to help the ships by prying them apart
wiki.cited-events.have-your-engi-crewmem: Have your Engi crewmember hail the vessel and assess the damage.
wiki.cited-events.for-a-moment-you-assum: For a moment you assume it's a glitch, but no... you've found a Federation military ship! They hail you and, after some probing, reveal that they deserted the Federation fleet before stumbling into this sector while seeking refuge.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-drone-sc: You receive a drone schematic with low scrap
wiki.cited-events.you-stumble-across-a-b: You stumble across a badly damaged Lanius craft. It jumps away as soon as it sees you. Looking around the area, you discover a number of destroyed Rebel automated ships. It must have been quite the fight. You scrap what remains.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-high-scrap: You receive high scrap with resources
wiki.cited-events.fight-a-lanius-ship-wi: Fight a Lanius ship with an Anti-Ship Battery on your side
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-lani: You come across a Lanius ship in the process of absorbing a Rebel automated scout. If you scare off the Lanius you could probably make use of it.
wiki.cited-events.the-mantis-ship-in-thi: The Mantis ship in this system looks like its distress beacon is malfunctioning... likely due to the Lanius ship mining their hull and sub-systems! It doesn't look like the Mantis ship will last much longer.
wiki.cited-events.leave-the-mantis-to-th: Leave the Mantis to their fate
wiki.cited-events.a-distress-beacon-puls: A distress beacon pulses weakly from a Rockman ship in this system... their hull (and their crew) are being mined by the Lanius, lasers and weapons tearing through the ship!
wiki.cited-events.leave-the-rockmen-to-t: Leave the Rockmen to their fate
wiki.cited-events.you-immediately-do-a-s: You immediately do a short-range scan after arriving at the beacon. It appears to be coming from a small civilian vessel under fire from a Lanius ship. Not all Lanius are content with simply scavenging the wrecks of previous battles.
wiki.cited-events.have-your-crew-admonis: Have your crew admonish their captain.
wiki.cited-events.a-lanius-crewmember-st: A Lanius crewmember starts a fight or powers the ship down.
wiki.cited-events.your-scans-have-picked: Your scans have picked up a Lanius vessel in this system: it appears to be navigating a rich debris field, harvesting the minerals.
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-harvest-som: Attempt to harvest some for yourself
wiki.cited-events.engage-the-auto-pilot-: Engage the auto-pilot and safely harvest the debris.
wiki.cited-events.improved-piloting-at-l: Improved Piloting at level 2 pays medium scrap with resources.
wiki.cited-events.advanced-piloting-at-l: Advanced Piloting at level 3 pays high scrap with resources.
wiki.cited-events.a-lanius-crewmember-ma: A Lanius crewmember may receive medium scrap only, a scoff, or nothing.
wiki.cited-events.you-lose-3-7-fuel-and: You lose 3-7 fuel and receive 15-30 scrap
wiki.cited-events.you-lose-3-7-missiles-: You lose 3-7 missiles and receive 20-40 scrap
wiki.cited-events.you-lose-3-7-drone-par: You lose 3-7 drone parts and receive 20-40 scrap
wiki.cited-events.you-cross-paths-with-a: You cross paths with a Mantis ship that looks to have had dozens of layers of armor-plating added over what must have been a hundred year career. Its captain is legendary thief KazaaakplethKilik. Your crew look frightened.
wiki.cited-events.the-mantis-outcasts-so: The Mantis outcasts sometimes make the mistake of taking the Zoltan for easy game. A scout moves in to attack while a boarding party beams aboard from a nearby transport!
wiki.cited-events.2-3-mantis-boarders-be: 2-3 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship and you fight a Mantis Ship (default rewards)
wiki.cited-events.you-discover-a-number-: You discover a number of civilian ships fleeing the area. Shots are fired and you find the assailant; a Mantis ship is attacking one of the smaller ships!
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-request-: You receive a request, "All of our military ships have been destroyed or damaged during the rebellion. However, there have been reports of a Mantis war camp only a few jumps from us. Can you help?"
wiki.cited-events.pledge-to-do-what-you-: Pledge to do what you can
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-responding-to-y: A ship responding to your distress moves in. Unfortunately it turns out to be an automated Rebel scout. It immediately reverses thrust after scanning your ship.
wiki.cited-events.offer-to-help-repair-t: Offer to help repair their hull.
wiki.cited-events.they-happily-accept-yo: They happily accept your offer for help. Once the drone does its work they transfer over some fuel for your trouble.
wiki.cited-events.fight-a-mantis-ship-th: Fight a Mantis ship that is running away
wiki.cited-events.fight-a-rebel-ship-tha: Fight a Rebel ship that is running away
wiki.cited-events.a-mobile-slugman-fuel-: A mobile Slugman fuel depot enters scanning range. "My prices are fair, but I ask one thing - do not insult me with negotiation!" You check out his price list.
wiki.cited-events.although-your-lack-of-: Although your lack of fuel cells prevents your ship from jumping, you can still use your impulse engines. Will you spend some time exploring the nearby system?
wiki.cited-events.try-to-be-a-hero-attac: Try to be a hero. Attack the pirate
wiki.cited-events.the-distress-beacon-is: The distress beacon is coming from a civilian ship. It appears it is being chased by a pirate.
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-with-conspicuou: A ship with conspicuous pirate markings is orbiting a nearby moon, broadcasting a simple message claiming to have equipment available for sale.
wiki.cited-events.attack-him-before-he-c: Attack him before he can attack!
wiki.cited-events.a-black-market-weapons: A black market weapons trader spins you a tale of the dangers of the nebula before pushing his wares.
wiki.cited-events.convince-him-to-make-i: Convince him to make it a better deal.
wiki.cited-events.a-declined-deal-or-a-p: A declined deal, or a Pirate ship.
wiki.cited-events.fend-for-yourself-atta: Fend for yourself, attack, and escape
wiki.cited-events.fly-behind-a-moon-and-: Fly behind a moon and stay hidden
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-midd: You arrive in the middle of a plasma storm. Despite the harsh conditions, a Rebel scout seems to be waiting for you.
wiki.cited-events.crystal-shards-fly-pas: Crystal shards fly past the screen as soon as you arrive. Checking the scanners, it looks like a crystalline ship is engaged with a Rebel!
wiki.cited-events.prepare-to-fight-the-r: Prepare to fight the Rebel ship!
wiki.cited-events.there-s-no-time-get-re: There's no time, get ready to jump
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-a-rebel-sco: You detect a Rebel scout on an attack approach to a small refueling outpost. Their weapons are charged, but they're not firing yet.
wiki.cited-events.wait-and-steal-the-sup: Wait and steal the supplies from the civilians
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-beac: You arrive at the beacon to find yourself in a huge Rebel shipyard, scaffolding and construction drones filling the sector! The entire system looks devoted to ship construction, the nearby planets and moons ruthlessly mined to harvest resources for a ship of immense size...
wiki.cited-events.you-spot-a-small-rebel: You spot a small rebel ship nearby. It seems to have been re-fitted for transport rather than combat. It does not seem to want to engage you and your ship.
wiki.cited-events.demand-the-surrender-o: Demand the surrender of their goods
wiki.cited-events.a-small-platform-orbit: A small platform orbits near this beacon - it looks like a fueling station of some sort, and it is cheerily broadcasting reasonable prices in a spectrum of frequencies and languages.
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-re-fueling-stat: A ship re-fueling station is stationed at this beacon. We can purchase fuel here.
wiki.cited-events.tell-them-their-god-se: Tell them their god sent them here to join your crew
wiki.cited-events.a-rock-armoured-transp: A rock armoured transport nearby looks to have lost its bearings, but when you hail they grow suspicious: "Whatever life-form you are, we find you repugnant. We seek no aid. Leave. Now."
wiki.cited-events.you-see-a-civilian-spa: You see a civilian space station with heavy damage. You receive a message, "We've been hit hard by the war. We need more drone parts to speed up our repairs. We'll buy some from you if you have extra."
wiki.cited-events.there-is-a-black-marke: There is a black market hub here. You receive a message, "These are dangerous times. If you have extra military-grade explosives, we'll gladly pay you for them."
wiki.cited-events.you-recognize-the-ship: You recognize the ship as a well known slave trader. He hails you and offers you "laborers" for cheap.
wiki.cited-events.ignore-the-slaver-and-: Ignore the slaver and continue on your way
wiki.cited-events.an-especially-well-arm: An especially well-armed pirate ship approaches you. "Hand over one of your crew and the rest can go unharmed."
wiki.cited-events.draw-straws-and-send-a: Draw straws and send a crew-member over to the slavers.
wiki.cited-events.we-will-never-surrende: We will never surrender one of our crew to slavers!
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-out-run-the: Attempt to out-run the slaver ship.
wiki.cited-events.a-slug-captain-hails-a: A Slug captain hails and invites himself aboard your ship to present a flask of something slimy. "Now, most gracioussss captain, you must join me please in a drink to our alliance!"
wiki.cited-events.you-are-immediately-ha: You are immediately hailed by a dangerous looking ship. "I'm feeling generouss today. I shall allow you to choose your own death. Which do you like leasst: shields, oxygen, or weaponsss?"
wiki.cited-events.offer-35-scrap-to-leav: Offer 35 scrap to leave you alone
wiki.cited-events.there-are-few-more-vic: There are few more vicious beasts in the galaxy than a Slug with his back to the wall. The faltering ship armed with fire-weapons uses a remote hacking tool to try and disable your door system - they're going to burn you out!
wiki.cited-events.a-slug-ship-hails-you-: A Slug ship hails you: "We've detected some worrying radiation coming from your medical unit, perhaps you should take a look?" As he signs off, your medical bay shuts off and their crew teleports aboard from a nearby station. They don't look like engineers.
wiki.cited-events.try-to-squeeze-some-ex: Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.
wiki.cited-events.the-slugs-here-use-a-t: The slugs here use a tactic you hoped you'd never see: They sabotage your oxygen production system and then charge fire-weapons - you're going to suffocate!
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-spac: You come across a space station under construction. You receive a message from their command tower, "Greetings. We recently lost contact with a cargo ship that was set to deliver more construction materials. Could you help us figure out what happened to them?"
wiki.cited-events.the-engi-are-awaiting-: The Engi are awaiting you at the beacon, with their weapons on-line! They explain a computer virus that is wanted for hostile acts against the Engi (multiple counts of binary scrambling, nano-dissolution, and variable interference) is aboard your vessel. They insist they must destroy your ship to prevent the virus from escaping!
wiki.cited-events.hold-on-let-us-try-to: Hold on! Let us try to purge the system code!
wiki.cited-events.hire-the-mercenary-to-: Hire the mercenary to delay the Rebels
wiki.cited-events.you-have-no-need-of-hi: You have no need of his services
wiki.cited-events.you-pick-up-a-zoltan-l: You pick up a Zoltan life raft floating in space. Its inhabitant asks you to retake his ship from the pirates who recently commandeered it. "I'm certain it is clear," he concludes, "that you must not destroy my vessel in the process."
wiki.cited-events.you-come-to-a-quiet-pa: You come to a quiet part of Zoltan space and encounter an ancient Zoltan wise man who has managed to harness the power of a spatial rift, but seems to have been driven completely mad by the power. "Choose your doom," he demands. This is all part of a day's work.
wiki.cited-events.an-image-of-some-weak-: An image of some weak and hungry humans comes onto your screen. "Those metal bastards think they can just absorb half of our engines and leave us here to die? I hope you understand the need to take your ship by force."
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-a-quiet-: You arrive at a quiet spaceport and are immediately hailed by another ship at port with a "once in a lifetime deal!"
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-into-a-sector: You jump into a sector filled with civilian activity. Your scan the various advertisement channels while waiting for your FTL to charge, and are intrigued by a grey-market shipwright.
wiki.cited-events.your-ship-is-flooded-w: Your ship is flooded with advertisement transmissions from nearby merchants as soon as you arrive at this beacon. You arbitrarily pick one to examine in detail.
wiki.cited-events.despite-the-barren-are: Despite the barren area, a trader has set up shop at this beacon. He presents his offer.
wiki.cited-events.the-beacon-at-first-gl: The beacon at first glance seems home to a junk yard. Upon closer inspection, it reveals itself to be a ramshackle market. One trader has a deal that catches your eye.
wiki.cited-events.a-pawn-broker-has-set-: A pawn broker has set up shop at this obscure beacon. He might be offering something worth looking at.
wiki.cited-events.it-s-hard-to-see-why: It's hard to see why, but this beacon is apparently a tourist destination. One of the ships at the small station is offering a deal.
wiki.cited-events.aided-by-a-modified-tr: Aided by a modified translator, a nearby Lanius scavenger ship messages you, saying, "Metal sufficient. Request exchange." It appears there are some Lanius who wish sociable interaction with other races.
wiki.cited-events.a-small-lanius-craft-a: A small Lanius craft approaches. You prepare for a fight but they do not seem to be carrying any weapons. After a brief moment they message you, although your translator struggles with the unfamiliar dialect. It appears they wish to trade.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-to-find-a-l: You arrive to find a large Lanius vessel laden with recently collected metal. They are apparently offering to trade for supplies they are lacking.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-jump-into-the-s: As you jump into the system a pirate advances on your position. They are refusing all hails. Prepare for a fight.
wiki.cited-events.soon-after-arriving-in: Soon after arriving in the system you are hailed by a small cruiser. "What good fortune that we happen to run into each other. Nothing personal, but you have some information we need!"
wiki.cited-events.at-first-it-appears-yo: At first it appears you've arrived in an empty system, but a ship appears from behind a planet and hails you: "Haha! I am the dread pirate Tuco, prepare to die!"
wiki.cited-events.the-only-other-ship-at: The only other ship at this beacon messages you: "Finally, after months of waiting, someone has fallen into our trap!"
wiki.cited-events.you-barely-have-time-t: You barely have time to register jump completion before your ship warns you of an incoming ship with weapons hot.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-a-system: You arrive in a system and immediately discover a pirate ship nearby. Strangely, scans indicate there are no lifeforms aboard. You salvage anything useful, but find no clue as to the whereabouts of the former crew.
wiki.cited-events.not-much-remains-in-th: Not much remains in this abandoned system; however, scans reveal a nearby mining platform with some salvageable materials.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-arrive-in-the-s: As you arrive in the system you are hailed by a loyalist settlement. Upon learning of your quest, they offer you supplies.
wiki.cited-events.debris-from-a-forgotte: Debris from a forgotten battle still orbits the gas giant in this system. Some of it still might be usable.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message from a nearby station, "A Federation cruiser jumping into Rebel territory? Quite the bold move." You quickly move to arm the weapons but he continues, "Lucky for you we're not all in support of the Rebellion. Perhaps these supplies will help you get to friendlier space alive."
wiki.cited-events.you-happen-upon-the-re: You happen upon the remains of a space station. It has been mostly picked clean but there appears to be a few materials that will aid you in your mission.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-beac: You arrive at the beacon and immediately detect a pirate ship. It seems this distress beacon was a trap!
wiki.cited-events.haha-i-knew-someone-wo: "Haha! I knew someone would fall into our dastardly trap!" It appears this distress beacon was nothing but a decoy for a pirate ambush.
wiki.cited-events.your-cockpit-lights-up: Your cockpit lights up with warning signals. You are being targeted by a nearby ship. The distress call was a lure to attract unwitting ships into weapons range. You prepare for a fight.
wiki.cited-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive-: As soon as you arrive at the distress signal, shots are fired toward your ship. A trap!
wiki.cited-events.the-ion-storm-here-thr: The ion storm here threatens to deactivate your core systems, a fact made all the worse for the largely unaffected Slug ships circling like space-vultures.
wiki.cited-events.the-slug-ship-that-des: The Slug ship that descends into view as you enter the ion storm must have sensed your distress - defensive action!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-midd: You arrive in the middle of an ion storm. Slugs generally avoid these storms but you find one waiting in ambush. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.you-find-yourself-stuc: You find yourself stuck in the middle of an ion storm with a Slug ship just a short distance away, refusing all hails. You cautiously try to slip further into the clouds, but they turn suddenly to attack!
wiki.cited-events.holy-crap-a-weapon-is-: Holy crap! A weapon is just floating in space!
wiki.cited-events.you-inform-a-nearby-st: You inform a nearby station of your flight from the Rebels. They offer to outfit your ship with a weapon and wish you well.
wiki.cited-events.a-settlement-still-loy: A settlement still loyal to the Federation hails your ship. They have prepared a weapon to aid your escape from the Rebels.
wiki.cited-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive-: As soon as you arrive a small Mantis ship detaches from a wreck and jumps away. You must have interrupted their salvage operation because you find a weapon ready to be installed!
wiki.cited-events.a-small-merchant-ship-: A small merchant ship messages you, "Underground Federation comm channels are all talking about your 'secret' mission. Let us install a weapon to help. Good luck!"
wiki.cited-events.debris-from-a-battle-i: Debris from a battle is scattered around this system. A few pieces bounce against your ship. You passively scan them and discover there is a functioning weapon among them!
wiki.cited-events.a-rather-large-fleet-o: A rather large fleet of civilian ships are held up at this Beacon. It appears to be a Rebel checkpoint; everyone is being inspected for possible ties to the Federation. No one has noticed you yet.
wiki.cited-events.another-rebel-checkpoi: Another Rebel checkpoint is monitoring this location. A number of civilian ships are awaiting inspection, any of them could be Federation loyalists. The Rebels haven't noticed you yet.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-space-station-: A Rebel space station and single fighter is monitoring this Beacon for Federation activity. A number of civilian ships are docked, awaiting inspection by the Rebels and possible detainment if they are Federation loyalists. The Rebels haven't noticed you yet.
wiki.cited-events.it-looks-like-this-bea: It looks like this Beacon is home to a Rebel checkpoint. They're stopping and searching any ship that passes through. Civilians are being harassed, and Federation members are detained. The Rebels haven't noticed you yet.
wiki.cited-events.sensors-go-wild-as-a-n: Sensors go wild as a nearby pulsar is detected. While you are attempting to recalibrate the FTL drive, a pirate sneaks up on your ship, weapons charging. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-to-find-a-p: You arrive to find a pulsar dominating the view screen. You see a small silhouette pass in front of the star. Before you can ponder what it is, warning signals go off. It appears to be a ship in a firing trajectory!
wiki.cited-events.a-small-research-stati: A small research station orbits a nearby pulsar. It appears largely abandoned, but you detect power signatures flaring up as soon as you're in scanning distance. A small combat ship launches from the station. Pirates!
wiki.cited-events.you-encounter-a-rock-v: You encounter a Rock vessel and attempt to open trading frequencies, but they take it as an act of cultural transgression and open fire.
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-into-the-midd: You jump into the middle of a Rock excavation project on a nearby moon. Unimpressed with your intrusion they move to defend themselves!
wiki.cited-events.you-intercept-chatter-: You intercept chatter from an approaching Rock ship: "Weapons, moving in to engage, arm the tubes." There is no talking to these guys.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-jump-in-a-vast: As you jump in, a vast figure appears on the view-screen. The Rock captain rubs the green, moss-like appendage on his chin and then orders his crew to open fire.
wiki.cited-events.it-looks-quiet-but-you: It looks quiet, but you realize your computer is being scanned. A hidden Rock vessel hails you: "Why do you fill your computer with lies?! These are not the holy words!" Before you can interject they open fire.
wiki.cited-events.you-notice-a-rock-ship: You notice a Rock ship performing combat exercises. However, they quickly change their course to engage your ship. They apparently treat unregistered alien ships as handy target practice.
wiki.cited-events.a-loud-thud-resounds-t: A loud 'thud' resounds through the ship after jump completion - you've just shunted a Rock fighter and he's already preparing to fire!
wiki.cited-events.you-re-intercepted-by-: You're intercepted by a Rock salvage operation. They don't seem to mind that you're still on board while they junk your ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-intercept-discussi: You intercept discussions between a Rebel patrol and a human mining colony, "...we realize you're scared but all reports indicate the metal bastards target abandoned settlements only. If we relocated our fleets based on every request from backwater... wait, what's that..." Before you can react, the channel is cut and the Rebel ship moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-to-see-a-nu: You arrive to see a number of Rebel ships attempting to dissuade Lanius scavenger ships from "acquiring" their forward station. A passing Rebel patrol ship spots you and moves in to intercept.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-scout-patrols-: A Rebel scout patrols near the beacon. "Hah! I knew you would try to sneak through this sector as soon as I heard it had become treacherous. Surrender!"
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-beac: You arrive at the beacon and notice a small Rebel ship chasing Lanius scavengers away from a wrecked Rebel battleship. As soon as the Rebel notices you and moves in to attack, the Lanius ships return to their prey like flies on garbage.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-messages-you-w: A Rebel messages you. "Who would have thought the most wanted ship in the quadrant would just happen by my station? Prepare to meet your maker."
wiki.cited-events.your-arrival-coincides: Your arrival coincides almost exactly with that of a Rebel ship. It's hard to know who is more surprised, but there is no option but to fight.
wiki.cited-events.you-passively-scan-a-s: You passively scan a small Rock station that is next to the beacon. However they must not have appreciated your curiosity. A Rock ship pulls away from the station and you register an incoming teleporter signal as well!
wiki.cited-events.you-find-a-rock-ship-d: You find a Rock ship docked with a damaged Mantis fighter. Before you have a chance to hail them, the ship moves in to attack you and you register teleporter symbols from the disabled ship. They're using Mantis tech to board you!
wiki.cited-events.you-discover-one-of-th: You discover one of the Rebel's autonomous scouts. The ship's AI wastes no time in engaging your ship.
wiki.cited-events.your-ship-is-hailed-th: Your ship is hailed: "This is an automated message. Resisting our takeover is pointless. Prepare to die." It appears this Rebel ship is run by an AI.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-autonomous-sco: A Rebel autonomous scout is exploring this beacon. You attempt to hide behind a nearby moon, but the ship finds you and begins its assault.
wiki.cited-events.the-ai-of-a-nearby-sma: The AI of a nearby small Rebel scout immediately identifies you as a threat and engages.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-moves-in-: A Rebel ship moves in to engage. You attempt to open communications, but realize the futility of that action when you see the ship is run by an AI.
wiki.cited-events.this-must-be-one-of-th: This must be one of the Rebels' unmanned scout ships. Looks like there's no way around a fight.
wiki.cited-events.another-unmanned-ship-: Another unmanned ship patrols this area. You prepare the ship for combat.
wiki.cited-events.this-beacon-is-being-p: This beacon is being patrolled by a unmanned scout. A fight is unavoidable.
wiki.cited-events.a-small-shuttle-appear: A small shuttle appears on the local radar. Turns out it is a Rebel automated scout!
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message from a nearby Rebel station, "You have a lot of guts passing through our space, I'll give you that." He turns giving an order, "Kill their crew, I want that ship intact."
wiki.cited-events.your-sensors-warn-of-a: Your sensors warn of an incoming Rebel ship at the same time as you hear the telltale signs of a teleporter. You hear someone taunt from within the ship, "Ready to die? I sure am ready to get a promotion!"
wiki.cited-events.incoming-message-hello: Incoming message, "Hello Captain," says a Rebel in an officer's garb. "How very generous of you to turn yourself in. Prepare to be boarded. Come quietly and we may be lenient."
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message on a low-band channel. "You're surrounded, just like the last of your Federation friends. Just die already." The enemy has teleported onto your ship!
wiki.cited-events.a-derelict-and-still-s: A derelict and still smoking Mantis vessel floats by. The battle must have been recent; its surviving crew beam aboard. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.your-world-all-of-a-su: Your world, all of a sudden, changes. The Mantis are on board your ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-hear-a-grating-rat: You hear a grating rattle and a soft clicking. You reach for your pistol.
wiki.cited-events.you-see-a-small-statio: You see a small station nearby and feel the shudder of shots ringing through the ship. You can't be sure without sensors, but it seems there may be intruders on the ship!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-nebu: You arrive in the nebula and immediately receive a message from an unknown source, "Prepare to be boarded!" With the static from the nebula, there's no way to tell where they came from, but you hear shots fired on board the ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-see-a-number-of-de: You see a number of derelict ships near this beacon. After a short time you hear the tell-tale sounds of a teleporter and shouts coming from within the ship. You've been boarded!
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-a-heavily-a: You detect a heavily armed Crystalline ship escorting some sort of prison vessel. Scans indicate there are a number of non-Crystal based life forms aboard; they must be rounding up all of the intruders in their space! Before you can react, you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter going off.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-near-a-smal: You arrive near a small settlement and a lone guard ship moves to intercept you. You try to contact them but they are refusing all hails. Suddenly you hear lasers ricocheting from within the ship. You've been boarded!
wiki.cited-events.you-pick-up-chatter-fr: You pick up chatter from a nearby ship, "Yes... Here are some interesting specimens. Try to take them alive this time, there's a lot of money to be had on aliens." Scanners indicate a remote teleporter was just used.
wiki.cited-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive-: As soon as you arrive you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter and shouts reverberating through the ship, "Prepare to burn, fleshy meat-sack aliens!"
wiki.cited-events.with-their-high-resist: With their high resistance to heat, outlaw Rocks often settle very close to stars. That is why it is hardly surprising when your ship gets boarded as you stumble past a hidden settlement.
wiki.cited-events.what-appears-to-be-a-c: What appears to be a civilian ship sends a friendly hail. As you approach the vessel, you detect a teleporter signal but it's too late... intruders have beamed aboard!"
wiki.cited-events.a-heavily-damaged-ship: A heavily damaged ship is drifting near this beacon. You receive a communication: "Hello! Nice of you to drop by. As you can see, our ship has seen better days. Yours is looking quite nice, I think we might be taking it from you now." Intruders beam aboard.
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-life-signs-: You detect life-signs actually on the beacon itself! A teleporter signal warns you but it's too late, they've beamed from the beacon onto your ship and seem intent on taking it over.
wiki.cited-events.your-ship-detects-a-fa: Your ship detects a faint distress signal on a nearby moon. As you approach the rock, warning lights flash as hostiles beam aboard the ship from some hidden location.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-arrive-you-beco: As you arrive, you become aware of a small Rebel outpost near the beacon. You are hardly able to bark an order before a small team is beamed aboard your ship. They must have been expecting you...
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-an-aster: You arrive in an asteroid field and immediately begin evasive maneuvers when a loud clunk reverberates through the ship. At first you think the hull has been hit, but the noise came from some Rock intruders teleporting aboard the ship!
wiki.cited-events.your-shields-are-being: Your shields are being taxed as they deflect the debris from an asteroid field. As you weave your way between the rocks, you happen upon a Rock pirate stronghold. You register teleport signatures and hear shouts aboard the ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message on a wide band frequency, originating from an approaching Lanius ship. It appears not to be directed at you, but your translator does its best all the same: "... metallic opportunity... acquisition... by force..." Looks like you're in for a fight.
wiki.cited-events.sensors-indicate-a-sma: Sensors indicate a small Lanius cruiser in the process of salvaging another small Lanius ship. Before you have a chance to wonder what caused them to turn on each other, the survivor notices you and moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.shortly-after-your-arr: Shortly after your arrival, a Lanius ship jumps near the beacon. It begins to move slowly toward you. You open wide band communication channels, attempting to make contact. However, it either ignores you or is unable to receive the messages. As they get closer you issue the order to charge weapons and find they do the same.
wiki.cited-events.a-military-lanius-vess: A military Lanius vessel stops repurposing an abandoned satellite as soon as you jump in. It blocks all hails and powers its weapons.
wiki.cited-events.the-beacon-is-surround: The beacon is surrounded by many tiny Lanius crafts, surely only capable of holding one occupant. Perhaps they are some kind of forward scout searching for 'metallic opportunities'? As you consider this, a much larger Lanius vessel moves in to engage you, and the scout ships scatter in all directions.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-to-see-a-we: You arrive to see a well-armed Lanius craft preparing to salvage a badly damaged Rebel patrol ship. Noticing your arrival, the Lanius greedily moves in to intercept its second target of the day.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-arrive-in-the-s: As you arrive in the system, your proximity alarm begins screaming: there is a Lanius ship right on top of you! Before you have a chance to hail, they open fire!
wiki.cited-events.as-you-are-getting-you: As you are getting your bearings, another ship suddenly arrives at the beacon - it's the Lanius, and they've marked your ship for salvage!
wiki.cited-events.at-first-everything-se: At first everything seems quiet, then your scanners pick up a ship approaching at high speed - the Lanius have detected your arrival and are powering up their weapons!
wiki.cited-events.you-have-stumbled-acro: You have stumbled across a mining expedition - unfortunately, the miners are the Lanius, and they've chosen your ship as their target!
wiki.cited-events.a-mixed-radar-signal-t: A mixed radar signal turns out to be a Mantis attack ship scavenging the remains of an Engi carrier. They turn and fight.
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-mant: You come across a Mantis raider taking pot shots at a defenceless Engi supply station. Discovering its weapons aren't much of a match for the station's armour, it turns on your ship. Battle stations!
wiki.cited-events.the-area-looks-clear-a: The area looks clear, and you prepare to jump off, but a Mantis scout jumps in behind you! They're as surprised as you are, but their weapons are already online.
wiki.cited-events.you-find-a-mantis-ship: You find a Mantis ship harrying a small squad of Engi. They make it to the node and jump off, leaving you toe to toe with their pursuer!
wiki.cited-events.nebulas-are-known-to-b: Nebulas are known to be popular Mantis hunting grounds. Information you would have done well to heed here.
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-a-mantis-ex: You detect a Mantis expedition vessel returning home with its haul. So determined are they, in fact, that they don't wait to see if you're hostile before firing.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-ship-lost-in-: A Mantis ship, lost in the storm, hails you. "Sensors are out. We have no local telemetry. We will take yours." You detect a power increase in their weapons systems.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-ship-hails-yo: A Mantis ship hails you through the storm: "These are sacred Urggghtnag clan hunting grounds. You are prey." Shields up!
wiki.cited-events.you-notice-a-mantis-at: You notice a Mantis attack ship ducking between the clouds of swirling space stuff; it's hunting you. You try to get the jump and move in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-military-ship: A Mantis military ship appears on local radar alongside the remains of a human freighter. Prepare for a hostile encounter!
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-military-scou: A Mantis military scout hails your ship. "Foolish alien! Your kind has stifled our greatness for too long! You will rue the day you backed the Federation!"
wiki.cited-events.a-small-mantis-cruiser: A small Mantis cruiser is broadcasting a repeating message on a wide-band frequency, "All non-Mantis ships that enter our territory are forfeit. Lower your shields and surrender if you value your lives."
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-a-small-mil: You detect a small military outpost and a few freighters nearby. This mineral rich planet in an isolated location would be perfect for an illegal Mantis mining operation. As you consider your options, a ship launches from the outpost. Prepare for a fight.
wiki.cited-events.you-discover-yet-anoth: You discover yet another unlicensed and uncharted Mantis colony. They certainly waste no time expanding their claims. A Mantis ship moves to intercept you before you can jump away.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-military-scou: A Mantis military scout seems to have just finished a salvage op on a nearby wreck. They have no time to waste with warnings and appear to wish to fight.
wiki.cited-events.a-small-military-craft: A small military craft hails you and a Mantis captain appears on your receiver. "All local human colonies have been punished for the Federation's transgressions. Submit to processing."
wiki.cited-events.a-nearby-mantis-ship-b: A nearby Mantis ship begins aggressive maneuvers. You prepare for the worst.
wiki.cited-events.a-stream-of-clicks-and: A stream of clicks and gurgling comes on the comm from a hostile Mantis scout. The universal translator might be on the blink, but his intent is obvious.
wiki.cited-events.the-mantis-ship-is-ple: The Mantis ship is pleased to see you, and fires up its weapon systems.
