wiki.cited-events.you-recognize-the-outl: You recognize the outline of a Mantis ship against the blackness. Engage!
wiki.cited-events.something-red-looms-it: Something red looms. It's the Mantis.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-vessel-hails-: A Mantis vessel hails you. "This hail is merely a distraction!" You notice their shields and weapons have come online.
wiki.cited-events.you-notice-a-flurry-of: You notice a flurry of laser fire glance by the port window. The Mantis are upon you.
wiki.cited-events.the-mantis-hail-you-th: The Mantis hail you. Their captain says, "I claim this vessel for my clan. Good hunting!"
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-female-comes-: A Mantis female comes on the vidscreen. The females don't make it to authority unless they're particularly vicious. You power the weapons.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-ship-with-the: A Mantis ship with the markings of a warrior tribe breaks position and attacks!
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-ship-hails-ah: A Mantis ship hails: "Ah! Fine prey. Fine prey! We honor you with our most eviscerating arsenal!" You sense a cloud to this silver lining and power the weapons.
wiki.cited-events.children-on-earth-are-: Children on Earth are told terrible tales of the blood red Mantis invasion ships - much like the one bearing down on you now - which once threatened the planet. You order weapons free!
wiki.cited-events.a-youthful-looking-man: A youthful-looking Mantis captain hails. "You, prey, must know. Your death, Kaaazthwak's final kill before maturity. Kaaazthwak pay respects." Seems respects in Mantis culture are paid with lasers.
wiki.cited-events.you-re-greeted-by-a-ra: You're greeted by a rare sight: a Mantis ship that appears not to have noticed you.
wiki.cited-events.for-once-you-see-the-m: For once, you see the Mantis before they see you.
wiki.cited-events.when-they-see-the-mant: When they see the Mantis warship waiting in ambush at your intended coordinates, your crew is relieved to note you've jumped someway off the mark.
wiki.cited-events.you-overhear-mantis-co: You overhear Mantis comm chatter: "Negative, I have killed more humans!" You gulp noticeably, but luckily they don't see you yet.
You overhear Mantis comm chatter: "The one on the right is starting to rot. Take him down. Take off his fingers. Put him out of the airlock." They certainly don't seem to be friendly...
You overhear Mantis comm chatter: "Agreed. Next ship is your turn. Good hunting." They don't see you yet.
wiki.cited-events.you-spot-a-mantis-ship: You spot a Mantis ship hunting in the distance.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-ship-engaging: A Mantis ship engaging a civilian hails you. Sparks fly about his cockpit as he yells, "Stay out of this human! Else you are next!"
wiki.cited-events.local-sensors-pick-up-: Local sensors pick up two ships engaged in a heated battle. It seems the Mantis military ship will surely defeat its prey.
wiki.cited-events.a-mantis-vessel-flashe: A Mantis vessel flashes past your view-screen, weapons and engines at full. A tiny blip on the sensor readout marks its quarry.
wiki.cited-events.you-pick-up-a-distress: You pick up a distress call from a civilian ship. It's being chased by a Mantis ship!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-syst: You arrive in the system to see a pirate ship pursuing a civilian ship. You detect messages from the civilian ship on a distress frequency.
wiki.cited-events.scanners-indicate-that: Scanners indicate that a battle is taking place nearby. It seems that someone is under attack by space pirates.
wiki.cited-events.you-detect-two-ships-o: You detect two ships, one chasing the other... Scanners show the pursuer is a pirate!
wiki.cited-events.there-are-only-two-shi: There are only two ships within range and they seem to be engaged in battle. One of them has the markings of a space pirate.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-next: You arrive at the next beacon only to immediately be hailed by a small shuttle. "Help us! We are being attacked by pirates!"
wiki.cited-events.you-come-out-of-the-ju: You come out of the jump to see laser blasts coming from the other side of the beacon. It looks like someone is under attack from pirates.
wiki.cited-events.you-discover-an-abando: You discover an abandoned mining facility in the process of being 'acquired' by the Lanius. However, you immediately receive a call from a civilian transport vessel, "Help! We were trying to escape before the Lanius came only to be caught by pirates!" You see a lone pirate ship boarding the civilian craft.
wiki.cited-events.a-pirate-ship-emerges-: A pirate ship emerges from hiding after you and another ship jump into the area. Sensors show the pirates ran a quick scan of your ship's weapon system before flying off to pursue the unarmed civilian ship.
wiki.cited-events.a-pirate-ship-is-firin: A pirate ship is firing on the small ships docked at a refueling station. They are broadcasting on a wide band channel. You catch the captain's rant mid-speed, "...saw you trading with those damned scavengers. I'll show you what happens when you try and undercut the Red Giant gang!"
wiki.cited-events.as-you-drift-through-t: As you drift through the nebula an unmarked vessel descends from the clouds and into your wake. Their weapons come online.
wiki.cited-events.a-pirate-ship-pulls-ou: A pirate ship pulls out of the ether and hails: "You know what I love about this part of the galaxy? The explorers! You always carry such fine loot." They lock weapons.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-coast-through-t: As you coast through the nebula a pirate ship matches your course and closes the distance. Better to pick your battleground, but beggars can't be choosers.
wiki.cited-events.a-hostile-vessel-desce: A hostile vessel descends from out of the nebula. Combat stations!
wiki.cited-events.you-try-to-read-the-id: You try to read the ID of a ship ahead in the fog, but it's too thick to penetrate. You have your answer when the ship turns, weapons hot!
wiki.cited-events.you-cross-paths-with-a: You cross paths with an advance scout of the Rebel fleet searching this section of the nebula for your ship.
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-bearing-rebel-c: A ship bearing Rebel colors can be seen waiting near the beacon. They must have been waiting for you, since they engage immediately.
wiki.cited-events.the-rebels-must-have-a: The Rebels must have anticipated you would try to lose them within the nebula. A scout is waiting for you at the beacon.
wiki.cited-events.it-looks-like-you-will: It looks like you will be unable to avoid the Rebels by traveling through the nebula. A Rebel ship is waiting for you near the beacon.
wiki.cited-events.shortly-after-you-arri: Shortly after you arrive, a Rebel ship jumps nearby. There looks to be no escape. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.newton-knows-what-brin: Newton-knows what brings this Rebel ship so far out; its captain hails, but does a double take when he identifies your ship. They open fire.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-hails-but: A Rebel ship hails, but you don't take chances in conditions like this. You block the frequency and prepare to engage.
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-into-a-calmer: You jump into a calmer part of the nebula. However, your relief fades as a Rebel scout jumps to the beacon and moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.the-tangled-wrecks-of-: The tangled wrecks of many ships wait in dormancy here. You see lights flicker on what looks like debris. A Rebel scout bursts out of the wreckage!
wiki.cited-events.this-drone-isn-t-looki: This drone isn't looking for you. Perhaps it's scouting ahead for the Rebel expansion or maybe they're seeking to use this nebula for cover. Regardless, it identifies you as hostile.
wiki.cited-events.it-s-worrying-that-the: It's worrying that the Rebels have penetrated so deep into uncharted space, even if it is only an unmanned craft. It arms its weapons; you should do the same.
wiki.cited-events.a-zoltan-ship-makes-co: A Zoltan ship makes contact. "The nature of the day is rotational. The fever is emaciated. The reason is-" They've caught some nasty deep space dementia. Before you can consider finding help for them, they open fire.
wiki.cited-events.you-re-surprised-when-: You're surprised when a stationary Zoltan ship opens fire. It appears there are aggressive pugilists even among the 'enlightened'.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message, "This area is off limits. Submit your ship to processing." It's only one guard ship in a lonely beacon. You decide to fight your way out.
wiki.cited-events.you-discover-a-number-: You discover a number of Zoltan civilian ships fighting off pirates. Unfortunately one ship mistakes your purpose and moves in to attack! They are refusing all communication; you have no choice but to fight.
wiki.cited-events.like-many-areas-in-zol: Like many areas in Zoltan space, the residents of this sector prepared well for Galactic war. The military here seem to have given up reasoning with foreigners, preferring instead to attack on sight!
wiki.cited-events.a-zoltan-ship-is-waiti: A Zoltan ship is waiting at this beacon. They request your identification, but radiation from the sun in this system is disrupting your communications. They take your silence for aggression and move in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.the-zoltan-ship-patrol: The Zoltan ship patrolling this area hails you: "This area is off limits. Secrecy is vital." They power their weapons.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-near-a-flee: You arrive near a fleet of crystal ships, civilian or mercantile from the looks of them. You pause to scan one but they react immediately and send an escort to fight you off. Prepare to engage!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-beac: You arrive at the Beacon and are immediately greeted by an automatic message or warning of some kind. The translator can't seem to discern its purpose but after a few short moments an alarm goes off and a hostile ship jumps in!
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message, "Hah. It looks like another worthless alien-filled craft. Prepare to meet your maker!" Weapon locks detected.
wiki.cited-events.a-crystalline-ship-mes: A Crystalline ship messages you, "I've heard tales that our isolation has finally ended. As a warrior I must demand to test my skills against you!" Before you can respond they move in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-a-busy-s: You arrive in a busy sector. At first no one pays any mind to your alien ship but soon you're registering a number of scan signatures. You get the feeling you're not wanted here just seconds before registering enemy weapon locks!
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-next-to-a-nod: You jump next to a node busy with traffic, but before long all nearby ships notice you and keep their distance, uncertain of your allegiance. After an awkward standoff, a military ship breaks away from the rest and charges you.
wiki.cited-events.a-barrage-of-rasps-and: A barrage of rasps and clicks is broadcast over the comm; the universal translator understands little, but the words 'aliens', 'allowed' and 'no' come through quite clearly. You'll have to prove your right to be here in combat!
wiki.cited-events.although-you-were-expe: Although you were expecting the Rebels, you never imagined their fleet could have grown so fast. Your scanners can hardly register them all before a fighter stationed nearby moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.this-system-is-flooded: This system is flooded with Rebel warships. Luckily your ship's signature is disguised as a civilian transport. Most heavy vessels ignore you but a small fighter is approaching with weapons hot!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-to-find-a-r: You arrive to find a Rebel battalion encircling a nearby planet, launching landing parties. A small scout moves toward your position. Prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive-: As soon as you arrive you find yourself in the debris of a fierce battle. However, only Rebel warships remain and you find yourself immediately under attack.
wiki.cited-events.shots-fly-by-and-your-: Shots fly by and your computer registers multiple weapon locks as soon as you arrive. Evasive action!
wiki.cited-events.what-was-once-a-great-: What was once a great series of space stations is now nothing but a small ring of debris around the nearby moon. There's no time to mourn the dead; an enemy approaches!
wiki.cited-events.the-federation-seems-t: The Federation seems to have put up a good fight. A number of Rebel ships lie broken or wounded. However their overwhelming numbers force the remaining Federation forces to retreat. Hopefully you can get away in time as well.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-midd: You arrive in the middle of a raging battle. Both sides are taking heavy losses. A small squadron flies past and a fighter breaks off, moving toward your position.
wiki.cited-events.two-fleets-fight-nearb: Two fleets fight nearby. You try to skirt around the edges of the battle and keep out of weapons range, but a Rebel scout spots you and moves in.
wiki.cited-events.it-s-hard-to-tell-who: It's hard to tell who is winning the nearby battle. Before you have a chance to figure it out, a fighter moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.the-sheer-scale-of-the: The sheer scale of the destruction in the distance is almost breath-taking. Unfortunately, your position as an independent observer doesn't last for long!
wiki.cited-events.the-destruction-in-the: The destruction in the distance is almost awe-inspiring. However you're dragged back to reality as Sensors indicate you are under attack.
wiki.cited-events.you-don-t-have-any-tim: You don't have any time to worry about the battle in the distance. The fight is coming to you really quickly!
wiki.cited-events.you-immediately-receiv: You immediately receive a message upon arrival, "Help! These metal bastards have gone crazy!" The communication originates from the hull of a partially dismantled ship which lies among a number of other destroyed ships. The violent Lanius ship responsible for this carnage is advancing on the survivors.
wiki.cited-events.you-scan-the-area-afte: You scan the area after arriving at this system. A Lanius ship is in fast pursuit of an unarmed civilian ship. It's hard to say if it's truly a threat since its weapons are not charging.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-the-loca: You arrive at the location of a recent battle. Judging from the debris, some settlers attempted to fight off a number of small Lanius ships, although it's impossible to say who instigated the aggression. A few skirmishes can be seen in the distance, but more notably a lone Lanius ship is firing on a heavily damaged civilian vessel.
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-sing: You come across a single Lanius ship salvaging a small civilian craft. You cannot tell if they attacked the craft or just happened upon it.
wiki.cited-events.there-are-remnants-of-: There are remnants of a fierce battle here. Scattered among the hulks are small Lanius craft, slowly breaking apart the wrecks. One of the ships is close enough that you could probably attack it without immediately alerting the others.
wiki.cited-events.when-you-arrive-at-the: When you arrive at the beacon you discover what must have been remnants of a large battle. However the vast majority of metal has been striped from the ships, only various plastic and other materials float in a ring around a planet. A lone Lanius ship moves between the wreckage looking for more salvage.
wiki.cited-events.a-small-asteroid-belt-: A small asteroid belt is near this jump beacon. It must be mineral-rich since a Lanius ship is docked on a large rock, slowly absorbing parts of it. You could probably get their attention pretty easily.
wiki.cited-events.a-lanius-ship-is-slowl: A Lanius ship is slowly salvaging what remains of a small research station. It's hard to say if it was abandoned or attacked by the Lanius.
wiki.cited-events.you-find-a-mercenary-f: You find a mercenary for hire at this Beacon. Their unique skills can sometimes prove to be useful.
wiki.cited-events.a-mercenary-hails-you-: A mercenary hails you: "Greetings, friend! We've heard tell of your quest and are here to offer our valuable services."
wiki.cited-events.there-s-a-ship-with-pi: There's a ship with pirate markings orbiting the nearby planet. You receive his hail: "Anything is possible, for the right price"
wiki.cited-events.the-captain-of-this-sh: The captain of this ship claims he can provide "services" as long as you've got the scrap.
wiki.cited-events.mercenaries-are-swarmi: Mercenaries are swarming the galaxy now, knowing that their less-than-legal services are in demand during this period of unrest. One is waiting at this beacon and hails you.
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-hails-you-good-: A ship hails you: "Good sir! It seems you're having some troubles with the Rebels. I'd like to help you, but I can't afford the upkeep required on this hunk of junk I'm flying... maybe we can come to an arrangement?"
wiki.cited-events.you-stumble-across-a-r: You stumble across a Rebel ship distributing supplies to local civilian colonies. It's probably not anything military grade, but every little bit helps...
wiki.cited-events.you-find-a-rebel-comba: You find a Rebel combat ship that has been reassigned as an emergency supply vessel. The local civilians are apparently in need of help, and the Rebels are rising to the occasion.
wiki.cited-events.the-rebels-in-this-sys: The Rebels in this system are doing supply runs for the local space stations. These civilians have likely been out of supply for months due to the war and are in desperate need.
wiki.cited-events.civilian-colonists-loy: Civilian colonists loyal to the Rebel cause are present on a nearby planet. It looks like they are currently receiving a supply shipment. Could be useful.
wiki.cited-events.because-of-the-war-tho: Because of the war, thousands of colonists have had their supply lines disrupted and have found themselves in dire straits. It seems in this system, the Rebels are sympathetic and are distributing what little supplies they can spare.
wiki.cited-events.upon-arriving-at-this-: Upon arriving at this beacon, you detect a distress call. Local scans reveal that a Federation transport is under attack from a Rebel scout!
wiki.cited-events.you-immediately-notice: You immediately notice a Rebel ship chasing what appears to be a civilian transport. However you are detecting chatter on an encrypted Federation channel... That transport is carrying Federation loyalists!
wiki.cited-events.your-sensors-are-picki: Your sensors are picking up a distress call on an encrypted Federation channel. You eventually find a Federation scout being chased by a Rebel fighter!
wiki.cited-events.you-come-across-a-pira: You come across a pirate in hot pursuit of an unidentified ship. You quickly receive a transmission from the pirate: "Stay out of this fight and we'll make it worth your while."
wiki.cited-events.an-unidentified-ship-i: An unidentified ship is badly damaged and still being assaulted by a space pirate. The victim begins a distress message until the pirate cuts in and offers to split the bounty if you sit tight.
wiki.cited-events.a-missile-shoots-acros: A missile shoots across your bow when the jump completes. Your scans quickly reveal a ship with pirate markings pursuing an unknown vessel. The pirate hails you: "Damn it, we weren't expecting company. Stay out of this and you could profit."
wiki.cited-events.your-sensors-are-no-ma: Your sensors are no match for the Slug's telepathic abilities - a ship you never even saw opens fire from astern!
wiki.cited-events.the-slug-vessel-you-en: The Slug vessel you encounter here has obviously made a big score and is looking to test its new armaments. They picked the wrong ship to attack.
wiki.cited-events.a-slug-passenger-ship-: A Slug passenger ship hails: "Please, your worthy alien highnessesss, we are unarmed and sseeking asssylum." You approach cautiously, and weapons immediately spring from their hull!
wiki.cited-events.a-slug-ship-a-rogue-yo: A Slug ship - a rogue, you suspect - approaches, but when he sees you're Federation he thinks better of the sneak attack and fires everything he has.
wiki.cited-events.direct-attacks-are-not: Direct attacks are not preferred by the Slugs, but of the three you see at this beacon, one has the brass to make a move on your position!
wiki.cited-events.after-a-short-time-you: After a short time you receive a message, "Hello. I hope it's not a bother, but I'm looking for an escort to a nearby system. This region is quite dangerous and our ship is not well-armed."
wiki.cited-events.there-is-a-single-ship: There is a single ship at this beacon. They hail you, "We could really use some help. Our FTL navigation system is shot. Can you help us get to a nearby station where they can patch us up?"
wiki.cited-events.hello-your-communicato: "Hello," your communicator opens a hail from a nearby ship. "Our weapon systems are malfunctioning and we're too afraid of pirates to travel home unassisted. Can you escort us?"
wiki.cited-events.a-nearby-space-station: A nearby space station hails you. "Greetings! Your arrival is most fortuitous. We recently came across some extra drones. If you have some fuel, perhaps we can make a deal?"
wiki.cited-events.a-strange-vessel-appro: A strange vessel approaches. A digital message appears on your view-screen: "This is an automated merchant. Refill this vessel with fuel and it will supply you with drones."
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-in-the-sect: You arrive in the sector and are greeted by a science vessel waiting by the beacon. They hail you, "We find ourselves low on fuel and have a proposition."
wiki.cited-events.unusual-solar-activity: Unusual solar activity in this region means you need to get out, quick. The Rock pirate nearby apparently thinks otherwise as they move to attack your ship.
wiki.cited-events.a-rock-ship-is-silhoue: A Rock ship is silhouetted against a sun in supernova. They hail: "Even out here you follow us! We only wish to be left alone!" Out of panic or anger, they charge their weapons.
wiki.cited-events.minute-fissures-in-the: Minute fissures in the shields spark and crackle as the ship jumps into the wake of a huge asteroid. More asteroids follow, as does a lost and aggressive Rock pirate ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-exit-the-jump-surr: You exit the jump surrounded by dirt and rocks. Before long a blast is deflected by your shield, but that was no asteroid... Incoming pirate!
wiki.cited-events.a-rock-mining-vessel-i: A Rock mining vessel is harvesting the mineral-rich asteroids in this locality, and their scouts take your presence to be a transgression. Battle stations!
wiki.cited-events.a-rookie-rock-cargo-sh: A rookie Rock cargo ship has taken its orders too literally and took the most direct route to their destination... right through an asteroid field. They're confused and fire wildly as you jump in.
wiki.cited-events.the-captain-of-a-rock-: The captain of a Rock freighter lost in the asteroid field hails you: "Our co-ordinates led us here, but only death greets us. What must be must be. Death to all." You power up the battle systems and wonder how long they've been stuck here.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-arrive-at-the-b: As you arrive at the beacon, a hostile ship immediately registers on your scanners. You didn't expect to see Rebels extending their reach into Slug territory. Charge the weapons!
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-into-empty-sp: You jump into empty space and are relieved to see your sensors blink back to life. However, you are less pleased to see them immediately register a rebel ship on an approach vector!
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-message-: You receive a message from a nearby ship, "Looks like our intelligence was correct! Sneaking through the clouds with the Slugs... No one can hide from the rebellion!"
wiki.cited-events.there-appears-to-be-a-: There appears to be a pirate ship nearby. Be on your guard; anyone trying to hunt in Slug territory is either formidable or deeply stupid, and in space, either can be dangerous.
wiki.cited-events.we-knew-anyone-foolish: "We knew anyone foolish enough to try and sneak through a Slug nebula would stick to open space. Yield your goods and we may let you live." You cut the transmission in lieu of a response.
wiki.cited-events.before-you-can-take-a-: Before you can take a moment's rest from the ever present nebulas in this sector, a pirate ship appears behind you and opens fire.
wiki.cited-events.an-upgraded-pirate-shi: An upgraded pirate ship sits among the remains of a number of Lanius ships. It hails you, "These punks think they can jus' waltz in here into our sector? Obnoxious, right? Well, I'm sure you know the routine, let's do this."
wiki.cited-events.the-pirate-ship-patrol: The pirate ship patrolling this sector has been busy. The debris of several Rebel scouts and at least one civilian ship litter the area. "Welcome, welcome, there's room for one more!" The over-confident pirate hails you as he charges his weapons and moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.a-pirate-ship-appears-: A pirate ship appears to be threatening a small refugee ship near the beacon. Upon seeing you jump in, it turns to approach. The civilian wastes no time and jumps away, but that appears only to harden the pirate's resolve.
wiki.cited-events.debris-from-a-number-o: Debris from a number of battleships are scattered around the beacon. As you approach the area a pirate ship thrusts itself through the hulks to attack. It must be using the metal to lure the Lanius into a trap.
wiki.cited-events.the-pirate-sees-you-be: The pirate sees you before you see him... prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-events.emergency-all-ships-in: "Emergency, all ships in range, we are under attack!" The frequency matches a nearby Zoltan ship; you move in on their pursuer. They take your intervention as a cue to jump away. Cowards.
wiki.cited-events.you-jump-just-in-time-: You jump just in time to witness a Zoltan ship's FTL drive overload. In their final moments they implore you not to get involved, but it's too late - their attacker is already upon you!
wiki.cited-events.despite-their-precauti: Despite their precautions, pirates have begun to harass the local Zoltan settlements across this sector. One such pirate spots your ship and moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.a-ship-with-pirate-mar: A ship with pirate markings demand that you surrender. These are sad times when even Zoltan space is beset by pirates. You doubt these fools will be missed.
wiki.cited-events.you-spot-a-pirate-ship: You spot a pirate ship looting a small Zoltan cruiser. They spot you and move in to attack before your FTL drive has a chance to recharge.
wiki.cited-events.as-a-naturally-warlike: As a naturally warlike species with few inter-galactic diplomatic ties, the Rock people have garnered quite a reputation as fearsome pirates. You stumble across one of their ships and they promptly live up to type.
wiki.cited-events.a-rock-ship-flies-past: A Rock ship flies past your windows and you recognize outcast decorations on the hull. These must be pirates!
wiki.cited-events.a-motley-collection-of: A motley collection of Rock ships are stationed around this beacon - they look to have resorted to a pirate's life. Defensive maneuvers!
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-captain-appear: A Rebel captain appears on the screen. "I thought we had been doomed to backwater assignments. This is my chance to get back in Command's good graces! Charge the weapons!"
wiki.cited-events.a-small-rebel-research: A small rebel research station overlooks a pulsating star. Before you can react a Rebel ship spots you and moves in to attack.
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-at-an-infre: You arrive at an infrequently used beacon close to a pulsar. Before long a Rebel ship happens to jump nearby. Looks like you'll have to fight.
wiki.cited-events.your-ship-is-hailed-we: Your ship is hailed. "We've found you at last. Prepare to die!"
wiki.cited-events.a-small-rebel-ship-is-: A small Rebel ship is docked at a small station. You try to lay low but it spots you. Power up the weapons!
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-has-been-: A Rebel ship has been patrolling this region. As soon as you arrive it begins its assault.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-hails-you: A Rebel ship hails you: "Federation scum! We've waited a long time for this!"
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-transmis: You receive a transmission: "Sorry sir, this is nothing personal but we're under orders." The Rebel ship's weapons go hot.
wiki.cited-events.by-the-time-you-notice: By the time you notice the Rebel ship behind the beacon, it's too late to avoid a fight.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-hails-we-: A Rebel ship hails. "We did not fight a war to let a single Federation ship shatter our dreams of a better galaxy!" He locks weapons.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-approache: A Rebel ship approaches cautiously. "Personally," says the captain, "I'd have stuck with the Federation. But I'm a soldier, sir, and I'm no use without a war to fight. Raise your shields!"
wiki.cited-events.you-re-hailed-by-a-reb: You're hailed by a Rebel ship: "When the rebellion is complete you'll see the safer world we provide. Well, you won't, but you get the point." They arm weapons.
wiki.cited-events.a-rebel-ship-is-guardi: A Rebel ship is guarding this beacon. You order a pursuit course and prepare to scratch up one more.
wiki.cited-events.a-number-of-large-tran: A number of large transports are being pursued by a Rebel bombing squadron. One bomber has managed to slip through the defensive fire, and is poised to wreak among the enormous yet vulnerable transports. There's time for you to advance and take it out!
wiki.cited-events.shots-fly-by-your-port: Shots fly by your port windows followed by a Rebel scout in pursuit of a damaged cruiser. Should we move in to engage?
wiki.cited-events.there-seems-to-be-a-sm: There seems to be a small Federation colony under attack by a Rebel forward scout. Will you protect them?
wiki.cited-events.a-battle-rages-nearby-: A battle rages nearby between small fighters; apparently fighting over a space station. The Federation appears to be losing ships fast. Shall we assist them?
wiki.cited-events.a-civilian-ship-is-bro: A civilian ship is broadcasting a request for assistance on a secure Federation channel. They are being harassed by Rebel scouts. Will you respond?
wiki.cited-events.fly-behind-a-moon-and-: Fly behind a moon and stay hidden.
wiki.cited-events.shut-down-all-non-vita: Shut down all non-vital systems and stay hidden.
wiki.cited-events.stay-quiet-and-hope-th: Stay quiet and hope they don't notice you.
wiki.cited-events.stay-out-of-their-way-: Stay out of their way and charge your FTL drive.
wiki.cited-events.as-you-drift-closer-yo: As you drift closer, you are contacted by a Slug marooned on the moon's surface. "I shall join your crew, sssay I, if you can answer me this simple quesssstion. How many moons are there in orbit here?"
wiki.cited-events.that-isss-correct-you-: "That isss... correct. You sssurprise me. Human, is it? Yesss... we can be partners." The Slug beams aboard and joins your crew!
wiki.cited-events.that-issss-incorrect-f: "That issss... incorrect." Further, I have taken advantage of your lack of acuity to beam aboard your ship and steal your stuff!
wiki.cited-events.you-arrive-near-the-di:
You arrive near the distress beacon's signal.

You track the distress beacon with difficulty to one of the {{slugMoonWord}} moons of a planet hidden in the nebula.
wiki.cited-events.there-is-no-room-aboar: There is no room aboard for the new crewmember.
wiki.cited-events.something-strikes-you-: Something strikes you as odd about a moon in the distance.
wiki.cited-events.it-looks-as-if-a-team: It looks as if a team could break through the fragile layer of the moon's surface into a hidden cavern.
wiki.cited-events.sending-a-shuttle-to-e: Sending a shuttle to explore a beckoning cave system you discover signs of a battle - and a still-functioning weapon!
wiki.cited-events.a-deep-scan-of-the-sur: A deep scan of the surface reveals a cave system that runs for miles, and what looks like a scrap heap left over from some heavy-duty construction.
wiki.cited-events.a-closer-inspection-re: A closer inspection reveals signs of habitation on the surface, but nothing else particularly interesting.
wiki.cited-events.you-try-not-to-fixate-: You try not to fixate on the moon in the aft scanner as you set the coordinates for the next jump.
wiki.cited-events.your-explosives-reveal: Your explosives reveal the 'cave' is actually a secret base, located in a network of bunkers just under the surface. Everyone inside is dead; Mantis clearly came through here recently. It looks like the Zoltan were researching advanced ship weaponry. You take one of the better examples back to your ship.
wiki.cited-events.a-portion-of-the-surfa: A portion of the surface layer is destroyed in an impressive display, revealing miles of caves. You don't have time to fully explore them, but you find some remains of an old subterranean base that could be useful.
wiki.cited-events.the-explosives-are-set: The explosives are set remotely, but the detonation achieves nothing. What a waste.
wiki.cited-events.initial-scans-indicate:
Initial scans indicate a network of caves not far underground. You launch a boarding drone and it breaks through the surface into the cavern below.

Your drone discovers a vast cave network and evidence of excavation. Buried deep below you find a Zoltan scientist, still hard at work. He tells you that all his colleagues are long dead. You decide not to ask questions and offer to let him join your crew.
wiki.cited-events.send-a-drone-to-probe-: Send a drone to probe the surface.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-weapon-w: You receive a weapon with low scrap.
You receive a weapon with a random amount of scrap.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-random-a: You receive a random amount of scrap.
wiki.cited-events.send-a-drone-to-distra: Send a drone to distract the automated ship.
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-stealthily-: Attempt to stealthily access the space station.
wiki.cited-events.use-your-stealth-to-ac: Use your stealth to access the space station.
wiki.cited-events.try-to-hack-the-statio: Try to hack the station to prevent an alert.
wiki.cited-events.hack-the-station-to-pr: Hack the station to prevent an alert.
wiki.cited-events.fire-a-warning-shot-fr: Fire a warning shot from your strongest weapon.
wiki.cited-events.have-your-slug-talk-th: Have your Slug talk them into letting you go.
wiki.cited-events.make-the-guards-believ: Make the guards believe they have already checked your crew today.
wiki.cited-events.have-your-navigation-s: Have your navigation software calculate and upload route instructions to their ship.
wiki.cited-events.have-your-rockman-pose: Have your Rockman pose as captain.
wiki.cited-events.offer-to-lead-them-out: Offer to lead them out of the nebula.
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-download-th: Attempt to download the ship's data stores.
wiki.cited-events.attempt-to-cloak-and-a: Attempt to cloak and access the cache.
wiki.cited-events.use-your-sensors-to-at: Use your sensors to attempt to access the data.
wiki.cited-events.beam-directly-onto-the: Beam directly onto the station to try to avoid detection.
wiki.cited-events.a-pirate-ship-arrives-: A pirate ship arrives shortly after you. Judging from the fact that it is attempting to avoid your ship, you assume that it's a smuggler trying to stay away from beacons.
wiki.cited-events.you-encounter-a-small-: You encounter a small craft with minimal propulsion; its Rock crew-member explains that the Rock home-world is run on lies and propaganda that keep the populace in check, and that they want no part of it.
wiki.cited-events.tell-them-their-god-se: Tell them their god sent them here to join your crew.
wiki.cited-events.promise-to-share-with-: Promise to share with them the truths they've been denied.
wiki.cited-events.show-them-to-your-data: Show them to your data suite.
wiki.cited-events.fend-for-yourself-atta: Fend for yourself, attack, and escape.
wiki.cited-events.bribe-the-rebels-to-re: Bribe the Rebels to release the civilian ships. [{{cost}} scrap]
wiki.cited-events.a-lanius-merchant-appe:
A Lanius merchant appears to have a significantly improved translator as you clearly understand their message. "Metal content more than sufficient. Does your ship care to exchange resources for our excess metal?"

{{laniusTraderOfferText}}
wiki.cited-events.decline-but-ask-about-: Decline but ask about their translation device.
wiki.cited-events.2-4-mantis-boarders-be: 2-4 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.2-4-human-boarders-bea: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.2-3-crystal-boarders-b: 2-3 crystal boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.2-3-rock-boarders-beam: 2-3 rock boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.3-5-human-boarders-bea: 3-5 human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.offer-to-have-your-cre: Offer to have your crewmember help.
wiki.cited-events.it-was-never-your-inte: It was never your intention to lead the Rebels here, and frankly you could do with the scrap. The Crystalline ship immediately jumps off to inform the Rebels, leaving you with a fleet to outrun!
wiki.cited-events.unable-to-interpret-it: Unable to interpret it themselves, the Crystalline Beings assume your data will mean something to the Rebels. It should see the pursuing fleet taking a leisurely cruise before they get back on track.
wiki.cited-events.they-take-one-look-at-: They take one look at your fake telemetry and realize what you've done. They apparently do not take being lied to well - they immediately attack
wiki.cited-events.your-distraction-buoy-: Your distraction buoy allows you to create a very convincing flight plan. They accept it as true and give you the scrap. The deception may not be the most honorable tactic but staying ahead of the fleet is your highest priority.
wiki.cited-events.you-apologize-for-the-: You apologize for the trouble you've brought them, but explain that you have no choice. They seem to understand, and break the comm link to set about preparing defenses.
wiki.cited-events.rebel-fleet-pursuit-is: Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled for 1 jump.
Rebel Fleet pursuit is delayed for 1 jump.
Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled for {{n}} {{v}}.
wiki.cited-events.no-effect-in-the-last-: No effect in The Last Stand.
wiki.cited-events.rebel-fleet-is-delayed: Rebel Fleet is delayed for {{n}} turns.
wiki.cited-events.you-prepare-to-secure-: You prepare to secure their cargo by force.
wiki.cited-events.you-power-up-your-weap: You power up your weapons, which quickly gets the attention of the ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-activate-your-impu: You activate your impulse engines and fly between the Mantis and their prey, weapons charging. You appear to have their full attention.
wiki.cited-events.no-species-deserves-a-: No species deserves a Mantis hunter on their back - time to make the galaxy a little safer. Engage!
wiki.cited-events.the-civilian-ship-hast: The civilian ship hastily retreats while you intercept the path of the ship and lock on weapons. It turns and prepares for a fight.
wiki.cited-events.the-ship-powers-up-and: The ship powers up and targets you.
wiki.cited-events.before-you-can-engage-: Before you can engage, the Crystalline ship scores a direct hit and obliterates the Rebel ship! They hail: "You, you are like these other aliens! You brought them here!" With that they turn their cannons on you!
wiki.cited-events.as-you-scan-the-vessel: As you scan the vessel, the scan frequencies awaken the Lanius from hibernation - and they're hungry for raw materials!
wiki.cited-events.you-chase-down-the-pir: You chase down the pirate before it has a chance to engage the civilian ship. When it detects the real threat, it turns to face you.
wiki.cited-events.you-asked-for-it-they-: "You asked for it!" They pull away from the planet and move in to engage.
wiki.cited-events.you-power-up-your-weap: You power up your weapons and move in to engage.
wiki.cited-events.there-is-a-screech-fro: There is a screech from your comm system, and the broadcast suddenly cuts off. The platform suddenly begins to move, revealing itself to be a Lanius ship!
wiki.cited-events.the-slug-feigns-offens: The Slug feigns offense at your refusal, but you sense that he respects your caution. This does not, however, prevent him from returning to his ship and opening fire.
wiki.cited-events.the-local-people-furry: The local people - furry, one-eyed tree lizard things - begin chanting when they see you. Suddenly the sky is lit by laser fire - the Zoltan opened fire on your ship! You dash back to the shuttle and join the fight.
wiki.cited-events.these-creatures-should: These creatures should be left to develop at their own pace. You direct all weapons on the Rebel ship and begin the firing sequence.
wiki.cited-events.you-message-the-crysta: You message the Crystalline ship your intentions and move in to intercept the Rebel ship.
wiki.cited-events.you-move-in-to-interce: You move in to intercept the Crystalline ship. As soon as the Rebel scans your ship it takes the opportunity to jump. You have the sneaking suspicion they will inform the fleet of your position, but that's the least of your current concerns.
wiki.cited-events.your-hacking-system-au: Your hacking system automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.
wiki.cited-events.warning-lights-flash-a: Warning lights flash as scans identify the gigantic ship under construction - it's a second Rebel Flagship! This must be the secret shipyards where the first one was built, and you've accidentally stumbled across it! Even in its weakened state, the Rebel ship powers up... get ready, you've got a hell of a fight on your hands!
wiki.cited-events.human-boarders-beam-ab: human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.slug-boarders-beam-abo: slug boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.cited-events.the-mercenary-ship-mas: The mercenary ship masks its jump signature to mimic your own and then jumps off in the opposite direction. This should keep the Rebels guessing.
wiki.cited-events.rebel-fleet-is-delayed: Rebel Fleet is delayed for 2 turns.
wiki.cited-events.you-send-over-some-sup: You send over some supplies to help them on their way and in return they upload their flight plan to your computer, allowing you to map the sector! "The Federation fleet's still standing - get there while you can!"
wiki.cited-events.the-current-sector-map: The current sector map is revealed.
wiki.cited-events.the-pirate-watches-as-: The pirate watches as you start to light the meager crops on fire. In a few moments the settlement surrenders, offering tribute to leave them alone. The pirate seems impressed.

The pirate watches as you teleport an incendiary explosive into their settlement. As the settlers scramble to put out the fires, their rudimentary planetary defenses power down. Forcing their surrender was almost laughably easy, but the pirate seems impressed with your tactics and agrees to share the settlement's 'tribute'.
wiki.cited-events.you-receive-a-drone-sc: You receive a drone schematic with high scrap.
wiki.cited-fuel.rebel-fleet-pursuit-is-d: Rebel Fleet pursuit is delayed for 1 jump
wiki.cited-fuel.another-out-of-fuel-even: Another out of fuel event occurs.
wiki.cited-fuel.while-it-doesn-t-have-mu: While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, it recognizes you are part of the Federation and offers to split its remaining fuel with you.
wiki.cited-fuel.no-ship-is-in-scanning-r: No ship is in scanning range and no one arrives at the beacon.
wiki.cited-fuel.your-waiting-yields-noth: Your waiting yields nothing while the fleet surely gets closer...
wiki.cited-fuel.a-freighter-suddenly-arr: A freighter suddenly arrives nearby. They are so close you can almost wave at them, but your hails are ignored and the ship quickly jumps away.
wiki.cited-fuel.small-traffic-passes-wit: Small traffic passes within a short distance of you, but no one responds to your hails.
wiki.cited-fuel.the-only-ship-within-hai: The only ship within hailing range appears to be a civilian vessel. However, it quickly leaves once it picks up your signal.
wiki.cited-fuel.as-you-wait-a-small-aste: As you wait, a small asteroid storm pelts softly against your shields and hull.

wiki.enemies-rebel.ordinary-rebel-ships-: Ordinary rebel ships are only crewed by humans. This is not true for pirated ships, which can have other races.
wiki.enemies-rebel.rebel-ships-are-likel: Rebel ships are likely to offer a surrender and/or run away after taking damage that exceeds half of their hull.
wiki.enemies-rebel.in-the-rebel-ship-war: In the Rebel ship warning event they start charging their FTL drive and double the Rebel Fleet's pursuit if they jump. It takes 40 seconds to escape, regardless of engine level. Destroying piloting or engines, or making the pilot leave the room, delays the escape.
wiki.enemies-rebel.automated-ships-are-u: Automated ships are unmanned. They have no oxygen, and they automatically repair systems over time at 1/3 the speed of a human. They cannot repair hull breaches, and as a consequence can never repair a breached system.
wiki.enemies-rebel.despite-having-no-cre: Despite having no crew, automated ships get manning bonuses for all their systems. Unlike crewed ships, these bonuses cannot be removed by boarding, passive hacking, ion damage, fires, and breaches by boarding drones. Only damaging the system removes the manning bonus.
wiki.enemies-rebel.fires-one-is-enough-s: Fires (one is enough) stop and reset the repairs in damaged systems.
wiki.enemies-rebel.because-automated-shi: Because automated ships belong to the Rebels, they may double the fleet pursuit if they escape before you jump in certain events. Automated ships will never begin fleeing mid-battle, and they also never surrender.
wiki.enemies-rebel.rebel-riggers-and-dis: Rebel Riggers and Disruptors are two of the most dangerous enemies in the game, especially because they appear in sector 1. They can have up to four drones, although the maximum number of drones is limited by sector progression.
wiki.enemies-rebel.rebel-elites-are-a-sp: Rebel Elites are a special class of ship that almost exclusively appears at beacons overtaken by the Rebel Fleet. They are much stronger than other enemies in the sector. Elites in sector 1 have a minimum of two shields and four or five weapons power, whereas all other enemies have a maximum of one shield and three weapons power. In sector 7 and 8, Elites can have up to 10 power in weapons.

wiki.filler-events.your-jump-leads-you-t: Your jump leads you to nothing but empty space. This Jump Beacon serves no purpose other than as a connection.
wiki.filler-events.you-jump-into-an-unre: You jump into an unremarkable system. No life signs detected within scanning range.
wiki.filler-events.your-scans-reveal-a-m: Your scans reveal a mining base on a nearby planet long since abandoned. No life signs detected.
wiki.filler-events.your-scans-reveal-an-: Your scans reveal an ore refinery and several factories, all standing still and empty. No life signs detected.
wiki.filler-events.you-discover-a-nearby: You discover a nearby planet speckled with settlements, although none respond to your hails.
wiki.filler-events.this-beacon-has-been-: This beacon has been built for a nearby civilian space-station. No one hails your ship.
wiki.filler-events.the-nearby-planet-sho: The nearby planet shows sign of habitation and great beauty. A rudimentary automated planetary defense system is looping its message into space: "Warning! Quarantine Level 5 in effect under FHA Act 22, article 11.2. Warning! Quarantine Level 5..."
wiki.filler-events.your-jump-leads-to-a-: Your jump leads to a completely unremarkable binary star system. There is nothing else around.
Your jump leads to a remarkable binary star system. The view is beautiful, but there is nothing else around.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive: As soon as you arrive, all of the ships docked at a nearby station scatter and jump away, while the station itself uses some form of cloak technology to disappear. They mustn't like outsiders here...
wiki.filler-events.no-ships-are-in-range: No ships are in range, so you take the time to scan the area. It seems like every planet you've seen so far shows signs of highly developed habitation without overpopulation. They must have a very structured and well regulated society.
wiki.filler-events.there-appears-to-be-n: There appears to be no one living near this node, a rare sight in this highly developed sector.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-near-a-civ: You arrive near a civilian settlement. It looks like their homes, ships and stations all rely heavily on an intriguing crystalline material. You wonder how they are able to create so much of this substance, as yet undiscovered in the rest of the galaxy.
wiki.filler-events.a-few-merchant-ships-: A few merchant ships pass nearby but they are either ignoring your hails or their computer isn't designed to work through the same frequencies...
wiki.filler-events.a-number-of-civilian-: A number of civilian ships seem to be evacuating a small colony. One ship messages you before jumping away, "Damn you aliens! This is why we closed that Long-range Beacon in the first place!"
wiki.filler-events.the-complex-arrangeme: The complex arrangements of ship hulls and FTL drive capacitors floating abandoned in space suggest the Engi were here not too long ago; but no longer.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-at-a-green: You arrive at a green planet with great plains and rolling waterfalls. It would be of little interest to the Engi nearby.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-arrived-near: You have arrived near an Engi construction yard. Most Engi maintain their bi-pedal appearance out of habit but here you see a number of Engi hives working together to create massive organic machines adept at building ships. Truly a sight to behold.
wiki.filler-events.even-though-each-indi: Even though each "individual" Engi is made up of trillions of nano-machines, their culture still revolves around traditional social interactions. A nearby station seems to be constructed for entertainment of passing Engi travellers.
wiki.filler-events.you-see-a-number-of-e: You see a number of Engi space stations and fleets nearby. Despite looking like piles of junk loosely tied together they are actually a model of efficiency. They just lack a certain aesthetic emphasis in their constructions.
wiki.filler-events.this-system-appears-q: This system appears quite peaceful. You're not sure how long it'll last between the combined threats of the Rebels and Mantis.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-a-number-of: There are a number of merchant ships passing through the area despite the threat of Mantis invasion. No doubt interested in buying the efficient technology of the Engi.
wiki.filler-events.you-see-a-small-rebel: You see a small Rebel carrier in the distance. You lay low and try to blend in with the other traffic. However it's surprising to see a Rebel military ship alone deep in Engi space.
wiki.filler-events.the-engi-seem-to-have: The Engi seem to have avoided this particular node, along with every other life-form. You keep your eyes peeled for reasons why, but spin up the FTL without event.
wiki.filler-events.a-cluster-of-engi-sat: A cluster of Engi satellites in orbit of a nearby planet are the only clue the mechanical species was ever here. You have other places to be.
wiki.filler-events.the-charts-indicate-t: The charts indicate this was the location of a small skirmish over a military facility on a nearby moon. Oddly, scans pick up no signs of debris from either the battle or the station. Yet another area sucked dry by the Lanius.
wiki.filler-events.scans-show-no-signs-o: Scans show no signs of any ships or settlements nearby. You have no way of knowing if the area was always uninhabited or if it was simply erased by the Lanius.
wiki.filler-events.a-few-refugee-ships-a: A few refugee ships are preparing for the long journey to another sector. They explain how a number of Lanius military ships surrounded them and began to hack their FTL drives. Fortunately the Lanius moved on after briefly scanning the civilian ships, leaving them more than a little shaken up.
wiki.filler-events.you-pass-a-civilian-s: You pass a civilian ship that warns of the nearby Lanius. "One of them attacked a civilian transport and started to melt their fracking hull. But then the weirdest thing happened... another metal ship actually fired on its companion until it backed off." Apparently there are disagreements among the Lanius about what should be salvaged.
wiki.filler-events.you-question-a-local-: You question a local settlement and they describe a fleet of metal ships wordlessly collecting all of the abandoned metal and debris in the area. When they approached important satellites, the settlements fired a few ASB warning shots. The Lanius moved on despite clearly having the firepower to overwhelm the settlements.
wiki.filler-events.you-come-across-a-hum: You come across a human civilian ship preparing to leave the sector. They message you, "We're getting out of here! There was some cult rambling about the spreading of the disease, Humanitis. They forcefully boarded our ship and tried to open all of our airlocks, shouting, "Be purged!" Is nowhere safe anymore?"
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-to-see-a-n: You arrive to see a number of Federation forward-carriers and dreadnoughts. This must be a system of high importance to warrant such a fleet.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-a-few-feder: There are a few Federation fleets in the nearby area as well as a lot of wreckage. There must have been minor skirmishes in the area.
wiki.filler-events.a-few-scattered-heavy: A few scattered heavy vessels are left to defend the nearby Federation settlement. They seem to be in the process of evacuation.
wiki.filler-events.a-large-host-of-feder: A large host of Federation heavy vessels are in formation around the beacon. Sensors run hot with missile locks, but once you transmit your ship signature they leave you alone.
wiki.filler-events.a-battalion-of-federa: A battalion of Federation fighters are fighting around a nearby moon with their carriers waiting in the distance. They must have encountered a Rebel scout squadron.
wiki.filler-events.at-this-point-you-alm: At this point you almost expect a fight with the Mantis, but this beacon appears to be entirely devoid of other ships. You take the time to catch your breath and double check the ship's systems.
wiki.filler-events.the-only-thing-this-b: The only thing this beacon offers is a view of deep space and a brief respite from battles. For some this must be a welcome refuge.
wiki.filler-events.a-nearby-mantis-minin: A nearby Mantis mining operation is clearly using heavy Engi slave labor. You briefly consider the possibility of emancipating the slaves, but the Mantis presence is too formidable. You decide to lay low.
wiki.filler-events.there-aren-t-so-many-: There aren't so many parts of Mantis space that aren't dotted by the wrecks of battles past, but this is one of them. You take a deep breath and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.there-s-nothing-here-: There's nothing here but space debris and some uninhabitable planetoids.
wiki.filler-events.you-fancy-you-see-som: You fancy you see something moving in the shadow of the beacon, but all remains still.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive: As soon as you arrive, a small ship de-cloaks behind yours. You immediately power up the shields and weapons, but they continue on their trajectory unimpressed. You try to calm your nerves.
wiki.filler-events.a-small-pirate-ship-m: A small pirate ship messages you, "That sure is a shiny ship you got there." You fire a warning shot across their bow and they respond, "Hey! No need for violence! It was just a comment..."
wiki.filler-events.the-only-thing-within: The only thing within scanning range is an old abandoned mining structure and a resupply station. They appear to have been picked clean by marauders.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-to-have-a-: You arrive to have a small fleet of Engi ships target you with a message, "Piracy results in negative societal impact. Not permitted." You assure them of your honest intentions and they allow you to pass.
wiki.filler-events.you-enter-a-system-bu: You enter a system bustling with Rebel activity. Supply freighters and re-supply stations are dwarfed by a few heavy warships. Luckily, no one seems to be paying attention to small cruisers. No ships are scanning or messaging you.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-near-a-sma: You arrive near a small Rebel refueling depot. Your ship is being scanned multiple times so they must recognize you, but there appears to be no combat-ready ships in the vicinity. The only message you receive is a denial to your request to dock at the depot.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-not-much-of-: There is not much of interest nearby. A small sun in the distance with a few orbiting planets in nearby space provide little of interest.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-no-other-sh: There are no other ships near this beacon, however you detect a small communication relay. You tap into it without a problem; there is no encryption. Most of the chatter revolves around troop and fleet movements, not particularly interesting.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-a-small-plan: There is a small planet nearby with scattered settlements. A small Rebel fleet is in orbit with many ships ferrying back and forth. It must be a more recently 'liberated' planet.
wiki.filler-events.you-receive-a-message: You receive a message meant to degrade you as aliens. You half expect an attack but it seems to have come from a small civilian shuttle.
wiki.filler-events.no-one-bothers-your-s: No one bothers your ship as you float among numerous space stations and mining platforms. The Rock certainly run efficient operations.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-and-detect: You arrive and detect signs of battle. A few ships are taking passes at each other near a small station. You don't know if it's a territory issue, a contest or a rite of passage but you decide it's best to stay out of it.
wiki.filler-events.there-s-not-much-at-t: There's not much at this beacon. Just a few abandoned depots, stripped clean.
wiki.filler-events.a-few-freighters-pass: A few freighters pass by but they refuse all communications. Must not want to sully their reputation by talking with foreigners.
wiki.filler-events.you-see-a-small-tradi: You see a small trading post and ask about refuelling but they respond, "Go away! We don't serve your kind here."
wiki.filler-events.you-see-a-zoltan-merc: You see a Zoltan merchant and ask about his wares. He responds, "Sorry, but it took years to gain their trust. I can't be seen communicating with you. I hope you understand." He cuts communications.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-at-the-bea: You arrive at the beacon and are relieved at the sight of open space. Nebulas are terribly claustrophobic.
wiki.filler-events.this-beacon-marks-a-s: This beacon marks a 'small' gap in the nebula. No colonies or ships in scanning distance.
wiki.filler-events.you-are-relieved-to-s: You are relieved to see your sensors blink back on after the jump. No ships detected.
wiki.filler-events.the-slugs-rely-heavil: The Slugs rely heavily on their telepathic powers and are reluctant to give up that advantage by extending beyond nebulas. It's unlikely you'll encounter any this far from the clouds.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-in-an-area: You arrive in an area clear of nebula and quickly check to see if the sensors are working. Everything is fine and no ships are detected in the vicinity.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-some-minera: There are some mineral-rich asteroids here that the Zoltan have left idle, but you've none of the necessary equipment to mine them.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-to-admit-zol: You have to admit - Zoltan space is a beautiful and peaceful place indeed. However, re-engaging the FTL and finishing your mission is your priority, not sight-seeing.
wiki.filler-events.a-light-asteroid-fiel: A light asteroid field is entering the atmosphere of a nearby planet - a fireworks show on a galactic scale. There's little for it but to take in the ambience and program the next jump.
wiki.filler-events.you-stumble-upon-some: You stumble upon some Zoltan military vessels engaging in combat training. Their Energy Shields are impressive, but you note how quickly beam and ion weaponry take them down.
wiki.filler-events.you-don-t-have-time-t: You don't have time to hail the Zoltan ship that was waiting at this beacon before it jumps away. They are a careful race.
wiki.filler-events.a-zoltan-shipyard-is-: A Zoltan shipyard is stationed at this beacon. You admire the display of hundreds of glowing Zoltan performing delicate exterior work on a massive transport ship.
wiki.filler-events.a-message-broadcast-f: A message broadcast from a nearby planet announces the presence of an ancient Zoltan monastery available for visiting. Likely just a tourist trap, but still too bad you don't have the time to visit.
wiki.filler-events.you-can-t-see-anythin: You can't see anything through the thick gases surrounding your ship. Without knowing what is out there, all you can do is wait for your FTL to charge.
wiki.filler-events.without-active-sensor: Without active sensors you have no other option but to look out of the view-ports in apprehension. It's eerily quiet.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-wait-for-the-f: As you wait for the FTL drive to charge, you half expect to be ambushed at any moment. However, no attack comes...
wiki.filler-events.you-feel-naked-withou: You feel naked without functioning sensors. You half expect a Rebel ship to appear from behind a cloud at any moment, but none come.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-are-constan: Your crew are constantly looking out of the windows, checking for hostiles. They jump at every creak and moan of the ship. The tension is almost palpable...
wiki.filler-events.you-nervously-glance-: You nervously glance out the windows but the only thing to greet you is more clouds and silence.
wiki.filler-events.you-cycle-through-wid: You cycle through wide-band comm channels as soon as you arrive. Nothing but static.
wiki.filler-events.with-the-sensors-down: With the sensors down, you spend a good deal of time staring out the window. It is, you must admit, rather beautiful here.
wiki.filler-events.there-s-nothing-here-: There's nothing here, save for vast swirls of gas reflecting rays from a distant sun.
wiki.filler-events.when-it-comes-to-slug: When it comes to Slugs, no news is not necessarily good news. However, if they are watching, they don't seem to want to confront you.
wiki.filler-events.it-s-not-unusual-to-f: It's not unusual to feel paranoia in a Slug controlled nebula, but for once, it is unfounded.
wiki.filler-events.either-this-part-of-s: Either this part of Slug space is deserted, or it's too dense for even Slugs to detect your presence. Time to move.
wiki.filler-events.this-area-of-the-nebu: This area of the nebula seems entirely empty until a small Slug transport and its escorts emerges suddenly from through the clouds, only to disappear again in a matter of seconds.
wiki.filler-events.you-explore-around-th: You explore around the beacon and are shocked when a rock the size of a small moon suddenly looms ahead of you. Scans reveal the solid-looking rock is just a husk, almost entirely mined out of useful minerals.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-a-number-of: There are a number of small stations for travellers in the area, lit up by guiding lights and advertisements. Only Slug ships are docked so you decide it's better to avoid a confrontation and steer clear.
wiki.filler-events.scans-reveal-a-large-: Scans reveal a large asteroid field nearby. Short-range scanners may discover useful materials while we wait for the FTL to recharge.
wiki.filler-events.too-dangerous-we-ll-j: Too dangerous. We'll just wait for the FTL to charge.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-jumped-into-: You have jumped into the aftermath of what seems to have been a brutal exchange between several ships. Wreckage drifts by your screens, and you can still see the remains of the dying ships sparking and breaking apart. It's hard to determine who the combatants were without closer investigation.
wiki.filler-events.ignore-the-wreckage-a: Ignore the wreckage and continue on.
wiki.filler-events.use-your-sensors-to-s: Use your Sensors to scan the wreckage.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-near-a-dam: You arrive near a damaged and dilapidated space station. It appears to be abandoned but you detect faint life signatures on board.
wiki.filler-events.board-the-station-and: Board the station and look for survivors.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-at-a-beaco: You arrive at a beacon located in a civilian star system. A nearby colony contacts you: "We've got a rogue Rebel ship harassing this system. Do you have time to find it?"
wiki.filler-events.go-looking-for-the-re: Go looking for the Rebel ship.
wiki.filler-events.no-time-to-search-you: No time to search, you prepare to jump away.
wiki.filler-events.perform-a-scan-of-the: Perform a scan of the area.
wiki.filler-events.your-sensors-have-pic: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
wiki.filler-events.scanners-are-showing-: Scanners are showing intelligent life forms on a nearby planet. No match for them can be found in the database.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-small-spac: You find a small space station that appears to be abandoned.
wiki.filler-events.move-in-to-examine-th: Move in to examine the station.
wiki.filler-events.you-receive-a-hail-fr: You receive a hail from a station orbiting a nearby planet. "Captain, we are Federation Terraforming Team C12 and are in need of assistance. Do you have some time?"
wiki.filler-events.a-heavily-damaged-fed: A heavily damaged Federation ship is hiding in the nebula at this beacon. Before you have time to make contact with them, they fade into the nebula.
wiki.filler-events.attempt-to-follow-and: Attempt to follow and help them.
wiki.filler-events.keep-your-position-th: Keep your position, they can handle themselves.
wiki.filler-events.you-jump-into-the-mid: You jump into the middle of a plasma storm. Multiple recently incapacitated ships loom in the shadows, briefly illuminated by the lightning.
wiki.filler-events.manually-search-the-w: Manually search the wreckage for survivors and equipment.
wiki.filler-events.avoid-the-risk-and-wa: Avoid the risk and wait to jump away unscathed.
wiki.filler-events.greetings-it-is-so-go: "Greetings! It is so good to see you! We've been out of fuel and floating out here for weeks. We were terrified a pirate or those damn Rebels would find us first. Could you spare some fuel?"
wiki.filler-events.apologize-wish-them-l: Apologize, wish them luck, and continue on.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-encountered-: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.

You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board, and its communications seem to be down.
wiki.filler-events.you-pick-up-an-automa: You pick up an automated message from a nearby space station. There appears to be a local shipwright that can perform emergency work on military ships.
wiki.filler-events.a-ship-re-fueling-sta: A ship re-fueling station is stationed at this beacon. We can purchase fuel here.
wiki.filler-events.you-come-across-an-as: You come across an asteroid mining colony. They message you immediately, saying, "Greetings. Our supplies of mining explosives have run out ever since the Rebels blockaded this system. Do you have any extra explosives?"
wiki.filler-events.offer-to-solve-their-: Offer to solve their problem by launching a missile.
wiki.filler-events.you-receive-a-message: You receive a message from a small convoy. They're looking for some military supplies and are offering to try to improve your reactor in exchange.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-number-of-: You find a number of ships fleeing from a small space station. You hail them, asking what's wrong: "Help! We're being overrun by some sort of giant alien spiders!"
wiki.filler-events.send-the-crew-to-help: Send the crew to help! Giant alien spiders are no joke.
wiki.filler-events.a-crewmember-or-high-: A crewmember, or high resources with some scrap.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-battle-dron: Send your battle drone in to help.
wiki.filler-events.launch-a-boarding-dro: Launch a Boarding drone into the station.
wiki.filler-events.use-the-beam-to-pick-: Use the beam to pick off the spiders.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-at-the-dis: You arrive at the distress beacon near a small asteroid belt and find a ship with pirate markings partially crushed between two large rocks. It must have been illegally mining the belt without proper equipment.
wiki.filler-events.try-to-dislodge-the-s: Try to dislodge the ship by shooting at the rocks.
wiki.filler-events.2-hull-2-system-damag: 2 hull, 2 system damage, and low scrap, or medium scrap with resources.
wiki.filler-events.destroy-and-loot-the-: Destroy and loot the ship. They're just pirates.
wiki.filler-events.medium-scrap-with-res: Medium scrap with resources, or a Pirate ship.
wiki.filler-events.have-your-drone-cut-t: Have your drone cut the ship out.
wiki.filler-events.you-locate-a-nearby-h: You locate a nearby human mining colony where an unknown disease has spread virulently. They are setting up a quarantine to contain it but a riot has broken out.
wiki.filler-events.send-in-your-crew-to-: Send in your crew to help control the crowds.
wiki.filler-events.a-crewmember-and-medi: A crewmember and medium resources, or nothing.
wiki.filler-events.ignore-their-request-: Ignore their request and move on.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-rock-crew-m: Send your Rock crew-member to prevent a riot.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-engi-to-cal: Send your Engi to calm down the infected.
wiki.filler-events.use-your-medbay-to-he: Use your medbay to help synthesize a cure.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-the-source-o: You find the source of the distress call, a small research station. It appears a small laboratory fire got out of control and is threatening to destroy the station. Their fire suppression system is not responding.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-crew-in-a-s: Send your crew in a shuttle to help put out the fire.
wiki.filler-events.a-crewmember-and-low-: A crewmember and low scrap, or high scrap.
wiki.filler-events.dock-and-try-to-rescu: Dock and try to rescue the survivors.
wiki.filler-events.4-hull-1-system-damag: 4 hull, 1 system damage, and low scrap, or Dr. Jones and low scrap.
wiki.filler-events.high-scrap-and-a-rand: High scrap and a random augmentation.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-repair-dron: Send your repair drone into the fire.
wiki.filler-events.high-scrap-and-a-rand: High scrap and a random drone schematic.
wiki.filler-events.it-appears-the-distre: It appears the distress beacon is coming from the surface of a nearby moon. Your sensors are picking up a single life form.
wiki.filler-events.go-down-to-the-surfac: Go down to the surface to investigate.
wiki.filler-events.charlie-a-crewmember-: Charlie, a crewmember, 5 hull, or scrap and repairs.
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-at-the-bea: You arrive at the beacon and immediately detect a pirate ship. It seems this distress beacon was a trap!
wiki.filler-events.the-distress-signal-i: The distress signal is coming from a small space station orbiting an uninhabited planet. Their satellite defense system has gone haywire and their repair crew can't approach without being fired on. They're looking for help to fix or disable it.
wiki.filler-events.ion-cloaking-an-engi-: Ion, cloaking, an Engi, or low scrap. The 5 hull result stays unwired.
wiki.filler-events.this-beacon-seems-to-: This Beacon seems to serve as meeting place for local traffic. It seems you can find crew willing to fight on your ship here... for a price.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-a-number-of: There are a number of privately owned ship construction platforms in the area. You find one that has a slot open for some immediate work.
wiki.filler-events.you-receive-a-message: You receive a message from a small refugee convoy, "Hail. We'd like to help you on your mission but don't have much to offer. If you have extra metal perhaps we could work on your ship?"
wiki.filler-events.you-are-immediately-h: You are immediately hailed by a mobile docking platform upon arrival, "Welcome to Uncle Joe's Fix-it Shop! Need a tune-up? We got you covered!"
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-space-stat: You find a space station set up for travelers. Browsing through its listings, you find a tavern full of mercenaries for hire. You look for potential crewmembers.
wiki.filler-events.there-are-a-number-of: There are a number of ships stationed around a rest stop. You immediately receive a message saying, "If you're looking for some bodies to fill your ship, you've come to the right place!"
wiki.filler-events.they-offer-to-upgrade: They offer to upgrade your reactor in exchange for some scrap.
They offer to upgrade your Oxygen system in exchange for some scrap.
They offer to upgrade your Piloting subsystem in exchange for some scrap.
They offer to upgrade your Door subsystem in exchange for some scrap.
They offer to upgrade your Sensors subsystem in exchange for some scrap.
wiki.filler-events.you-open-your-eyes-an: You open your eyes and everything is still where it was a moment ago. You did it!
wiki.filler-events.the-weapon-detonates-: The weapon detonates. Everything goes dark, the bridge illuminated by flames pouring from the hull, your bomb disposal volunteer spinning off toward a nearby sun. You put out the fires and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.rebel-fleet-is-delaye: Rebel Fleet is delayed for 1 turn.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-no-room-aboa: There is no room aboard for the new crewmember.
wiki.filler-events.they-thank-you-and-of: They thank you and offer to have their engineers repair some of your ship's hull.
They thank you and offer to have their engineers upgrade your reactor.
wiki.filler-events.they-thank-you-for-yo: They thank you for your generosity and offer some scrap in exchange.
wiki.filler-events.wow-this-will-help-ou: "Wow. This will help our efforts considerably." They offer to have their engineers fix up your ship and upgrade your reactor.
"Wow. This will help our efforts considerably. What could I offer for your troubles..." After some time they deliver a ship Augment for installation on your ship.
"Wow. This will help our efforts considerably. Let me see what I can scrounge up to offer you." They deliver some scrap and have their team try to repair part of your hull.
wiki.filler-events.you-look-like-a-milit: "You look like a military vessel. We're trying to get back to our homes alive. I'm an engineer by trade and could try to improve your reactor if you have any extra supplies."
wiki.filler-events.simply-fire-on-the-de: Simply fire on the defense system from a distance.
wiki.filler-events.cloaking-use-your-clo: (Cloaking) Use your cloaking to disable the system.
wiki.filler-events.improved-cloaking-use: (Improved Cloaking) Use your cloaking to disable the system.
wiki.filler-events.advanced-cloaking-use: (Advanced Cloaking) Use your cloaking to disable the system.
wiki.filler-events.engi-crew-remotely-re: (Engi Crew) Remotely repair its targeting system.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-no-room-aboa: There is no room aboard for Charlie.
wiki.filler-events.bring-him-back-to-you: Bring him back to your ship in hopes of finding some help for him.
wiki.filler-events.leave-the-madman-to-h: Leave the madman to his ravings, he's not worth the risk.
wiki.filler-events.improved-medbay-bring: (Improved Medbay) Bring him to your medbay.
wiki.filler-events.advanced-medbay-bring: (Advanced Medbay) Bring him to your medbay.
wiki.filler-events.sir-allow-me-to-asses: Sir, allow me to assess his mental state.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-man-living: You find a man living alone in a cave. From the appearance of his wrecked ship, it seems he's been here for many years. He looks healthy, but his mental state is questionable.
wiki.filler-events.haha-i-knew-someone-w: "Haha! I knew someone would fall into our dastardly trap!" It appears this distress beacon was nothing but a decoy for a pirate ambush.
wiki.filler-events.your-cockpit-lights-u: Your cockpit lights up with warning signals. You are being targeted by a nearby ship. The distress call was a lure to attract unwitting ships into weapons range. You prepare for a fight.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive: As soon as you arrive at the distress signal, shots are fired toward your ship. A trap!
wiki.filler-events.you-arrive-to-find-wh: You arrive to find what appears to be a colonized moon, however scans show it has been abandoned. You also detect an abandoned space station near the Beacon.
wiki.filler-events.this-area-shows-signs: This area shows signs of a battle some time ago. There are scattered remains of ships but one station appears to be intact.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-you-arrive: As soon as you arrive, you receive a Federation encrypted message: "A Rebel ship has been terrorizing the local civilians in this system, please seek and destroy it."
wiki.filler-events.you-begin-charging-yo: You begin charging your FTL drive, and do a quick scan of a local planet. You find the ruins of a recently destroyed federation colony on the surface. There must be a Rebel ship in the vicinity...
wiki.filler-events.you-jump-into-a-field: You jump into a field of debris. It appears a battle recently took place here, and the loser seems to have been a civilian ship. A message was left on repeat before it was destroyed: "Rebels attacking, please send aid!" The responsible Rebels are likely still nearby.
wiki.filler-events.what-at-first-seems-t: What at first seems to be a simple nebula is actually filled with a good amount of debris from a brutal exchange between several ships. Wreckage drifts by your screens and tumbles into the depths of the nebula to be lost to sight. It's hard to determine who the combatants were without closer investigation.
wiki.filler-events.improved-medbay-quick: (Improved Medbay) Quickly bring him to the medbay.
wiki.filler-events.improved-clonebay-qui: (Improved Clonebay) Quickly register him into the clonebay.
wiki.filler-events.it-seems-he-was-in-wo: It seems he was in worse health than we first thought. He collapses on the trip up to the ship. It doesn't look like he's going to make it...
wiki.filler-events.use-the-nano-med-bots: Use the Nano med-bots to accelerate the dispersal of the cure.
wiki.filler-events.your-military-grade-m: Your military-grade medical computers are easily able to isolate the cause of the virus, a previously unknown spore that was unearthed during excavations. You are quickly able to inform the colony's leaders of your success in reverse engineering a cure.
wiki.filler-events.the-engines-cannot-ta: The engines cannot take the upgrade.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-no-room-aboa: There is no room aboard for Robert Smith.
