wiki.filler-events.send-a-shuttle-with-a: Send a shuttle with an away team to help.
wiki.filler-events.leave-them-a-cornered: Leave them, a cornered Mantis is too dangerous.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-human-crewm: Send your human crewmember to communicate with the Mantis.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-mantis-crew: Send your Mantis crewmember to communicate with the Mantis.
wiki.filler-events.use-your-mind-control: Use your Mind control system to calm him down.
wiki.filler-events.found-malfunctioning-: Found malfunctioning Mantis. Believes it is human. Will receive input only from human. Danger Evaluation: Extremely High. Provide assistance.
wiki.filler-events.the-colony-is-a-minin: The colony is a mining operation that specializes in FTL fuel. Robert's family, the head engineers, are excited to see him, and very grateful for his return. Apparently he ran away to 'join the Federation' like his older brother, but was never accepted onto a ship.
wiki.filler-events.offer-him-a-position-: Offer him a position on your ship.
wiki.filler-events.ask-if-they-can-take-: Ask if they can take a look at your engines.
wiki.filler-events.the-oxygen-system-can: The oxygen system cannot take the upgrade.
wiki.filler-events.after-a-complete-scan: After a complete scan of the planet, you find no life. The team is grateful and ready to get to work. The station scientists have a unique talent for life support units and offer to upgrade your oxygen system as thanks.
wiki.filler-events.a-complete-scan-of-th: A complete scan of the planet reveals no life signs other than a single ship on the surface. The terraformers thank you for your help, and attempt to contact the ship. Just as you're about to jump away, the ship takes off and attacks, it's a pirate!
A complete scan of the planet reveals a simple mold as the only life present. The terraformers claim their terraforming plans are only hindered by intelligent life; they can begin their work.
wiki.filler-events.tell-them-to-stop-any: Tell them to stop. Any life is valuable.
wiki.filler-events.the-vessel-is-relieve: The vessel is relieved to hear from you! They are running low on supplies. They suggest a trade.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-hail-the-refug: As you hail the refugee ship, a Zoltan ship suddenly jumps into the system... it claims the refugees are criminals, and accuses you of escorting fugitives! Before you can respond, it cuts communications, and powers up its weapons!
wiki.filler-events.the-refugee-ship-than: The refugee ship thanks you for your assistance. As a gesture of good will (and seeing how effectively you dispatched the enemy ship), they offer up what supplies they can spare.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-hail-the-refug: As you hail the refugee ship, a pirate ship jumps into the system... it was using the refugee ship as bait!
wiki.filler-events.the-refugee-ship-clai: The refugee ship claims pirates have been following their trail since they left their homeworld. As a gesture of good will (and seeing how effectively you dispatched the enemy ship), they offer up what supplies they can spare.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-hail-the-freig: As you hail the freighter, it advances, weapons bristling from its hull! It's a pirate ambush!
wiki.filler-events.as-you-hail-the-refug: As you hail the refugee ship, a Slug ship jumps into the system... it was hunting the refugee ship for sport and now they've found you instead!
wiki.filler-events.you-find-the-decaying: You find the decaying remains of some kind of ship coated with ice or crystal. You send some crew aboard to explore. Nearly everything is either destroyed or unidentifiable, but one of the weapons appears salvageable and there's a strange stasis pod that catches your eye. It looks like a massive asteroid is in a direct collision course with the derelict ship! You have to pull your crew out but they want to grab what they can first. What do they take?
wiki.filler-events.take-the-weapon-and-a: Take the weapon and any spare scrap.
wiki.filler-events.you-prepare-to-jump-a: You prepare to jump as soon as possible. You don't want to be around if they disable this beacon.
wiki.filler-events.you-make-preparations: You make preparations to jump but are surprised when the Lanius ship pulls away from the beacon towards you. It appears to be fully operational!
wiki.filler-events.scans-reveal-a-number: Scans reveal a number of asteroids with useful compositions. You extract some fuel.
wiki.filler-events.you-discover-the-rema: You discover the remains of ship embedded into an asteroid. It still has some functional missiles.
wiki.filler-events.you-happen-upon-an-ab: You happen upon an abandoned mining site. A few mining drones were left behind and could be repurposed.
wiki.filler-events.a-pirate-ship-hiding-: A pirate ship hiding behind one of the larger asteroids attacks you!
wiki.filler-events.the-asteroid-field-pr: The asteroid field proved more dangerous than expected. Some asteroids managed to get through your ship's defenses.
wiki.filler-events.a-brief-exploration-y: A brief exploration yields nothing of interest.
wiki.filler-events.you-carefully-extract: You carefully extract as much usable material as possible from the nearest asteroids while waiting for the FTL to charge.
wiki.filler-events.you-scan-the-battlefi: You scan the battlefield, and find little remains. Disappointed, you prepare to jump.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-the-w: As you approach the wreckage, a Slug ship makes its arrival. It hesitates for a moment, as if surprised to see anyone remaining, and then jumps away without a word. You resume scanning the system, wary of any other visitors.
wiki.filler-events.you-scan-the-battlefi: You scan the battlefield, and are able to salvage some useful material from the wreckage.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-the-w: As you approach the wreckage, a Mantis ship screams into the system... either sensing prey - or to finish the job its fellows started.
wiki.filler-events.the-wreckage-appears-: The wreckage appears to be a battle between Federation fighters and Rebel cruisers. Though outnumbered, it looks like the Federation fought valiantly. As you begin a more detailed scan of the wreckage, Rebel reinforcements arrive in the system and target your ship!
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-the-w: As you approach the wreckage, a Zoltan ship makes its arrival. It immediately mistakes you for one of the attackers, declares you as hostile aggressors in violation of Zoltan space, and opens fire!
wiki.filler-events.you-scan-the-battlefi: You scan the battlefield, and with the aid of your Sensors, you are able to salvage a moderate amount of material from the wreckage. You prepare to jump.
wiki.filler-events.all-around-you-is-the: All around you is the stench of death and decay. The life sign readings must have been malfunctioning because you really doubt anything could be alive in here. You quickly return to the ship.
wiki.filler-events.human-corpses-are-sca: Human corpses are scattered across the station. You find the source of the signal, a lone survivor that locked themselves in a storage closet. You quickly retreat with them in tow back to the ship, and hope they can recover enough to be of some use.
wiki.filler-events.all-around-you-is-the:
All around you is the stench of death and decay. Suddenly, one of your crew bends over and starts retching violently. Some sort of disease must have wiped out this station. You pull back to the ship, but it looks like your crew member is not going to make it.

Scrap: {{scrap}}.
wiki.filler-events.you-stop-your-crew-s-: You stop your crew's clone from forming, knowing that the disease would follow into his next life.
wiki.filler-events.your-crewmember-insis: Your crewmember insists you leave them behind, not wanting to endanger the rest of the crew. Knowing the truth of this, you hurry back to the ship.
wiki.filler-events.your-advanced-medical: Your advanced medical suite is able to isolate the cause of the problem and administer an antidote. That was a close one.
wiki.filler-events.while-waiting-for-the: While waiting for the FTL drive to charge, you skirt around the edge of the station and collect some scrap.
wiki.filler-events.after-a-short-search-: After a short search you find the Rebel ship. Let's hope he's as easy to defeat in combat as he was to find.
wiki.filler-events.rebel-fleet-pursuit-i: Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled for 1 jump.
wiki.filler-events.after-far-too-much-ti: After far too much time spent searching, you are finally able to track him down. You go into the fight pondering just how much of a head start you've lost on the Rebel Fleet...
wiki.filler-events.you-spend-some-time-l: You spend some time looking but your scanners cannot pick up any trace of the Rebel ship. You prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.you-quickly-find-the-: You quickly find the rebel ship's location and move to intercept.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-the-rebel-sh: You find the Rebel ship hiding on a nearby asteroid. You are able to get a shot off and permanently disable their engines before they notice you.
wiki.filler-events.you-try-and-stay-out-: You try and stay out of sight. You doubt they saw you.
wiki.filler-events.you-follow-their-vapo: You follow their vapour trails and surf onto their six o' clock, weapons hot.
wiki.filler-events.you-get-disoriented-i: You get disoriented in the nebula and lose your bearings completely. It takes some time to get back to the beacon. It's likely the fleet has had time to advance closer to your position.
wiki.filler-events.without-sensors-you-c: Without sensors you can't maintain a lock for long. The rebels slip away.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-they-see-y: As soon as they see you they make a run for it. You squeeze what you can out of the malfunctioning sensors and are able to keep track of them enough to get in firing range.
wiki.filler-events.your-augment-s-abilit: Your augment's ability to keep track of their life signatures within the nebula proves useful. You catch up to the ship and prepare for a fight.
wiki.filler-events.you-check-your-clonin: You check your Cloning Bay but it lies dormant. Whatever just happened to your crewmember must be irreversible.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-a-kal: As you approach, a kaleidoscope of colours fills the view-screen and one of your crew begins to age rapidly in reverse, eventually disappearing into nothingness. Let's hope they've transcended physical existence, and not just been forced out of it.
wiki.filler-events.you-approach-the-plan: You approach the planet and wait, but nothing happens. The Zoltan hail: "And in the coming times, when the monolith speaks not with a man he has no future and must be left wanting."

You approach the planet carefully, trying to keep your ship from breaking up in orbit. The monolith, whatever it is, must sense as much because the next thing you know you have enough scrap to patch up your damage and more besides!
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-an-an: As you approach, an ancient alien voice speaks to you: "Your mission has brought you great battles, and great losses. This will help ease the pain." A few minutes later someone reports medical equipment has appeared on the ship!
wiki.filler-events.your-mission-is-to-sa: Your mission is to save the Federation, not discover new wonders around the galaxy. You prepare to jump.
wiki.filler-events.you-receive-a-slug-cr: You receive a Slug crewmember named Slocknog.
wiki.filler-events.you-power-up-the-ftl-: You power up the FTL, at which point the Slug sends an urgent plea. "Please, I ssee you are a sssly captain. You have an advantage. Very well. I will join your crew - but please remove me from this rock!"
wiki.filler-events.there-is-no-room-aboa: There is no room aboard for Slocknog.
wiki.filler-events.when-he-sees-the-shut: When he sees the shuttle headed for his position the Slug thanks you with what looks like sincerity. He readily joins your crew.
wiki.filler-events.you-close-the-frequen: You close the frequency and continue jump prep. If this Slug is such a hero he'll find a way off that moon on his own.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-what-appears: You find what appears to be pieces of a derelict ship coated with ice or crystal. Before you have a chance to dock, a few asteroids get past your shields and partially damage your engines. You'll have to pull out!
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-pirate-shi: You find a pirate ship, damaged and abandoned. You salvage what you can and move on.
wiki.filler-events.discretion-is-the-bet: Discretion is the better part of valor. Better not risk it.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-grabs-what-: Your crew grabs what they can and returns to the ship before the asteroid hits. You take a look at what you've recovered once you move clear of the asteroid field.
wiki.filler-events.no-free-augmentation-: No free augmentation slot for the Damaged Stasis Pod: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-drags-the-p: Your crew drags the pod back to your ship before the asteroid smashes into the ship, shattering through the crystal coating and destroying the ship. The pod appears to be functioning but you see nothing but shards of crystal inside. Perhaps someone else will know how to open it.
wiki.filler-events.a-rock-patrol-ship-ju: A Rock patrol ship jumps in while you are salvaging the ship. They message you, "Filthy pirates! Prepare to die!" You doubt explaining your mission will convince them of your need.
wiki.filler-events.you-salvage-what-you-: You salvage what you can from the ship. No one bothers you during the operation.
wiki.filler-events.the-rock-people-are-n: The Rock people are not known for setting traps but you hasten to leave anyway.
wiki.filler-events.before-you-have-a-cha: Before you have a chance to leave, a Rock patrol ship arrives and you intercept their comm chatter, "...appears we've finally found them. Their killing spree ends now!" Before you can plead your innocence they move in to attack.
wiki.filler-events.you-salvage-what-you-: You salvage what you can from the ship. No lifeforms or ships are detected nearby.
wiki.filler-events.you-begin-the-salvage: You begin the salvage operation but before long your crew warns you of an approaching ship. You hasten to leave before they get within firing range.
wiki.filler-events.it-was-a-trap-the-man: It was a trap! The Mantis sabotages your ship before teleporting away.
wiki.filler-events.he-expresses-his-than: He expresses his thanks and prepares to help you fight his pursuer.
wiki.filler-events.the-engi-captain-is-d: The Engi captain is delighted, and quickly arranges for the transfer of the prisoner.
wiki.filler-events.fury-sparks-in-the-ey: Fury sparks in the eyes of the Mantis. He won't go easily, and causes serious damage before he can be captured.
wiki.filler-events.the-pursuing-ship-res: The pursuing ship responds with a completely unintelligible message. The young Mantis jerks to attention and assumes a battle stance. It was a trap!
wiki.filler-events.you-charge-weapons-an: You charge weapons and the Slugs quickly change course to meet your charge.
wiki.filler-events.you-charge-your-weapo: You charge your weapons and the Slugs immediately back down. When you return to the freighter, the Rockmen have already repaired the worst of their damage and jump away without another word.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-no-desire-to: You have no desire to provoke Slugs in their own territory. You leave them alone.
wiki.filler-events.after-the-slugs-board: After the Slugs board the ship, you are surprised to see the Rock ship spring to life and decimate the other ship. They message you, "Pathetic. You are either a coward or an ally of the Slugs. Either way, you don't deserve to live."
wiki.filler-events.the-slug-captain-expl: The Slug captain explains that they upgraded the Rock ship's reactor and now the 'thick boulder heads' are refusing to pay for the work done. The Rock Captain says the 'slime balls' did a poor job that is not worth their agreed upon price.
wiki.filler-events.offer-to-pay-off-the-: Offer to pay off the Rock debt. [{{debt}} scrap]
wiki.filler-events.demand-the-rock-ship-: Demand the Rock ship pay the agreed upon price.
wiki.filler-events.you-have-better-thing: You have better things to attend to, leave them.
wiki.filler-events.you-try-your-best-to-: You try your best to convey the notion that the approaching Rebel fleet has countless automated ships scouting for them. They thank you for the tip and prepare to jump in the direction you came. That will hopefully delay the fleet. You scrap what remains of the Rebel station.

You try your best to convey the notion that the approaching Rebel fleet has countless automated ships scouting for them. You're not certain if you were misunderstood but they appear to scoff at your suggestion. Most ships continue what they were doing but a single ship moves to fight you.

You try your best to convey the notion that the approaching Rebel fleet has countless automated ships scouting for them. However, either the translation device has failed or they're simply not interested. They cut the channel and continue to absorb the ships.
wiki.filler-events.you-decide-it-would-b: You decide it would be better to leave them be.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-craft-are-: The Mantis craft are both too busy slaughtering one another to notice you. Eventually the smaller ship gets the upper hand, but they must have blown a fuse in the assault and their weapons system is inoperable. Now is the time to attack!
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-craft-may-: The Mantis craft may have their differences, but when it comes to you they are of one mind. The smaller ship suffers a power failure as it moves to engage, but the larger one lets off a volley of fire and moves in to attack!
wiki.filler-events.there-s-quite-enough-: There's quite enough action here already - prepare for light speed.
wiki.filler-events.while-the-two-mantis-: While the two Mantis fight you approach the Rock ship and send a repair drone through one of the many breaches. It fixes the ship up enough to make at least a single jump. You're surprised when, instead, they embark on a kamikaze run on the two Mantis, which results in the obliteration of all three!

While the two Mantis fight you approach the Rock ship and use a drone to fix up the ship. Once the breaches are fixed the life support flickers back on. In a matter of moments they are already in pursuit of one of the Mantis ships. Meanwhile the second Mantis turns toward you.
wiki.filler-events.the-ship-s-turning-ci: The ship's turning circle proves too wide and the mine bites down onto the hull. You can hear it now, chewing through the armor.
wiki.filler-events.send-someone-out-ther: Send someone out there to defuse it.
wiki.filler-events.attempt-a-controlled-: Attempt a controlled detonation using a missile.
wiki.filler-events.use-a-drone-to-cut-aw: Use a drone to cut away the mine with a precision beam.
wiki.filler-events.it-stresses-the-inert: It stresses the inertial dampeners, but you reverse course and outrun the mine. You prepare to jump off.
wiki.filler-events.your-crewmember-dons-: Your crewmember dons a space suit and exits the airlock. They make quick work of the basic device and return inside to relief all round. The mine makes good scrap pickings too.
Your crewmember dons a space suit and exits the airlock. When they open up the mine housing, though, they panic. The red wire or the blue?! 3... 2... 1...
wiki.filler-events.after-drawing-straws-: After drawing straws, a crewmember goes out to fix a modified warhead to the mine. You detonate the missile in a way that dislodges the mine. It blows up shortly after. The ship takes some damage in the blasts, but you're still sailing.
wiki.filler-events.carefully-guided-from: Carefully guided from the bridge, your beam drone removes the mine's grappling arms and sends it drifting off into space, where you shoot at it until it detonates at a safe distance.
wiki.filler-events.your-engi-crewmember-: Your Engi crewmember refuses. In a halting use of adjectives and nouns, followed by some animated holographic aids, the Engi explains the ships are using each other to, loosely translated, "achieve a union." For some reason, this consolidation of ship matter sounds embarrassing and personal. You elect to leave the two Engi ships to their "business." After questioning your Engi crewmember, however, you do manage to salvage what scrap parts you can from the perimeter, even though you feel slightly dirty for doing so.
wiki.filler-events.your-crewmember-tells: Your crewmember tells them of the approaching fleet and the number of automated ships they use to scout ahead. They thank you for the tip and prepare to jump in the direction you came. That will hopefully will delay the fleet. You scrap what remains of the Rebel station.
wiki.filler-events.you-begin-to-message-: You begin to message the ship but it quickly powers on its weapons defensively. It appears to be fully functional and looking for a fight!
wiki.filler-events.after-a-long-message-: After a long message the translator only able to spurt out "critical... must... metal..." You can only surmise they must be desperate for scrap.
wiki.filler-events.after-a-time-you-are-: After a time you are told they were damaged and unable to repair their ship due to a lack of metal. They offer to exchange a piece of their ship's equipment for some scrap or other useful materials.
wiki.filler-events.they-respond-we-haven: They respond, "We haven't the foggiest idea how it works. They appear to meld part of their bodies into the metal and reshape it. They have been willing to demonstrate their ability if you have some extra metal that you would like converted into something."
wiki.filler-events.give-n-scrap-to-craft: Give {{n}} scrap to craft an augmentation.
Give {{n}} scrap to craft a weapon.
Give {{n}} scrap to craft a drone schematic.
wiki.filler-events.offer-to-help-in-the-: Offer to help in the process.
wiki.filler-events.your-crewmember-offer: Your crewmember offers to aid in the process to speed it along. They think it can be performed a bit more efficiently with the extra help and request less scrap.
wiki.filler-events.you-transfer-over-the: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the augmentation. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the weapon. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the schematic. You thank them and load it onto your ship.
wiki.filler-events.you-thank-them-for-th: You thank them for the information and prepare to jump.
wiki.filler-events.while-replicating-the: While replicating their innate ability would have immeasurable consequences on commercial manufacturing, your mission has a much higher priority at the moment.
wiki.filler-events.as-soon-as-the-drone-: As soon as the drone gets close, a Lanius in a type of spacewalk maneuvering unit grabs it and immediately starts breaking it down for metal. You prepare for a fight but they appear quite grateful for the act. They start to use the metal to repair key portions of their ship. From what you can understand from the translator it appears one of their crew wishes to join you.
wiki.filler-events.the-ship-refuses-all-: The ship refuses all hails, even from one of its own kind. It appears to have gone completely rogue. Before you can react, it begins to target your ship. Prepare for a fight.
wiki.filler-events.after-a-discussion-th: After a discussion that your translator fails to comprehend, the enemy ship powers down its weapons. You learn that your crewmember sucessfully reminded them of their treatise promising to leave the property of sentient aliens alone. If this is a widespread rule of this race, there appear to be many who disagree with it. You attempt to hail the civilian ship now that it's safe.
wiki.filler-events.you-land-a-small-shut: You land a small shuttle in an enormous field, whose only occupants are small, brightly colored, six-legged, horse-like animals. Could they be what your scans picked up?
wiki.filler-events.bring-some-of-the-cre: Bring some of the creatures on board to sell.
wiki.filler-events.none-of-your-attempts: None of your attempts to communicate seem to work: they just stare at you silently. As you prepare to leave, one of the creatures canters forward and forcefully nudges you away from the ship. He seems to want you to follow him. Eventually, the creatures guide you to an old Engi ship's crash site. Inside you are able to find and reactivate an Engi!
wiki.filler-events.you-try-to-communicat: You try to communicate in every possible way you can but they just stand there, silently judging you with their large, expressionless eyes. You prepare to leave.
wiki.filler-events.the-seemingly-docile-: The seemingly docile creatures quickly turn violent when you show your hostile intentions. They stampede with terrifying force, trampling one of your crew before you have time to react. You fight your way back to the shuttle and prepare to jump.

The seemingly docile creatures quickly turn violent when you reveal your hostile intentions. Their well-organized stampede forces you to draw weapons and make a rushed and shambolic retreat to the shuttle.
wiki.filler-events.this-isn-t-the-time-f: This isn't the time for exobiology. You head back to the ship.
wiki.filler-events.you-ignore-the-readin: You ignore the readings and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.you-approach-cautious: You approach cautiously but you detect no danger. It appears to have been a small rest stop that was abandoned a while ago. You take what few supplies you can find.
wiki.filler-events.upon-closer-inspectio: Upon closer inspection it appears to have a large portion of its hull destroyed. You take what few supplies you can find.
wiki.filler-events.you-dock-with-the-sta: You dock with the station to take a look inside. However no sooner do you open the airlock than pirates burst in. Meanwhile scanners pick up a previously undetected pirate ship moving in to attack!

You dock with the station to take a look inside. However no sooner do you open the airlock than pirates burst in. Meanwhile multiple warning signals go off on the bridge. The pirates have activated a remote planetary defense system and it's locking onto your ship!
wiki.filler-events.the-station-is-in-dis: The station is in disarray. You find a cloning bay partially intact but nothing else seems to be functioning.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-it-be: As you approach it becomes clear that the station is simply an empty shell. It has been stripped of useful materials long ago.
wiki.filler-events.you-take-what-you-can: You take what you can and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.you-decide-it-s-not-w: You decide it's not worth the time to examine.
wiki.filler-events.thank-you-we-need-to-: "Thank you! We need to scan this planet for life before we can begin terraforming, but our sensors can't get the necessary power to scan through this atmosphere. We've got a schedule to keep, any chance you could help?"
wiki.filler-events.set-sensors-to-maximu: Set sensors to maximum and scan.
wiki.filler-events.send-your-crewman-to-: Send your crewman to overcharge their systems.
wiki.filler-events.it-seems-your-sensors: It seems your sensors are no more powerful than the terraformer's. You apologize and continue on your way.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-if-you-modul: You find if you modulate the feedback signal of your sensors to just the right frequency, you're able to get through the atmosphere and perform a complete scan!
wiki.filler-events.but-our-livelihood-de: "But our livelihood depends on this job! Who cares about some silly mold? We'll pay you to look the other way!"
wiki.filler-events.accept-the-bribe-and-: Accept the bribe and leave. [+{{n}} scrap]
wiki.filler-events.offer-to-pay-them-to-: Offer to pay them to at least delay until the mold can be studied. [{{n}} scrap]
wiki.filler-events.power-your-weapons-an: Power your weapons and demand they leave at once.
wiki.filler-events.they-shut-off-communi: They shut off communications, but you can tell they have begun an evacuation procedure.
wiki.filler-events.we-understand-best-of: "We understand. Best of luck on your mission, sir!"
wiki.filler-events.you-get-lucky-and-fin: You get lucky and find them floating not too deep into the nebula. Thrilled to be found by friendlies, they come on board and abandon their wrecked ship.
wiki.filler-events.lock-onto-their-life-: Lock onto their life-signs with your teleporter.
wiki.filler-events.you-beam-the-federati: You beam the Federation crew aboard. One gladly joins your crew, the rest wait to be dropped off at the next station.
wiki.filler-events.pump-extra-power-into: Pump extra power into your sensors and try to track them.
wiki.filler-events.you-follow-the-faint-: You follow the faint signatures and find them floating not too far away into the nebula. Thrilled to be found by friendlies, they come on board and abandon their wrecked ship.
wiki.filler-events.your-local-radar-flic: Your local radar flickers, periodically showing signs of a large object in the clouds nearby. However it's enough to get coordinates and you find the ship... an empty hull, long since stripped of functioning components.
wiki.filler-events.while-searching-fruit: While searching fruitlessly through the nebula, you stumble upon the rebel ship which the Federation loyalists were likely hiding from. You prepare for a fight.
wiki.filler-events.your-search-is-hopele: Your search is hopeless. Your sensors can't pick up anything in the nebula.
wiki.filler-events.despite-your-caution-: Despite your caution, the lack of detection equipment allows debris to crash into your ship, damaging the hull. You salvage what you can and prepare to jump before anything worse happens.
wiki.filler-events.within-the-ship-grave: Within the ship graveyard you find one ship that seems relatively untouched. On board you find an unconscious passenger, and take them back to the ship. Once awake they offer to join your crew in thanks.

Within the ship graveyard you find one ship that seems relatively untouched. On board you find an unconscious passenger and take them back to the ship. Once awake they offer to join your crew in thanks.
wiki.filler-events.have-your-pilot-caref: Have your pilot carefully explore the debris.
wiki.filler-events.your-pilot-carefully-: Your pilot carefully explores the wrecks, but the storm has taken its toll. Any crew are long-since dead and the floating debris has been scorched beyond repair.
wiki.filler-events.while-the-crew-is-off: While the crew is off the ship searching through the wrecks, two hulls crash into each other breaking the crew's tethers. You have no time to react as someone is knocked away, floating helplessly into the gaseous clouds...
wiki.filler-events.among-the-junk-and-sc: Among the junk and scrap you find a salvageable drone schematic. You decide to quit while ahead and prepare to jump with your recent find.
wiki.filler-events.most-of-the-debris-is: Most of the debris is hardly even usable as scrap. However, you eventually find an intact weapon that can be mounted on your ship.
wiki.filler-events.we-understand-please-: "We understand... Please send help our way if you meet anyone trustworthy."
wiki.filler-events.your-abandoned-crewme: Your abandoned crewmember is waiting on the ship when you return, trying not to dwell on the fate of his previous incarnation.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-investigate-th: As you investigate the ship, you are attacked by the now-cannibalistic crew! Driven mad by lack of food, they have turned to feeding on each other. As you fight your way off the ship, one of your crew falls to the crazed attackers, and you are forced to leave them behind or else lose your entire ship.
wiki.filler-events.it-looks-as-if-the-sh: It looks as if the ship ran out of fuel, and the crew ran out of food not long after. Despite the grisly scene that remains, you find one surviving crewman locked in the freezer, almost perfectly preserved and apparently overlooked by the starving crew.
wiki.filler-events.the-ship-is-completel: The ship is completely abandoned. It looks like it ran out of fuel... and the crew ran out of food not long after. Despite the grisly scene that remains, you are able to scavenge some supplies from the cargo hold.
wiki.filler-events.as-you-approach-the-s: As you approach the ship, the other ship's transporters suddenly power up, and your decks swarm with now-cannibalistic refugees! Driven mad by lack of food, they have turned to feeding on each other - and now your crew is next!
wiki.filler-events.the-ship-is-completel: The ship is completely abandoned. There is no trace of the crew or any cargo. Mystified, you leave the ghost ship and continue on.
wiki.filler-events.human-boarders-beam-a: human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.filler-events.until-you-are-able-to: Until you are able to jump away from the hostile space station, your sensors will be disabled. You should deal with these boarders first though!
wiki.filler-events.while-i-appreciate-yo: "While I appreciate your enthusiasm, we have certain protocols for the use of explosives around the workplace. Launching a military grade weapon into our mines isn't exactly what I'd call 'union-friendly'."
wiki.filler-events.i-understand-good-luc: "I understand. Good luck out there. We'll try to make do with what we have."
wiki.filler-events.you-decide-you-need-w: You decide you need what supplies you have.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-boards-the-: Your crew boards the station, cautiously moving between corridors. Suddenly a man-sized arachnid bursts from a vent in the ceiling, followed by countless more. You fight your way back to the airlock and are forced to leave before accounting for all crew members. Not everybody made it back.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-slowly-cree: Your crew slowly creeps up on a cluster of the creatures from behind. Without warning, the giant arachnids turn and charge. However, your team stays in control and before long you've beaten them back. They are thrilled with your success and offer you a reward.
wiki.filler-events.you-can-t-risk-fighti: You can't risk fighting some unknown alien on every backwater station you come across. You prepare to jump.
wiki.filler-events.you-pull-up-alongside: You pull up alongside the station and release the drone through the airlock. Within a short time the majority of the creatures are dead, with only a little collateral damage. They express their most sincere gratitude.
wiki.filler-events.you-launch-the-drone-: You launch the drone and it crashes through their hull, leaving a huge breach. You watch as the drone tears through the creatures while debris and dead bodies fly out of the breach. The owners of the station are less than effusive when they thank you, and offer only a meager payment. Maybe it's a good time to leave...
wiki.filler-events.you-instruct-them-to-: You instruct them to drop their shields and you are able to kill the creatures without damaging the station. "The monsters just started bursting into flame as we watched. What a terrifying weapon... Here, take this for your help, friend."
wiki.filler-events.you-take-a-few-carefu: You take a few careful shots but you expose a mineral patch in the rock that reacts violently with your weapon. A shockwave forces you back as debris pelts against your hull. When you regain control you find there is not much left of the ship.
wiki.filler-events.you-fire-a-few-volley: You fire a few volleys into the rock and it starts to shudder and break apart. Without shields the pirate ship takes a beating but eventually pulls free. They thank you for your assistance.
wiki.filler-events.you-decide-the-pirate: You decide the pirate is not worth saving and fire a few volleys into their hull causing the ship to depressurize and break apart. You move in to loot the remains.

You decide the pirate is not worth saving and fire a few volleys into their hull. Before you can scrap the remains another pirate ship flashes on your radar. Perhaps they saw your deed, or perhaps they want to claim the spoils for themselves, but for whatever reason, they're charging weapons!
wiki.filler-events.you-use-your-beam-to-: You use your beam to make a few precision cuts in the asteroid. The ship gives a quick burst of thrust and the rock crumbles away. They thank you and offer some of the resources they have collected.
wiki.filler-events.you-program-the-drone: You program the drone to work carefully around the trapped ship. In a short time it allows the ship to easily slip out of its cage. They thank you and offer some of the resources they have collected.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-tries-to-ke: Your crew tries to keep the crowds in line but the scene quickly turns ugly. Half-crazed with fear, the infected grab mining tools and push back at your crew, forcing them to retreat hastily. They barely get away without injury but the same can't be said for the colony's leaders. You quickly leave.
wiki.filler-events.as-your-crewman-is-st: As your crewman is still alive and working towards a cure, it would be against Federation regulation to create a clone to continue with you on your journey.
wiki.filler-events.with-the-visible-thre: With the visible threat of your weapons, the infected become subdued enough for you to set up a rudimentary quarantine. However before you leave, one of your crew presents signs of infection. You have no choice but to leave them on the station in the hopes that they discover a cure quickly. You leave before more crew succumb.
wiki.filler-events.unfortunately-your-mi: Unfortunately your mission is too important and you're not willing to risk your crew. You prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.it-s-unlikely-the-roc: It's unlikely the Rock's impressive immune system is susceptible to a human virus so you send it in. It is able to intimidate the workers long enough for the colony forces to set up a quarantine. Their leaders offer a reward and assure you they will try to find a cure as soon as possible.
wiki.filler-events.with-no-fear-of-catch: With no fear of catching the disease, your Engi crewmember helps reassure and organize the infected humans. Calmed by its extensive knowledge of human physiology, the infected submit to the quarantine in the hopes that a cure can be found soon. The colony leaders offer a reward for helping to prevent an ugly incident.
wiki.filler-events.you-send-your-crew-in: You send your crew into the station. Unfortunately as soon as they enter the fire breaches the station's fuel cell containment. You quickly try to dock and retrieve your crew but not before an unfortunate soul is lost in the inferno.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-valiantly-k: Your crew valiantly keeps the fire at bay long enough to allow some of the scientists to escape, but it appears to be a losing battle. Before long you order the retreat. The few scientists they were able to save are distraught but grateful. You'll drop them off at the next station.
wiki.filler-events.you-locate-the-highes: You locate the highest concentration of life forms and bring the ship alongside the station. Before you can begin to offload the survivors a huge blast splits the station apart. Your ship is thrown away and some debris pierces your hull. You watch helplessly as the last of the survivors are consumed in the collapse of the station.
wiki.filler-events.you-pull-up-alongside: You pull up alongside the station and cut through their hull. You are able to rescue a few survivors but many more are lost. One of the survivors offers to join your crew and you offload the rest on a nearby station.
wiki.filler-events.there-is-no-room-aboa: There is no room aboard for Dr. Jones.
wiki.filler-events.you-coldly-shut-off-c: You coldly shut off communications and prepare to leave. Your crew seems upset but you assure them that nothing could have been done.
wiki.filler-events.your-rock-soldier-tea: Your Rock soldier tears through the airlock directly into the fire. You've never seen someone that large move that fast. It disperses as much fire suppressant as possible into the heart of the blaze and eventually the fires start to die down. With most of the fire under control, the scientists are able to help secure the station. They offer you their sincere gratitude and a generous reward.
wiki.filler-events.you-send-the-repair-d: You send the repair drone in and it methodically puts out the fires. Once it has made some progress, the rest of your crew helps to secure the station. They offer you their sincere gratitude; the station would have surely been destroyed without your assistance. They transfer a small reward and an additional drone schematic.
wiki.filler-events.you-find-a-colony-tha: You find a colony that seems to have been recently attacked. Exploring the devastation, you find a lone survivor.
wiki.filler-events.invite-him-to-join-yo: Invite him to join your crew.
wiki.filler-events.take-him-home-to-his-: Take him home to his family on a nearby planet in this system.
wiki.filler-events.you-can-t-help-them-s: You can't help them so you prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.you-fire-a-few-volley: You fire a few volleys from a distance and it is clear the defense system is no match for your weapons. However, the station does not seem happy with your 'solution'. You salvage what you can and jump before there is trouble.
wiki.filler-events.you-use-your-ion-weap: You use your ion weaponry to disable the gun long enough for their repair crews to fix it. They message you, "I've never seen a weapon like that before! Thanks for your help! Please, accept this reward."
wiki.filler-events.you-use-your-ship-s-c: You use your ship's Cloaking to try to prevent the defense system from getting a lock. However before you are able to safely disable the system your cloaking gives out and you are forced to destroy the satellite. No one was harmed but they don't seem happy with your solution.
wiki.filler-events.you-use-your-ships-cl: You use your ships Cloaking to prevent the defense system from getting a lock. Once closer, you hasten to disable the system without damaging it. It was a sloppy job but they appreciate it and offer a reward.
wiki.filler-events.your-ship-s-advanced-: Your ship's Advanced Cloaking allows you to approach the defense system without an issue. Once closer, you are able to safely disable the system. They thank you for your help and offer a reward.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-member-is-a: Your crew-member is able to remotely fix the glitch in the defense AI, allowing the repair crew to close in and finish the job. The station gives you its thanks along with a reward.
wiki.filler-events.you-send-the-pod-back: You send the pod back out the airlock. You're not stupid.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-inside-is-: The Mantis inside is FURIOUS. He cuts the closest person in half with a single swipe. Kill it before anyone else is hurt.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-inside-con: The Mantis inside considers you a messenger from the god of mercy and demands to join your crew.
wiki.filler-events.a-man-bursts-out-of-t: A man bursts out of the life-pod screaming and claws his way into a corner. A rare survivor of Mantis captivity. Once calm, the survivor offers to join your crew for a time.
wiki.filler-events.you-thank-them-but-pr: You thank them but prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.your-hacking-system-a: Your hacking system automatically counters the digital assault. Your Sensors flicker back on and you prepare to fight the boarders.
wiki.filler-events.you-briefly-consider-: You briefly consider cloning a replacement, but decide to respect the Federation laws regarding simultaneous duplicates.
wiki.filler-events.you-divert-all-availa: You divert all available power to your engines and flee. You caught them off-guard, but they seem to be gaining on you. Luckily you are able to stay out of range long enough to charge the FTL drive.
wiki.filler-events.you-fire-up-the-engin: You fire up the engines and try to escape. Their slower ship is unable to keep pace; eventually it gives up and returns to the beacon to await an easier target.
wiki.filler-events.you-quickly-fire-up-y: You quickly fire up your engines and make a break for it. However, it seems to be in vain. They catch up to you effortlessly and power up their weapons.
wiki.filler-events.you-give-them-the-fue: You give them the fuel. "Thank you. Here, have this extra scrap as payment."
You give them the fuel. "Thank the Gods. We can finally get out of here! We're jumping straight home so take this extra weapon. We won't need it, hopefully."
You give them the fuel. "Thank you so much! We don't have much to offer, but have a look at the sector scans we took." Your map is updated.
wiki.filler-events.could-not-upgrade-the: Could not upgrade the Reactor, it's maxed
wiki.filler-events.you-give-them-the-fue: You give them the fuel. "Thank you. Perhaps as payment our engineer can try to optimize your ship's reactor output?"
wiki.filler-events.you-let-their-team-on: You let their team on board and after a short time they finish their work.
wiki.filler-events.you-lose-scrap-and-yo: You lose {{cost}} scrap and your ship reactor is upgraded.
You lose {{cost}} scrap and your Sensors are upgraded to level {{level}}.
You lose {{cost}} scrap and your {{v}} is upgraded to level {{level}}.
wiki.filler-events.you-make-the-exchange: You make the exchange and their team comes on board to try to improve your reactor.
wiki.filler-events.you-accept-the-bribe-: You accept the bribe and leave.
wiki.filler-events.they-see-reason-and-a: They see reason and accept the offer. The station scientists have a unique talent for life support units and offer to upgrade your oxygen system as an apology for their behaviour.
wiki.filler-events.thank-you-so-much-we-: "Thank you so much! We don't have the funds to hire outside help and it would have taken our staff weeks to figure that out. Here, take this as payment!"
wiki.filler-events.you-reconfigure-your-: You reconfigure your ship's nano dispersal system. In a matter of minutes all of the workers are cured. The leaders can hardly believe what you have achieved. They offer you what they can as payment.
wiki.filler-events.you-break-communicati: You break communications and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.with-much-grumbling-t: With much grumbling, the Rock Captain agrees to pay the price.
wiki.filler-events.apparently-the-rock-c: Apparently the Rock Captain was more annoyed than you thought, they shut off all communication and turn on you, the 'slime balls' defender.
wiki.filler-events.a-massive-explosion-e: A massive explosion emanates from the Rock Ship, shattering its hull and sending debris on an unavoidable collision course to your ship. Seems like that reactor upgrade was poorly done after all, and the Slugs took the opportunity to jump away.
wiki.filler-events.once-convinced-to-hel: Once "convinced" to help he lowers the price and describes the weapon. However, he eventually comes to his senses and confusedly takes back his discount. He is clearly unsure why he offered it in the first place.

Once "convinced" to help, he casually states that his offer was actually a lie and that they planned to attack your ship. By the time he returns to his senses you've already prepared your ship to fight.
wiki.filler-events.you-thank-him-for-his: You thank him for his offer and prepare to move on.
wiki.filler-events.after-an-hour-of-conv: After an hour of convincing, the Mantis finally calms down and introduces himself as Robert Smith. He explains he's from a nearby human colony and would appreciate being returned there.
wiki.filler-events.your-crew-s-clone-is-: Your crew's clone is waiting when you return to the ship.
wiki.filler-events.the-cornered-and-frig: The cornered and frightened Mantis attacks as soon as you approach. One of your crew is eviscerated before the rest are able to stop him. The Engi apologize for your loss.

The cornered and frightened Mantis attacks as soon as you approach. You're able to subdue him and leave him at a Mantis colony in a neighboring system. They don't seem pleased or grateful at his return.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-is-gratefu: The Mantis is grateful to see 'another human', and introduces himself as Robert Smith. He explains he's from a nearby human colony and would appreciate being returned there.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-is-terrifi: The Mantis is terrified at the sight of your crewmember. He immediately attacks his Engi rescuers, and your crewmember is forced to kill him. The Engi are grateful for your help and offer a small reward.
wiki.filler-events.the-mantis-calms-down: The Mantis calms down and communicates thanks to the Engi and yourself for helping. He requests to be dropped off at a nearby planet, at the human colony where he was raised. They are grateful for his return and offer a reward.
wiki.filler-events.he-graciously-accepts: He graciously accepts, having always wanted to serve in the Federation.
wiki.filler-events.they-are-happy-to-tak: They are happy to take a look, and are able to offer some suggestions for improvements.
wiki.filler-events.he-states-that-he-was: He states that he was a weapons operator before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
He states that he was a shield operator before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
He states that he was a pilot before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
He states that he was an engineer before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
He states that he was an infantryman before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
He states that he was a shipwright before being stranded. He happily offers his services for a time in exchange for "getting off that rock".
wiki.filler-events.the-family-apparently: The family apparently owns one of the most valuable mining enterprises in the sector. For the safe return of his son, the patron of the family offers you a substantial reward.
wiki.filler-events.the-survivor-s-family: The survivor's family is of modest means, yet they manage to offer you a reward for your virtuous deed.
wiki.filler-events.overjoyed-with-the-re: Overjoyed with the return of their son, the family of the survivor arranges to repair your ship's hull as compensation.
wiki.filler-events.once-back-in-orbit-th: Once back in orbit, the man turns increasingly violent. Eventually he turns on your crew and manages to kill one before you can subdue him.
wiki.filler-events.he-seems-to-improve-i: He seems to improve immensely upon getting back to the ship. It might take a while for him to truly be well again, but until them he seems happy to serve as a member of your crew.
wiki.filler-events.being-back-in-space-t: Being back in space terrifies him. He goes mad and nearly blows a hole in the side of your ship with a makeshift explosive in an attempt to "escape this metal prison." He dies in the explosion.
wiki.filler-events.once-inside-your-medb: Once inside your medbay, the system is able to restore his body and undo some of the damage to his brain. Once awake he states, "I feel almost like my old self again... Thank you. Please let me serve on your ship."
wiki.filler-events.your-improved-medbay-: Your improved medbay was able to resuscitate him. After a short time he recovers greatly saying, "I really thought I was a goner... I haven't eaten for days. Would you mind if I stayed on your ship?"
wiki.filler-events.once-inside-your-adva: Once inside your advanced medbay, the system is able to identify and minimize the trauma associated with being alone for so long. Once awake he states, "I don't know how to repay you, I feel 10 years younger... Let me serve on your ship."
wiki.filler-events.your-quick-reaction-a: Your quick reaction allowed your Clonebay to revive him after he passes. After he steps out of the machine he states, "How am I alive? Wasn't I just dying on some shuttle? Technology sure has changed."
wiki.filler-events.you-bring-the-ship-cl: You bring the ship closer and the Slug, after a pause, says that the person is stable and with good intentions. You offer a position in your crew and it is graciously accepted.
You bring the ship closer. The Slug enters a trance-like state for 1 to 2 seconds, then quickly snaps out of it. He states, "This person is clearly unstable. It is best we leave them alone."
wiki.flagship-systems.power-surge-their-: Power surge: their Zoltan Shield is back online.
wiki.flagship-systems.the-flagship-s-ai-: The Flagship's AI has taken control of the ship.
wiki.flagship.wiki-page-the-rebel-flagsh: Wiki page "The Rebel Flagship", section "1st Stage"
wiki.flagship.weapons-system-levels-boss: Weapons: system levels Boss Ion 3, Boss Laser 3, Boss Missile 3, Boss Beam 3.
wiki.flagship.weapon-cooldowns-and-statu: Weapon cooldowns and status effects: at system level 3 the charge times are Ion 21 seconds, Laser 15 seconds, Missile 17.25 seconds, Beam 19.5 seconds.
Weapon cooldowns and status effects: lasers 10% fire and 9% breach. Missiles 30% fire and 14% breach. None of the Flagship weapons can stun.
wiki.flagship.global-behavior-the-missil: Global behavior: the missile launcher does not consume missiles.
wiki.flagship.dodge-rate-base-10-fully-m: Dodge Rate: base 10%. Fully manned 20% (enemy crew is unskilled regardless of difficulty). Unmanned and the piloting room empty 8%. Controlled by AI 20%.
wiki.flagship.hacking-advanced-edition-o: Hacking: Advanced Edition only. Consumes 1 drone part to deploy.
wiki.flagship.flagship-variation-easy-mo: Flagship variation: Easy mode with Advanced Edition Content disabled has 3 shield layers (shield system level 6) instead of the usual 4 (level 8), on all three stages. Shields on this row stay at the printed 8.
wiki.flagship.global-behavior-no-power-s: Global behavior: no Power Surge on the first stage.
wiki.flagship.1st-stage-diagram-room-pos: 1st Stage diagram: room positions are a picture. Transparent systems exist only with Advanced Edition. Transparent rooms exist only on Hard mode. No room layout is encoded.
wiki.flagship.wiki-page-the-rebel-flagsh: Wiki page "The Rebel Flagship", section "2nd stage"
wiki.flagship.power-surge-deploys-extra-: Power Surge: deploys extra drones, randomly split between Beam and Combat (both mark 1). Extra drones are 4 on Easy, 6 on Normal, and 7 on Hard. The split stays fixed for every surge unless you jump away and come back. Cooldown varies randomly each time, between 20 and 30 seconds. A warning sounds exactly 5 seconds before the surge begins. The extra drones take two shots each and then disappear; the length varies, but is about 7 seconds. If you are cloaked, positioning for a shot counts as one of the two shots. Hacking or destroying the drone system does not affect them; they are an independent hazard.
wiki.flagship.general-crew-is-the-remain: General: crew is the remaining crew from the previous stage, minus the one in the Ion room if left alive.
wiki.flagship.drones-combat-drone-mark-i: Drones: Combat Drone Mark I (2), Anti-Ship Beam Drone I (2), Defense Drone Mark I (2), Boarding Drone (Boss) (2). Uses 4 drones at once.
wiki.flagship.power-surge-those-extra-dr: Power Surge: those extra drones do not consume drone parts.
wiki.flagship.weapons-system-levels-boss: Weapons: system levels Boss Laser 3, Boss Missile 3, Boss Beam 3. The Boss Ion was lost during the previous battle.
wiki.flagship.weapon-cooldowns-and-statu: Weapon cooldowns and status effects: at system level 3 the charge times are Laser 15 seconds, Missile 17.25 seconds, Beam 19.5 seconds.
wiki.flagship.systems-hacking-door-and-c: Systems: Hacking, Door, and Cloaking were lost in the previous battle.
wiki.flagship.dodge-rate-base-15-fully-m: Dodge rate: base 15%. Fully manned 25% (enemy crew is unskilled regardless of difficulty). Unmanned and the piloting room empty 12%. Controlled by AI 25%.
wiki.flagship.2nd-stage-diagram-room-pos: 2nd stage diagram: room positions are a picture. Transparent rooms exist only on Hard mode. No room layout is encoded.
wiki.flagship.wiki-page-the-rebel-flagsh: Wiki page "The Rebel Flagship", section "Final stage"
wiki.flagship.power-surge-shoots-7-laser: Power Surge: shoots 7 laser shots simultaneously, or brings its Zoltan shield back online. After every 3 laser Power Surges, the 4th fully restores the Zoltan Shield. Cooldown varies each time, randomly between 20 and 30 seconds. There is a warning exactly 5 seconds beforehand. Crew on board when the Zoltan shield comes back are stuck until the shield is broken, unless you have Zoltan Shield Bypass. The surge lasers use the Heavy Laser Mark I blueprint but do 1 damage instead of 2, with 30% fire, 21% breach, and 20% stun.
wiki.flagship.general-crew-is-the-remain: General: crew is the remaining crew from the previous stage, minus the one in the Beam room if left alive.
wiki.flagship.general-the-zoltan-shield-: General: the Zoltan Shield has 12 health points.
wiki.flagship.weapons-system-levels-boss: Weapons: system levels Boss Laser 4, Boss Missile 4. The Boss Beam was lost during the previous battle.
wiki.flagship.weapon-cooldowns-and-statu: Weapon cooldowns and status effects: at system level 4 the charge times are Laser 10 seconds, Missile 11.5 seconds.
wiki.flagship.systems-the-drone-system-w: Systems: the Drone system was lost in the previous battle.
wiki.flagship.systems-mind-control-is-pr: Systems: Mind Control is present only with Advanced Edition enabled.
wiki.flagship.dodge-rate-base-28-fully-m: Dodge rate: base 28%. Fully manned 38% (enemy crew is unskilled regardless of difficulty). Unmanned and the piloting room empty 22%. Controlled by AI 38%.
wiki.flagship.final-stage-diagram-room-p: Final stage diagram: room positions are a picture. Transparent systems exist only with Advanced Edition. Transparent rooms exist only on Hard mode. No room layout is encoded.
wiki.flagship.wiki-page-the-rebel-flagsh: Wiki page "The Rebel Flagship", sections "Flagship variation" and "Boarding strategy" / "Hard mode"
wiki.flagship.flagship-variation-on-hard: Flagship variation: on Hard mode, two additional rooms link the Laser and Missile ones to the main section of the ship. That makes it harder to stop the enemy repairing them.
wiki.flagship.flagship-variation-those-e: Flagship variation: those extra rooms are only drawn on the stage pictures (transparent rooms exist only on Hard mode). Positions are a picture. No room layout is encoded.
wiki.flagship.2nd-stage-power-surge-7-ex: 2nd stage / Power Surge: 7 extra drones on Hard. Easy is 4 and Normal is 6. Those counts are not averaged.
wiki.flagship.boarding-strategy-hard-mod: Boarding strategy / Hard mode: the laser and missile weapons are connected to the main body, so crew can contest a boarding party and repair those weapons. The main body has two extra crew.
Boarding strategy / Hard mode: without boarding, leaving one crew alive in the main body stops the AI and means 5% lower evasion.
wiki.hulls-crystal.this-powerful-vessel-: This powerful vessel is powered by the secret technologies of the lost Crystalline Beings.
wiki.hulls-crystal.see-ancestry-ship-ach: See Ancestry (ship achievement) and its linked pages for directions on unlocking the Crystal Cruiser. Alternatively, beat the Flagship with layout A and B of every ship (excluding The Lanius Cruiser).
wiki.hulls-crystal.their-unique-racial-a: Their unique racial ability makes the Crystal beings very adept at ship boarding. This ship was designed for such raiding parties.
wiki.hulls-crystal.earn-at-least-two-out: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Crystal Cruiser.
wiki.hulls-mantis.this-warship-is-design: This warship is designed to enhance its crew for close combat missions.
wiki.hulls-mantis.see-the-legendary-thie: See the Legendary Thief KazaaakplethKilik random event. Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Zoltan Cruiser.
wiki.hulls-mantis.this-warship-encourage: This warship encourages sending massive boarding parties and keeping strong defense.
wiki.hulls-mantis.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Mantis Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.hulls-mantis.with-a-large-teleporte: With a large teleporter and weapons designed to impede enemy crew, this ship is deadly in the hands of a capable boarding party.
wiki.hulls-mantis.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching Sector 8 with the Mantis Cruiser B and Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.

wiki.layout-pages.does-not-require-unloc: Does not require unlocking (it is the only ship, the cruiser and the layout, available from the very start of the game)

wiki.layout-pages.this-model-was-modifie: "This model was modified by pirates to utilize newly discovered technology. It can clone lost crewmembers and stun enemies."

wiki.layout-pages.the-engi-cruiser-secti: The Engi Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.the-engi-were-quick-to: "The Engi were quick to adapt to the sudden surge of hacking technology - this ship is the result of their research."

wiki.layout-pages.the-federation-cruiser: The Federation Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.this-ship-features-the: "This ship features the latest in federation technology: an advanced beam weapon that pierces through shields!"
wiki.layout-pages.defeat-the-flagship-pr: Defeat the Flagship prototype in the Rebel Stronghold sector to unlock this ship.
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-defeat-t: Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Engi Cruiser.

wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Federation Cruiser achievements will unlock layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-federation-cruiser: The Federation Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.with-a-flak-artillery-: "With a Flak Artillery weapon and an improved Clone Bay, only the most suicidal of infantry chooses to fly on this ship."
wiki.layout-pages.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching Sector 8 with The Federation Cruiser B and Advanced Edition content enabled will unlock Layout C.

wiki.layout-pages.the-zoltan-s-advanced-: "The Zoltan's advanced shields technology give this ship an edge during each battle."

wiki.layout-pages.weak-level-1-shields-s: Weak (level 1) Shields system requires 100 scrap to upgrade it to level 2 (in order to have a normal shield layer)
wiki.layout-pages.the-zoltan-cruiser-sec: The Zoltan Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.the-designer-of-this-s: "The designer of this ship was not willing to spend the money for a decent reactor. Instead it relies on its Zoltan crew and Backup Battery."
wiki.layout-pages.getting-to-sector-8-wi: Getting to Sector 8 with the The Zoltan Cruiser Type B with Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock Layout C.
wiki.layout-pages.weak-level-2-reactor-r: Weak (level 2) Reactor requires 30 scrap per power bar upgrade until level 5 (inclusive).
wiki.layout-pages.the-lanius-cruiser-sec: The Lanius Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.the-sharp-knife-like-s: "The sharp knife-like structures make Lanius ships a sight to behold. This cruiser was adapted to support the other races of the Federation."
wiki.layout-pages.unlock-4-ships-excludi: Unlock 4 ships (Excluding The Kestrel) to unlock this ship.
wiki.layout-pages.the-lanius-cruiser-sec: The Lanius Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.the-racial-ability-of-: "The racial ability of the Lanius make them fearsome combatants in small quarters. Combine that with a Mind Control system and this ship is a force to be reckoned with."
wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Lanius Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-stealth-cruiser-se: The Stealth Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.constructed-for-the-fe: "Constructed for the Federation by the Engi, this ship is designed to use cloaking technology and speed to get behind enemy lines."
wiki.layout-pages.see-the-engi-fleet-dis: See the Engi fleet discussion event.
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-defeat-t: Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Rock Cruiser.
wiki.layout-pages.the-stealth-cruiser-se: The Stealth Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.built-like-a-glass-can: "Built like a glass cannon, this ship is hard to handle. If its cloaking can keep it safe long enough to charge its weapon, few cruisers can withstand its might."
wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Stealth Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-stealth-cruiser-se: The Stealth Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.this-ship-was-part-of-: "This ship was part of an Engi experiment to make a power efficient version of the Zoltan shield. Unfortunately this required the removal of the Cloaking system."
wiki.layout-pages.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching sector 8 with the Stealth Cruiser B and Advanced Mode enabled will unlock layout C.
wiki.layout-pages.the-rock-cruiser-secti: The Rock Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.similar-to-its-designe: "Similar to its designers, this super dense behemoth uses brute force to overwhelm its foes."
wiki.layout-pages.see-the-rock-war-vesse: See the Rock war vessel encounter.
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-defeat-t: Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Slug cruiser.
wiki.layout-pages.the-rock-cruiser-secti: The Rock Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.with-no-airlocks-this-: "With no airlocks, this ship must rely entirely on its rock crew to put out fires."
wiki.layout-pages.the-shivan-starts-with: The Shivan starts without a Door System, requiring 60 scrap to buy it. It is the only ship which does not have airlocks, preventing any sections from being vented to space except via a hull breach or with Lanius crew.
wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Rock Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-rock-cruiser-secti: The Rock Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.contact-has-been-made-: "Contact has been made with the Crystalline race and this cruiser was offered to the Federation as part of diplomatic discussions between the sister species."
wiki.layout-pages.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching sector 8 with the Rock Cruiser B with Advanced Mode enabled will unlock layout C.
wiki.layout-pages.the-slug-cruiser-secti: The Slug Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.designed-for-use-insid: "Designed for use inside nebula, this cruiser lacks sensors and relies instead on the guile and cunning of the Slugs."
wiki.layout-pages.see-the-slug-home-nebu: See the Slug Home Nebula Surrender random event.
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-defeat-t: Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Mantis Cruiser.
wiki.layout-pages.the-slug-cruiser-secti: The Slug Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.this-boarding-ship-has: "This boarding ship has no medical facilities and must manage its explosives carefully to keep the crew alive."
wiki.layout-pages.the-stormwalker-starts: The Stormwalker starts with a teleporter but lacks a medbay, resulting in reliance on the Healing Burst to heal crew members.
wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Slug Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-slug-cruiser-secti: The Slug Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.slugs-are-often-skille: "Slugs are often skilled in the arts of misdirection and manipulation. With Hacking and Mind Control systems, this ship capitalizes on that fact."
wiki.layout-pages.the-ariolimax-starts-w: The Ariolimax starts with Hacking and Mind Control, making it effective at disrupting an enemy ship.
wiki.layout-pages.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching sector 8 with the Slug Cruiser B on any difficulty with Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.
wiki.layout-pages.the-mantis-cruiser-sec: The Mantis Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.this-warship-is-design: "This warship is designed to enhance its crew for close combat missions."
wiki.layout-pages.see-legendary-thief-ka: See Legendary Thief KazaaakplethKilik random event.
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-defeat-t: Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Zoltan Cruiser.
wiki.layout-pages.the-mantis-cruiser-sec: The Mantis Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.this-warship-encourage: "This warship encourages sending massive boarding parties and keeping strong defense."
wiki.layout-pages.one-of-the-few-ships-w: One of the few ships with a four man crew teleporter; one of the few ships without starting Weapons.
wiki.layout-pages.earning-two-of-the-thr: Earning two of the three Mantis Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
wiki.layout-pages.the-mantis-cruiser-sec: The Mantis Cruiser, section Layout C
wiki.layout-pages.with-a-large-teleporte: "With a large teleporter and weapons designed to impede enemy crew, this ship is deadly in the hands of a capable boarding party."
wiki.layout-pages.one-of-the-few-ships-w: One of the few ships with a four-man crew teleporter.
wiki.layout-pages.reaching-sector-8-with: Reaching Sector 8 with the Mantis Cruiser B and Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.
wiki.layout-pages.notes-this-layout-is-o: Notes: this layout is one of the ships with most airlocks.
wiki.layout-pages.the-crystal-cruiser-se: The Crystal Cruiser, section Layout A
wiki.layout-pages.this-powerful-vessel-i: "This powerful vessel is powered by the secret technologies of the lost Crystalline Beings."
wiki.layout-pages.see-ancestry-ship-achi: See Ancestry (ship achievement) and its linked pages for directions on unlocking the Crystal Cruiser
wiki.layout-pages.alternatively-beat-the: Alternatively, beat the Flagship with layout A and B of every ship (excluding The Lanius Cruiser)
wiki.layout-pages.the-crystal-cruiser-se: The Crystal Cruiser, section Layout B
wiki.layout-pages.their-unique-racial-ab: "Their unique racial ability makes the Crystal beings very adept at ship boarding. This ship was designed for such raiding parties."
wiki.layout-pages.earn-at-least-two-out-: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Crystal Cruiser
wiki.quests-a-pages.an-ancient-device-is: An ancient device is orbiting within the crystal rings of a nearby gas giant. You can't discern its nature or function, but it seems to have been deactivated for a very long time. Perhaps you can get some scrap from it.
wiki.quests-a-pages.you-break-it-apart-o: You break it apart, or a Rock military ship answers.
wiki.quests-a-pages.you-are-immediately-: You are immediately messaged by an imposing looking Rock war vessel, "You're the ship off to 'save the Federation,' aren't you? And you expect to survive with that hunk of junk?"
wiki.quests-a-pages.we-re-going-to-save-: "We're going to save them or die trying."
wiki.quests-a-pages.a-quest-marker-is-ad: A quest marker is added to your map.
wiki.quests-a-pages.an-unarmed-zoltan-tr: An unarmed Zoltan transport vessel is slowly making its way toward the beacon here. They hail: "This is a Zoltan peace envoy. We carry no weapons or shielding and rely on the mercy of others to communicate our message."
wiki.quests-a-pages.you-arrive-at-a-zolt: You arrive at a Zoltan research facility. They say they are researching genetic distortion due to stasis sleep and prolonged FTL travel. They ask if your crew has the time to undergo a few scans.
wiki.quests-a-pages.you-come-to-a-zoltan: You come to a Zoltan trade and supply hub - everything the weary traveler needs, provided they have the right documentation.
wiki.quests-a-pages.try-to-talk-your-way: Try to talk your way in.
wiki.quests-a-pages.you-try-your-luck-at: You try your luck at the airlock.
wiki.quests-a-pages.beam-directly-to-the: Beam directly to the civilian deck.
wiki.quests-a-pages.present-his-official: Present his official documentation and pay the entry fee.
wiki.quests-a-pages.a-rock-captain-hails: A rock captain hails you: "It is improper of me to contact off-worlders, but this is an emergency. We were on our way to deliver our passenger to her new husband - the Grand Basilisk of Numa V - when our engines broke down. Will you take possession of her, and make haste to Numa V?"
wiki.quests-a.there-is-no-room-aboard-fo: There is no room aboard for {{name}}.
wiki.quests-a.you-arrive-at-the-coordina: You arrive at the coordinates to find a massive Crystalline cruiser docked at a small repair station. You arrange for the ship to be sent back to the Federation base while the station upgrades your hull.

You arrive at the coordinates given and find yourself dangerously close to an M-class star! The other ship messages you, "Let's see how long your puny ship can handle this heat! Prepare for a challenge!"
wiki.quests-a.you-arrive-at-a-massive-ro:
You arrive at a massive Rockman shipyard and notice the ship that had just tried to kill you is docked and already being repaired. "Well fought! I must say I did not expect you to survive."

I am convinced of your strength and pledge to assist your cause. We'll immediately send an advanced cruiser to the Federation fleet and we will prepare our warships to move out.

"Now that that's taken care of, let us patch up your hull. Maybe we can improve its armor plating while we're at it."
wiki.quests-a.you-arrive-at-the-location: You arrive at the location specified by the peace-loving Zoltan, but the only thing nearby is a Rebel ship, closing in fast! "We've found you! You're not getting away this time!"
wiki.quests-a.a-vast-tunnel-network-near:
A vast tunnel network near the surface of Numa V indicates an advanced Rock civilization. This must be where you were asked to deliver the passenger.

Realizing arrival is imminent, your passenger - silent so far - pleads with you not to hand her over. She's interrupted by the Grand Basilisk's Chief Aide: "To the alien vessel holding the Basilisk's wife. Deliver her to us. You will be rewarded... well."
wiki.quests-a.you-head-into-a-ship-suppl:
{{text}}

You head into a ship supply store. It is a well-equipped, self-service affair. An order is dialed into a terminal, scrap is deposited, and the item is dispatched from a nearby chute.
wiki.quests-a.you-break-it-apart-and-tak: You break it apart and take it for scrap. No one will miss it.
wiki.quests-a.as-you-start-to-break-it: As you start to break it apart a Rock military ship jumps nearby, "You think you can come into our sector and just steal whatever you please?! Prepare to die, vandals!"
wiki.quests-a.better-not-risk-it-the-roc: Better not risk it. The Rock people are unlikely to respond well to vandalism.
wiki.quests-a.your-crystalline-companion:
Your Crystalline companion says, "It looks like we have found the abandoned link to my home worlds. I can reactivate it." He transmits some codes to the device and it immediately powers on.

Before you can react, the space around you distorts and a wormhole forms. You begin to sound the alarm, but your companion calms you and indicates that you should fly directly into the wormhole. You reluctantly do as he says.

You arrive in a sector not listed in any star charts. Strange crystalline ships dot the horizon. Your companion speaks, "Here we are, my home sector. It has been a long time since others have set foot here, I wonder how you will be received."

"You have done as you promised and so shall I. The coordinates of my old ship have been forwarded to your navigation system."
wiki.quests-a.the-latter-being-more-like: "The latter being more likely. Still... we can potentially help you and your precious fleet, but you'll need to prove yourself first. Meet us at these coordinates." They jump away.
wiki.quests-a.one-ship-is-not-the-same: "One ship is not the same as a fleet, but at least you've got some fire. Meet us at these coordinates if you want to prove to us that the Federation is worth saving." They jump away.
wiki.quests-a.heh-like-i-expected-if-the: "Heh. Like I expected. If the Federation is as weak as you it deserves to fall." They jump away without another word.
wiki.quests-a.the-rock-ship-starts-to-po: The Rock ship starts to power up their FTL drive. If we're going to earn their trust we must endure the heat for as long as they can!
wiki.quests-a.you-charge-your-weapons-no: You charge your weapons - not that this will take much.
wiki.quests-a.they-are-clearly-not-putti: They are clearly not putting up a fight. Are you sure you want to destroy them?
wiki.quests-a.just-as-you-re-preparing-t: Just as you're preparing to attack you detect a nearby jump signature. A Zoltan defense ship comes to their aid!
wiki.quests-a.you-power-down-your-weapon: You power down your weapons and after a time the ship slowly limps away. They refuse all communications. You can't help but feel somewhat guilty.
wiki.quests-a.they-continue-we-take-your:
They continue. "We take your silence for interested contemplation." They talk at length about peace and harmony, but either it's beyond your simple mind or it's all nonsense.

They finish: "Please, spread the word of enlightenment to those that have not heard. Once you have, contact our brethren." They transmit coordinates of their so-called "brethren".
wiki.quests-a.the-galaxy-is-at-war-there: The galaxy is at war - there's no time for talk of peace. You leave their hails unanswered and charge the jump drive.
wiki.quests-a.you-power-your-weapons-and: You power your weapons and prepare to fight.
wiki.quests-a.they-open-communications-i: They open communications: "I can't imagine there's anything you could say that will save you. The rebellion must destroy those that are still loyal to the obsolete Federation."
wiki.quests-a.perhaps-there-could-be-a-r: "Perhaps there could be a reconciliation of our ideals without war?"
wiki.quests-a.surrender-your-ultimate-de: "Surrender. Your ultimate destruction is inevitable. We've left scores of Rebels destroyed in our wake."
wiki.quests-a.your-rebellion-is-causing-: "Your Rebellion is causing millions of deaths. Your beliefs are dividing the galaxy. Unity is the only option!"
wiki.quests-a.our-ideals-are-too-differe: "Our ideals are too different to be so easily reconciled. You think this could end any way but war?"
wiki.quests-a.the-galaxy-is-huge-you-can: The galaxy is huge, you can find a place for your ideals elsewhere without causing this destruction.
wiki.quests-a.true-progress-can-only-be-: True progress can only be achieved without bloodshed.
wiki.quests-a.no-we-will-not-be-consigne: "No! We will not be consigned to the backwaters of space just because we don't fit into your 'Federation ideals'" They charge.
wiki.quests-a.they-shut-off-communicatio: They shut off communications and immediately engage.
wiki.quests-a.humans-are-treated-as-equa: "Humans are treated as 'equal' to aliens in the weak Federation. The sacrifice of BILLIONS of alien or human lives are justified if it means we reach our full potential!" They charge.
