wiki.quests-a.suddenly-all-indications-o: Suddenly all indications of the Rebel ship fade away and a Zoltan fleet appears around your ship. The captain of the ship you met previously materializes on your bridge.
wiki.quests-a.although-your-methods-are-: "Although your methods are crude and most certainly ineffective, it is clear you took our previous meeting to heart. If your ship represents the Federation's willingness to adapt we shall do what we can to aid in their fight.
wiki.quests-a.this-technology-should-aid:
{{intro}}

{{said}} This technology should aid your quest."
wiki.quests-a.your-crew-calmly-lines-up-: Your crew calmly lines up for the Zoltans to take their readings. After a short time, the process is done. They contact you, "Thank you for your participation in our study. Please accept these small cakes made from stiff dough as well as some scrap."
wiki.quests-a.as-soon-as-you-dock-pirate: As soon as you dock, pirates burst on board and a hostile ship appears on the radar. You hear the Zoltans yell in the distance, "We're being held hostage!"
wiki.quests-a.alright-fly-safe-you-prepa: "Alright. Fly safe." You prepare to leave.
wiki.quests-a.thank-you-we-didn-t-expect: "Thank you! We didn't expect to receive such a significant amount of data regarding your crew's health during FTL travel. Please, accept this for your trouble."
wiki.quests-a.thank-you-for-rescuing-us-: "Thank you for rescuing us! They held us hostage to ambush unsuspecting passersby. Please, take this."
wiki.quests-a.they-don-t-see-many-of: They don't see many of your species in these parts, and you stick out like a Casvagarian Sea Slug in a Plutonian Shrimp Stew. You make it back to the ship with a gang of Zoltan guards in tow!
wiki.quests-a.you-pose-as-traders-and-su: You pose as traders and succeed in bypassing airlock security - however, it's only a matter of time before someone realizes your ID cards are counterfeit!
wiki.quests-a.you-re-materialize-in-a-da: You re-materialize in a dark corner of the main concourse and are able to conduct your investigations in peace.
wiki.quests-a.they-scan-id-that-declares: They scan ID that declares your crewmember an official citizen, collect their fee, and let you pass.
wiki.quests-a.you-don-t-have-the-papers: You don't have the papers - well, the neuro-laced identity bracelets - to get in, so best not to try.
wiki.quests-a.you-surprise-me-off-worlde: "You surprise me, off-worlder. Thank you. The passenger will be with you momentarily." She refuses to enter the main hold and prefers to wait in the cargo bay.
wiki.quests-a.arranged-marriages-aren-t-: Arranged marriages aren't on your list of worthy causes. You leave the Rock to their business.
wiki.quests-a.may-your-children-erode-in: "May your children erode into dust!" she screams as she's bundled into the waiting shuttle. The Rock guards on board hurriedly drop off an exotic piece of technology and return to the Grand Basilisk.
wiki.quests-a.ask-if-they-can-fix-this: Ask if they can fix this.
wiki.quests-a.interesting-i-ve-never-see:
"Interesting. I've never seen a cryogenic system like this. It appears to still be functioning..." They hook it up to their system and run a number of tests on it.

"Amazing! It has the ability to reconstruct the body if it was damaged during transit. Watch." They reactivate the pod and you watch as the hunks of crystal inside reform to build a humanoid structure. The pod slides open and the re-formed alien steps out.

It speaks slowly, "Greetings. I appear to be in your debt. My people isolated themselves a long time ago, but perhaps it's time to re-establish a connection. There's a hidden wormhole near the Rock home-worlds. Perhaps you can take me there so I can properly repay you?"
wiki.quests-a.the-rebel-contacts-you-lov: The Rebel contacts you. "Lovely, you've done our job for us! We'll let you live as thanks. However, I can't promise the fleet will show you the same courtesy." They jump off. You collect what you can from the remains of the Zoltan ship.
wiki.quests-a.the-zoltan-hail-once-the-s: The Zoltan hail once the smoke disperses. "Thank you. We were led to believe Federation ideals died along with the Federation itself. Let us aid you a little, for old times' sake." You accept their reward and scrap, then collect some remains from the Rebel ship.
wiki.quests-a.i-was-led-to-believe-your: "I was led to believe your kind did not know mercy. I will join you. But quickly, we must jump away - they will not tolerate..." She's interrupted by weapons fire from the Basilisk's escort!
wiki.quests-a.you-can-t-help-but-feel: You can't help but feel somewhat guilty as you search through the debris. It was probably a trap... right?
wiki.quests-a.you-begin-to-strip-their-s: You begin to strip their ship and don't find anything that would indicate they were on anything other than a peaceful mission. Perhaps you were too hasty.
wiki.quests-a.you-defeat-your-assailant-: You defeat your assailant, but the peace ship has jumped away in the commotion.
wiki.quests-a.their-ship-breaks-apart-an: Their ship breaks apart and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.
wiki.quests-a.their-ship-goes-quiet-and-: Their ship goes quiet and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.
wiki.quests-a.you-take-out-the-ship-and: You take out the ship and contact the research station.
wiki.quests-a.you-disable-the-ship-and-c: You disable the ship and contact the research station.
wiki.quests-a.his-escort-eliminated-the-: His escort eliminated, the Grand Basilisk dispatches his entire fleet. There's just time to take your pick from the wreck before you jump out of reach.
wiki.quests-a.as-they-jump-away-they-rel: As they jump away they relay coordinates to your navigation system. They must mean for you to follow them!
wiki.quests-b.a-fire-and-a-breach-break: A fire and a breach break out.
wiki.quests-b.rebel-fleet-pursuit-is-dou: Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled for 1 jump.
wiki.quests-b.try-to-shield-their-ship-w: Try to shield their ship with yours and escort them out of the field.
wiki.quests-b.don-t-risk-our-ship-leave: Don't risk our ship. Leave them to their fate.
wiki.quests-b.use-a-defense-drone-to-pro: Use a Defense Drone to protect their ship.
wiki.quests-b.send-a-repair-drone-to-fix: Send a Repair Drone to fix their Shields.
wiki.quests-b.offer-to-beam-them-aboard-: Offer to beam them aboard your ship.
wiki.quests-b.shield-their-ship-with-you: Shield their ship with yours and escort them out.
wiki.quests-b.they-respond-help-our-shie: They respond: "Help! Our shields are down and we won't last long!"
wiki.quests-b.your-drone-succeeds-in-kee: Your drone succeeds in keeping their ship from breaking apart while they fix it, however you take some damage while attempting to leave the asteroid field. They offer you some military supplies as thanks for saving them.
wiki.quests-b.the-drone-keeps-the-ship-s: The drone keeps the ship stable enough to allow them to escape the asteroid field. They message you with map coordinates, "You're that Federation ship the Rebels are after, aren't you? I can't offer much but I heard there was a Federation loyalist base nearby. Maybe they can help you?"
wiki.quests-b.they-quickly-scan-your-shi: They quickly scan your ship and say, "It appears you could help. A bandit has made off with some very important cargo, though I doubt they have any understanding of what it is they stole. We need you to capture the ship intact."
wiki.quests-b.they-thank-you-for-the-ass: They thank you for the assistance and when you tell them of your mission, one of the Engi asks if he can assist your crew. You welcome him aboard.
wiki.quests-b.the-station-was-in-the-pro: The station was in the process of being evacuated. A number of civilian Engi offer their gratitude as they finalize their preparations to leave. They offer some fuel as a reward.
wiki.quests-b.the-engi-station-is-stripp: The Engi station is stripped bare and there are signs of a fierce battle. The Mantis must have left the distress call active to lure other ships into a trap.
wiki.quests-b.threat-unresolved-current-: Threat unresolved. Current Mission imperative: Protocol 52.34.
wiki.quests-b.the-station-hails-you-grat: The station hails you, "Gratitude. Expected probability of defeat without assistance... 86.2 percent. Request suitable reward."
wiki.quests-b.the-cargo-was-some-food-an: The cargo was some food and medical supplies, nothing that you need right now. You make a note of the delivery destination in case you want to drop off the cargo for the payment.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-prototype-weapo: You find a prototype weapon inside. You quickly install it on the ship.
wiki.quests-b.there-were-general-militar: There were general military supplies in the cargo crates. You take what you can use.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-the-small-researc:
{{intro}}

You find the small research station and discover that it's putting out a distress signal. Strangely, there is no response to your hails.
wiki.quests-b.dock-with-the-station-and-: Dock with the station and investigate.
wiki.quests-b.you-send-your-anti-personn: You send your Anti-Personnel drone to explore the station. What you find is disconcerting... It appears that something has caused the scientists and guards to tear each other to pieces. You abandon the drone on the station for fear that it is contagious.
wiki.quests-b.once-on-board-the-station-: Once on board the station, your drone is immediately beset by frenzied scientists and guards. It eventually gets torn apart by the mob but it has bought you enough time to disengage from the station and escape into empty space.
wiki.quests-b.the-cameras-mounted-to-you: The cameras mounted to your Anti-Personnel drone show a chaotic scene. No people are to be found but the remnants of a recent battle on-board the ship are obvious. You instruct the drone to retrieve some useful materials before leaving.
wiki.quests-b.there-are-no-life-signs-de: There are no life signs detected on the ship although there appears to be a number of deceased crew. There does not appear to be any airborn contagions so your crew quickly salvages what they can before moving on. You can only wonder what befell the station.
wiki.quests-b.sensors-show-scattered-sig: Sensors show scattered signs of life although most of the crew are deceased. However the health signatures of the living indicate they are violent and unstable. You decide it's better to move on than risk engaging the remaining crew.
wiki.quests-b.inside-there-are-signs-of-: Inside there are signs of a great struggle; scientists lie dead where they fell, brutally dismembered. You grab a few research drone parts lying on a desk near the door and leave quickly.
wiki.quests-b.have-the-advanced-medbay-a: Have the advanced medbay analyze their condition.
wiki.quests-b.you-dock-with-the-station-:
You dock with the station and see a frantic person banging on the airlock door. Once inside your ship, he drops to the floor saying, "My... friends... They've gone insane... They're coming!" You hand him a blaster and turn to see a number of people charging toward the ship.

{{joined}}
wiki.quests-b.drag-him-back-to-the-ship: Drag him back to the ship and prepare for a fight.
wiki.quests-b.use-your-teleporter-to-ret: Use your Teleporter to retrieve your crew.
wiki.quests-b.drag-him-back-to-the-medba: Drag him back to the Medbay.
wiki.quests-b.have-the-advanced-medbay-a: Have the Advanced Medbay analyze their condition.
wiki.quests-b.as-you-explore-the-base-cr: As you explore the base, crazed screams are heard. Your team retreats back to your ship with a number of armed scientists in pursuit. One of your team starts to cough and falls in a spasm onto the floor.
wiki.quests-b.leave-the-battlefield-befo: Leave the battlefield before other ships arrive.
wiki.quests-b.explain-about-finding-the-: Explain about finding the dead crewman.
wiki.quests-b.a-zoltan-ship-decloaks-and: A Zoltan ship decloaks and demands your reason for being here!
wiki.quests-b.there-is-a-moment-of-silen: There is a moment of silence, and suddenly the Zoltan ship cloaks - must have been the wrong word to use... now you've got a fight on your hands!

{{lead}}There is a moment of silence, and the ship's captain solemnly thanks you for the information. He wishes you well on your journey, and he offers several upgrades to assist you in exchange for your service to the Zoltan race.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-the-ship-that-you: You find the ship that you were asked to capture intact. You're not sure why, but they stressed that it's of great importance that you kill the crew WITHOUT destroying the ship.
wiki.quests-b.you-arrive-at-the-location: You arrive at the location given to you by the merchant. You are supposed to deliver drone parts to a station here.
wiki.quests-b.refuse-and-keep-the-drone-: Refuse and keep the drone parts.
wiki.quests-b.remain-silent-but-power-up: Remain silent but power up your weapons.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-the-station-and-t:
{{intro}}

You find the station and they respond to your hails immediately, saying, "It took you long enough! We have practically no use for these now... I refuse to pay full price, take this and leave the cargo in our holds."
wiki.quests-b.you-arrive-at-the-last-kno: You arrive at the last known location of the merchant's delivery. You begin to scan for the lost ship.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-the-remains-of-th:
{{intro}}

You find the remains of the ship. It seems to have severe external damage, but you cannot pinpoint a cause. The majority of its cargo seems intact. You manage to discern the ship's intended destination.
wiki.quests-b.take-the-cargo-and-head-to: Take the cargo and head to its original destination in search of a reward.
wiki.quests-b.promise-to-deliver-the-car: Promise to deliver the cargo and ask if any would be interested in joining your crew.
wiki.quests-b.take-the-cargo-but-drop-th: Take the cargo but drop them off at a nearby station.
wiki.quests-b.beam-the-cargo-aboard-and-: Beam the cargo aboard and leave them to their fate.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-severely-damage:
{{intro}}

You find a severely damaged ship floating among some debris. The crew hails you, "I can't believe that cheap bastard sent someone after us! I thought we would freeze to death. If you help us complete the delivery, we'll share the reward and join your crew."
wiki.quests-b.after-a-quick-scan-you-fin:
{{intro}}

After a quick scan, you find a ship being chased by a pirate. This must be the missing delivery ship! You move in to rescue them.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-the-station-that-: You find the station that had ordered your cargo. You drop it off and they respond, "Ignoring the fact that this is days late, we really appreciate that you delivered our materials. We realize how dangerous this sector is these days. Take this as payment."
wiki.quests-b.ask-your-slug-crewmember-t: Ask your Slug crewmember to scan for life forms.
wiki.quests-b.do-a-full-system-scan-thou: Do a full system scan - though you're sure to lose some of your lead with the Rebels.
wiki.quests-b.you-have-arrived-at-the-co: You have arrived at the coordinates given to you by the dead crewman you attempted to save. There doesn't seem to be anything here - no planets, no vessels, and no clue as to what he meant by sending you here.
wiki.quests-b.you-succeed-in-preventing-: You succeed in preventing them from being entirely destroyed, but your ship took a number of hits in the process. They offer some of the scrap and fuel they were mining out of the asteroid as thanks.
wiki.quests-b.despite-your-best-efforts-: Despite your best efforts, the civilian ship breaks apart from the constant barrage. You are barely able to break out of the asteroid field yourself. The ship sustains some damage in the process.
wiki.quests-b.you-try-your-best-but-one: You try your best but one stray rock hits a key structure in their ship. It breaks apart in front of your eyes. You salvage what you can before leaving, and try not to think about the lost crew.
wiki.quests-b.you-regretfully-leave-the-: You regretfully leave the area, not able to watch them get destroyed. A short while later you get a second message, "We survived, no thanks to you! Don't think I don't know that the Rebels are hunting for you. I'll be sure to tell them where you are the next time I see them!"
wiki.quests-b.you-watch-helplessly-as-th: You watch helplessly as their ship smashes against a cruiser-sized rock...
wiki.quests-b.they-reluctantly-agree-onc: They reluctantly agree. Once aboard, you watch as their ship crashes against a massive rock. They thank you, but say "I don't know what we'll do without our ship. As the Captain, I feel obligated to help you with your mission."
wiki.quests-b.they-refuse-at-first-but-a: They refuse at first, but after another blast rocks their ship they agree and beam aboard your ship. They say, "Thank you but we really should return to our families... I'm sure we can muster up a reward if you take us home."
wiki.quests-b.take-them-to-the-nearby-pl: Take them to the nearby planet, where they're from.
wiki.quests-b.the-family-apparently-owns: The family apparently owns one of the most valuable mining enterprises in the sector. For the safe return of his son, the patron of the family offers you a substantial reward.
wiki.quests-b.the-survivor-s-family-is-o: The survivor's family is of modest means, yet they manage to offer you a reward for your virtuous deed.
wiki.quests-b.overjoyed-with-the-return-: Overjoyed with the return of their son, the family of the survivor arranges to repair your ship's hull as compensation.
wiki.quests-b.you-succeed-in-preventing-: You succeed in preventing them from being entirely destroyed, your improved hull taking the brunt of the asteroids that make it past your defenses. They offer you some of the scrap and fuel they were mining out of the asteroid as thanks.
wiki.quests-b.they-briefly-scan-your-shi: They briefly scan your ship and inform you that you are not "properly equipped" for this type of mission.
wiki.quests-b.if-they-wanted-your-help-t: If they wanted your help they would surely ask for it. You prepare to leave.
wiki.quests-b.great-we-ll-relay-their-co: "Great, we'll relay their coordinates. Remember, do NOT destroy that ship! Remember, we'll be right behind you."
wiki.quests-b.we-understand-hopefully-we: "We understand. Hopefully we can find a solution to this on our own." You prepare to jump.
wiki.quests-b.the-pirate-ship-moves-to-e: The pirate ship moves to engage.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-secret-federati: You find a secret federation outpost. They are regrettably out of supplies but are eager to tell you of another secret base. They give you the coordinates.
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-hidden-federati: You find a hidden federation outpost. They message you, "Quick, we just got word from a sister outpost that they've been discovered by the Rebels and are under attack! If you are still loyal to the Federation, go save them!"
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-small-cache-of: You find a small cache of supplies that were surely left for any loyal Federation ships in trouble. You take all that you need, leaving some for others to find.
wiki.quests-b.as-you-approach-the-signal: As you approach the signal you receive a message on a Rebel channel, "I knew we'd catch some Federation fish with this signal. Prepare to be boarded, scum!"
wiki.quests-b.you-find-a-secret-federati: You find a secret Federation outpost... but it appears the Rebels have found it before you; the place is empty and faint bloodstains can be seen in the living quarters. You find the encrypted signal emitter and shut it off before leaving.
wiki.quests-b.you-approach-to-find-a-man: You approach to find a Mantis ship assaulting a small Engi space station. You prepare for a fight!
wiki.quests-b.you-receive-another-messag: You receive another message from the ship, this time with a Mantis at the comm-log. "Foolish meatsacks," he yells. Sensors indicate the ship is moving in to attack and boarders teleport from the station.
wiki.quests-b.they-respond-understood-re: They respond, "Understood. Re-establishment of Federation highest import. Transmitting hidden base coordinates. Repairing hull and attaching ship to ship ordnance."
wiki.quests-b.great-i-was-worried-no-one: "Great, I was worried no one would respond. My usual carrier is days late. I need you to deliver this cargo of drone parts to a small station a few jumps from here. I'll pay you a bit of scrap now, but they will surely tip you generously."
wiki.quests-b.your-ship-seems-reasonably: "Your ship seems reasonably equipped... A freighter carrying a shipment of my goods is a week late. The fools flew through a pirate-filled sector in their haste and I fear for the cargo's safety. I'm looking for a less incompetent captain to investigate."
wiki.quests-b.great-i-uploaded-their-loc: Great! I uploaded their location to your star map. I'm running out of options, so I have no choice but to trust you'll do what you have agreed to do.
wiki.quests-b.fine-i-ll-keep-looking-for: "Fine, I'll keep looking for someone who wishes to make some easy money..."
wiki.quests-b.at-least-you-re-confident-: "At least you're confident, for what little that's worth. Here is their last known location."
wiki.quests-b.at-least-you-are-willing-t: "At least YOU are willing to admit your incompetence. Thank you for saving me the cost of paying more fools to go to their death."
wiki.quests-b.you-drop-the-parts-off-and: You drop the parts off and take your pay.
wiki.quests-b.fine-i-was-bluffing-i-ll: "Fine, I was bluffing. I'll pay the full price."
wiki.quests-b.the-merchant-disconnects-i: The merchant disconnects in a huff.
wiki.quests-b.i-m-being-unfair-you-did: "I'm being unfair. You did the job and the parts are here safe and sound. Here is the agreed upon amount."
wiki.quests-b.you-make-a-good-point-you: "You make a good point. You traveled all the way out here to fulfill our request, despite what must have been... a difficult scenario to cause such a delay. Here, we'll even tip you for the inconvenience you must have gone through..."
wiki.quests-b.they-upload-the-delivery-d: They upload the delivery destination once on board. One takes you up on your offer, the rest you drop off at a nearby station.
wiki.quests-b.you-hold-them-off-while-re: You hold them off while retreating into the med-bay. Its advanced systems determine that an alien neurotoxin is the cause of their frenzy. It synthesizes an antidote and releases it into the room. After a time, the scientists recover. One offers their services as thanks for saving them.
wiki.quests-b.as-you-get-back-on-board: As you get back on board, your injured friend rises up and starts to attack you, screaming. Caught off-guard, your remaining crew fall back as the other scientists fight their way onto the ship.
wiki.quests-b.you-beam-your-away-team-ba: You beam your away team back to the ship and disengage from the station. Although the ship is safe, the infected crew member quickly becomes frenzied and attacks.
wiki.quests-b.you-hold-him-down-and-the: You hold him down and the medbay is able to stop whatever neurotoxin was on the ship from fully infecting your crew. Once he recovers, you prepare to fight off the scientists, who are beyond help.
wiki.quests-b.you-hold-them-off-while-re: You hold them off while retreating into the med-bay. Its advanced systems determine that an alien neurotoxin is driving your crew member insane. It synthesizes an antidote and releases it into the ship. After a time, the frenzied scientists recover and one offers to help out as thanks for saving them.
wiki.quests-b.despite-the-destruction-fi: Despite the destruction filling the system, your crewman is able to pick up the faint thoughts of a life form in the debris - it looks like they won't last much longer without help.
wiki.quests-b.the-wreckage-is-drifting-f: The wreckage is drifting faster than it first appeared. You barely avoid being pummeled by drifting wreckage - unable to detect anything of interest, you decide not to risk your ship and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests-b.as-you-investigate-the-bat: As you investigate the battlefield, your ship is pummeled by drifting wreckage - unable to detect anything of interest, you decide not to risk any further damage to your hull and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests-b.you-spot-a-life-form-float: You spot a life form floating within the wreckage.
wiki.quests-b.make-them-comfortable-for-: Make them comfortable for their final moments.
wiki.quests-b.try-to-clone-them-before-i: Try to clone them before it's too late.
wiki.quests-b.you-bring-the-survivor-abo: You bring the survivor aboard, but discover their wounds are severe. They won't live much longer.
wiki.quests-b.on-their-death-bed-they-cr: On their death bed, they croak out a series of coordinates and beg you to go there - when you attempt to ask them why, the survivor simply says, "ABADOTH" and perishes.
wiki.quests-b.using-your-upgraded-medica: Using your upgraded medical bay, you are able to heal the survivor's wounds and they recover quickly. Grateful to be saved, they offer to join your crew and help however they can.
wiki.quests-b.you-clone-the-individual-a: You clone the individual and let the host pass away. The clone decides to join you - although it has little choice in the matter.
wiki.quests-b.you-start-the-arduous-task:
You start the arduous task of a full system scan. This better be worth it.

{{line}}
wiki.quests-b.your-engi-crewman-easily-r: Your Engi crewman easily recalls the phrase the deadman used from its memory banks.
wiki.quests-b.you-secure-the-ship-and-wa: You secure the ship and wait for the merchants to arrive. Upon arrival they message you, saying "Good job. We would prefer if you did not speak of this to anyone."
wiki.quests-b.the-explosion-rocks-the-pi: The explosion rocks the pirate ship and a brilliant light begins to shine from the wreckage. Before you can react the ship is consumed in a massive chain of explosions that send you careening toward a nearby planet. You struggle to put out the fires and your pilot desperately tries to get the controls online before you're dragged down to the surface. Apparently when they said the ship should not be destroyed they had good reason...
wiki.quests-b.no-more-life-signs-detecte: No more life signs detected on the Mantis ship. You hasten to contact the Engi.
wiki.quests-b.you-contact-the-delivery-s: You contact the delivery ship, who are grateful for your assistance. They offer you a reward for saving them.
wiki.quests.added-a-quest-marker-to-your: Added a quest marker to your map!
wiki.quests.added-a-quest-marker-to-the: Added a quest marker to the next sector!
wiki.quests.upon-examining-your-map-you-: Upon examining your map, you realize you just won't have time and need to get to the Federation base! You leave the quest for another day.
wiki.quests.no-room-on-this-map-for: No room on this map for the quest marker.
wiki.quests.give-them-40-scrap-2-missile: Give them 40 scrap, 2 missiles and 2 fuel.
wiki.quests.you-are-hailed-thank-you-it: You are hailed, "Thank you! It's not much but we can repair a bit of damage before you jump off into the war. Good luck!"
wiki.quests.the-survivors-send-a-message: The survivors send a message, "Thanks for the support, I don't know how much longer we could have held on. Take some supplies, we probably won't need them at this point."
wiki.quests.the-people-you-rescued-were-: The people you rescued were primarily refugees fleeing the conflict. They offer you their sincere gratitude.
wiki.quests.the-rebels-destroyed-you-pic: The rebels destroyed, you pick the bones of their ship and wait for the small Engi ship to catch up. The Engi vessel turns out to be very poorly equipped - barely a runabout, really. They're trying to outrun the rebels, and need all the help they can get.
wiki.quests.the-engies-are-grateful-they: The Engies are grateful. They don't have any supplies or weapons to spare, but they do send over a self-teleporting med-bot disperser they hope they won't need.
The Engies are grateful. They don't have much by way of supplies but they do offer a drone schematic for your use.
wiki.quests.the-words-they-use-are-need: The words they use are "Need = fulfilled", but you take it for gratitude. They take the next jump in their long journey home.
wiki.quests.no-free-augmentation-slot-fo: No free augmentation slot for {{name}}: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.quests.there-is-no-room-aboard-for: There is no room aboard for the new crewmember.
wiki.quests.even-if-there-was-something-: Even if there was something malicious in the drink, you doubt it would affect the Rock digestive system. The Slug casually celebrates your newfound trust by repairing part of your ship and offering to sell you his wares.
wiki.quests.you-take-a-cautious-gulp-it: You take a cautious gulp. It's foul, but doesn't do any lasting damage. It's a thousand to one chance, but this Slug actually seems to be trustworthy. He casually celebrates your newfound trust by repairing part of your ship and offering to sell you his wares.
wiki.quests.your-crewmember-is-able-to-i: Your crewmember is able to identify a heavy anaesthetic contained in the flask when he feels slightly drowsy (the Rock digestion system is very robust). His ruse discovered, the Slug immediately returns to his ship and opens fire.
wiki.quests.you-take-one-gulp-and-wake: You take one gulp and wake up with the rest of the crew in the cargo hold... which contains noticeably less scrap than before.
wiki.quests.the-vessel-appears-to-be-dor: The vessel appears to be dormant. It is likely there are Lanius on board, but they may be in hibernation until the ship comes within range of new materials.
wiki.quests.navigate-carefully-around-th: Navigate carefully around the ship and strip what materials from the hull you can.
wiki.quests.send-over-a-lanius-crewmembe: Send over a Lanius crewmember to plunder the ship of resources.
wiki.quests.engage-the-autopilot-to-stri: Engage the autopilot to strip the ship safely.
wiki.quests.you-escort-the-ship-to-the: You escort the ship to the requested beacon. Much to your dismay you are ambushed by a Rebel ship. You walked right into their trap!
wiki.quests.shortly-after-you-arrive-the: Shortly after you arrive, the ship you were escorting jumps nearby. They thank you for your help and offer you a reward.
wiki.quests.the-ship-you-were-escorting-: The ship you were escorting thanks you, "I don't think we could have made it without your help. Let my friends patch up some of your hull and show you their wares."
wiki.quests.could-not-upgrade-the-reacto: Could not upgrade the Reactor, it's maxed
wiki.quests.you-arrive-and-the-ship-you: You arrive and the ship you were escorting jumps in behind you. "Thanks for the help. We work at a nearby fusion power plant, we could try to improve your reactor's output as a form of compensation."
wiki.quests.you-find-the-missing-cargo-s: You find the missing cargo ship docked to a Rebel station. You send a short-band message to them and discover they are being held against their will and forced to 'donate to their supplies for the war effort.'
wiki.quests.attack-the-rebels-to-help-th: Attack the Rebels to help them escape.
wiki.quests.you-find-the-missing-cargo-s: You find the missing cargo ship docked to an empty space station. However their hold appears to be empty and there are no obvious signs that anyone is inside the ship or station. Everything looks abandoned.
wiki.quests.move-in-to-examine-the-stati: Move in to examine the station.
wiki.quests.you-find-the-missing-cargo-s: You find the missing cargo ship floating near the beacon. "Thank heavens! We've been drifting here after using the last of our fuel to escape a pirate raid."
wiki.quests.you-arrive-in-the-sector-to: You arrive in the sector to see a small Federation outpost using their Anti-Ship Battery to fire at an automated drone. Debris from other ships is strewn around the area. It looks like the brunt of the battle is already over. You move in to assist.
wiki.quests.you-arrive-in-the-sector-to-: You arrive in the sector to see the Federation outpost under fire from multiple Rebel ships. However, as you approach they get their Anti-Ship Battery online and disable two of the smaller ships. You swoop in to assist, taking down the wing leader.
You arrive in the sector to see a small outpost being bombarded by an automated drone. This must be the Federation base you were told about!
wiki.quests.you-find-the-planet-at-the: You find the planet at the indicated coordinates. Your initial scans show the planet to be barren and devoid of life, but you get a prompt reply when you broadcast on Federation frequencies. "Hello! So nice to see friends. We'll bring you up some supplies."
wiki.quests.by-following-the-directions-: By following the directions given to you, you find a well-disguised outpost. You are welcomed by a friendly face who offers to assist you in your quest by joining your crew.
wiki.quests.after-a-quick-search-you-dis: After a quick search you discover the hidden Federation space-dock. They offer you some supplies in addition to fully repairing your ship.
wiki.quests.you-search-near-the-coordina: You search near the coordinates given to you, but your search yields no results. Perhaps they were mistaken.
wiki.quests.teleport-fire-bombs-into-key: Teleport fire bombs into key structures.
wiki.quests.you-find-the-mantis-encampme: You find the Mantis encampment but there are far too many of them to count accurately. You send a long range message back to the settlement with your findings but unfortunately there's not much you can do. It would be suicide to attack directly.
wiki.quests.arriving-at-the-specified-co: Arriving at the specified coordinates, you find a sizable stash of useful materials.
wiki.quests.you-arrive-at-location-of-th: You arrive at location of the hoard, but discover that it was not quite as large as advertised.
wiki.quests.you-catch-up-with-the-mantis:
You catch up with the Mantis ship that escaped before, only to see them transferring their crew into an even bigger ship!

"Not YOU again! Do you know how much these repairs are going to cost me? Time to take out the big guns."
wiki.quests.you-arrive-at-small-asteroid: You arrive at small asteroid field and discover the hidden cache among the debris. You input the codes given to you by KazaaakplethKilik and find a weapon inside.
wiki.quests.you-catch-up-with-the-two:
You catch up with the two Slug ships and they're already carrying out their raid! One is in close combat with the pirate, the other seems to be heading for a small space cache the pirate was protecting.

Suddenly the first ship bursts into flames, and an urgent call arrives from the remaining Slugs. "We sssugest you distract the pirate vesssel while we retrieve the valuables. Fifty fifty sssplit."
wiki.quests.you-arrive-at-one-of-the: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one scout ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.
wiki.quests.you-have-finally-caught-up-w: You have finally caught up with the ships you've been hunting. A hangar-sized cargo ship is being escorted by a number of Mantis ships. As you reconsider the assault, a squadron of Engi ships with pirate emblems jump in and assist you. You prepare to fight the Mantis but scans indicate they are manned by Rebels!
wiki.quests.you-arrive-to-discover-an-im: You arrive to discover an impressive cruiser being worked on by a few smaller ships and guarded by an assault ship. The mobile construction platform is slowly slipping into the clouds. You have not yet been noticed.
wiki.quests.try-to-tail-them-without-bei: Try to tail them without being noticed.
wiki.quests.once-you-arrive-at-the-beaco: Once you arrive at the beacon you detect a Rebel scout assaulting a compound on a nearby desolate moon.
wiki.quests.engage-the-rebel-and-rescue-: Engage the Rebel and rescue the space dock.
wiki.quests.quickly-try-to-rescue-the-cr: Quickly try to rescue the crew.
wiki.quests.pump-their-ship-with-nano-me: Pump their ship with Nano Med-bots to aid in the rescue.
wiki.quests.lock-on-to-all-remaining-lif: Lock on to all remaining life signatures and beam them onto your ship.
wiki.quests.use-a-healing-bomb-to-keep: Use a healing bomb to keep them alive.
wiki.quests.you-launch-a-healing-bomb:
You launch a healing bomb into their ship and the Nanobots are able to keep the crew stabilized. Once they come to, you send over some supplies to keep them healthy enough to get to friendly territory.

Now that they're safe an engineer offers to join your crew and the rest tell you of a hidden Federation base a few jumps from here.
wiki.quests.their-ship-looks-to-be-on: Their ship looks to be on the verge of destruction and life signs are fading quickly.
wiki.quests.put-him-out-of-his-misery: Put him out of his misery.
wiki.quests.dock-and-try-to-speak-with: Dock and try to speak with him.
wiki.quests.listen-to-what-he-has-to: Listen to what he has to say.
wiki.quests.dock-and-quickly-take-him-ba: Dock and quickly take him back to the medbay.
wiki.quests.quickly-teleport-him-back-to: Quickly teleport him back to the medbay.
wiki.quests.quickly-configure-the-cloneb: Quickly configure the Clonebay to save him.
wiki.quests.you-detect-kazaaakplethkilik: You detect KazaaakplethKilik slumped in a corner dying.
wiki.quests.you-find-kazaaakplethkilik-s: You find KazaaakplethKilik slumped in a corner dying.
wiki.quests.the-engi-emerge-victorious-f: The Engi emerge victorious from their battles with only minor losses. They message you, "Project X-ME56 commissioned by Federation military research division. Advanced stealth cruiser. Project finished during rebellion. Unable to reconnect with Federation military command."
wiki.quests.you-accidentally-reactivate-: You accidentally reactivate the ships AI. Its weapons and shields immediately go online; prepare for a fight!
wiki.quests.you-are-able-to-pull-all: You are able to pull all of the ship's data about this sector. Your map has been updated.
wiki.quests.the-refueling-station-welcom: The refueling station welcomes you into one of its berths, and as you hail them, there is an explosion from your engine room! While assessing the damage, you detect a Pirate Ship closing fast!
wiki.quests.you-make-the-preparations-to: You make the preparations to leave. One of the civilian leaders contacts you: "That Rebel was our sole source of supplies. You have doomed us all."
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-civilians-with: You leave the civilians with the supplies, though without the Rebel that was running supplies to them its unlikely they'll live long.
wiki.quests.you-wonder-if-any-more-rebel: You wonder if any more Rebels will be available to help these civilians on the edge of nowhere. Oh well, for you a few more dead Rebels matter more than the lives of a thousand colonists.
wiki.quests.before-your-ftl-drive-charge: Before your FTL drive charges, you receive a hail: "My son was on that ship. He only helped the Rebels because they cared enough to help us. Without him to find us supplies, we'll likely be forgotten and die out here."
wiki.quests.the-colonists-hand-over-the-: The colonists hand over the supplies. It appears to be mostly equipment meant for automated farming, but you can make use of it. As you leave, you receive a message: "This is why the Rebels will always have support!"
wiki.quests.you-make-the-colonists-telep: You make the colonists teleport the supplies to your ship. It's nothing more than building construction supplies. Oh well, scrap is scrap.
wiki.quests.the-colonists-willingly-give: The colonists willingly give up their supplies. But as you make to jump away, an explosion rocks your ship. The cargo was booby-trapped!
wiki.quests.the-colonists-hand-over-the-: The colonists hand over the supplies and you load it onto your ship. As you jump away, you crack it open and discover nothing more than vaccinations for a local plague.
wiki.quests.with-the-rebel-crew-dead-you: With the Rebel crew dead, you strip their ship for equipment. They had already made their delivery to the civilians.
wiki.quests.with-the-rebel-ship-destroye: With the Rebel ship destroyed, you take the time to collect what little scrap remains. They had already made the delivery to the civilians.
wiki.quests.offer-to-hire-him-for-40: Offer to hire him for 40 scrap.
wiki.quests.the-last-pirate-life-signs-b: The last pirate life-signs blink out and the Zoltan returns to his bridge. "Egalitarianism is a cornerstone of successful cohabitation. Please, enjoy the fruits of your labor."
wiki.quests.you-salvage-what-you-can-fro: You salvage what you can from the ship.
wiki.quests.the-zoltan-looks-deeply-diss: The Zoltan looks deeply dissatisfied with your aiming and demands to be dropped off at your earliest convenience.
wiki.quests.he-responds-defeatedly-i-sup: He responds defeatedly, "I suppose I have nowhere else to go without a ship. I accept your offer."
wiki.quests.he-responds-haughtily-you-wo: He responds haughtily, "You would presume I would work under your command after such a display of... prowess? No, I must decline."
wiki.quests.you-overhear-their-conversat: You overhear their conversation and learn they're planning to raid an infamous and likely wealthy pirate ship in the area. The pair jump off and you note down their target co-ordinates.
wiki.quests.you-have-no-interest-in-anyt: You have no interest in anything the Slugs could make business out of. Time to move on.
wiki.quests.they-respond-it-s-a-good: They respond, "It's a good thing you came when you did; we'd be dead now otherwise. I'm a shipwright and I'd like to help you like you helped me." The captain offers to install a piece of equipment on your ship.
wiki.quests.this-sector-has-become-incre: "This sector has become increasingly dangerous for friends of the Federation. I think my crew can patch up some of your hull damage as thanks."
wiki.quests.apparently-the-ship-that-was: Apparently the ship that was being assaulted was a science vessel. They thank you for saving them and offer a small reward.
wiki.quests.it-seems-the-crew-did-not: It seems the crew did not survive the assault. You take what you can from the remains of the ship.
wiki.quests.the-civilian-ship-wisely-mad: The civilian ship wisely made a fast retreat while you distracted the hostile ship.
wiki.quests.the-ship-looks-battered-and-: The ship looks battered and ready to break apart. You quickly move in to help rescue the survivors, but it looks like only one person made it. They offer to join your crew as thanks.
wiki.quests.thank-you-we-heard-you-jumpe: "Thank you! We heard you jumped into an unknown sector and we figured it would be a safe enough place to hide from the Rebels. We were wrong!" They transfer some excess materials for your trouble.
wiki.quests.the-rockman-ship-jumped-away: The Rockman ship jumped away during the battle, but it left much of its hull and spare parts floating behind - you salvage what you can, and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.the-rockmen-give-an-awkwardl: The Rockmen give an awkwardly-translated message that seems to indicate something about gratitude. They then jump away without another word.
wiki.quests.the-mantis-hiss-and-click-an: The Mantis hiss and click, angry at being saved, and angry at themselves for needing to be saved. They part ways with some scrap metal that is no longer attached to their hull and a few missiles they can no longer use.
wiki.quests.the-mantis-ship-sustained-to: The Mantis ship sustained too much damage - there are no survivors. You gather what resources you can from the wreckage.
wiki.quests.the-slugs-reluctantly-thank-: The Slugs reluctantly thank you for your help, protest they had the whole situation under control, attempt to make you pay for them helping you, and an hour later, finally relent and give you some supplies.
wiki.quests.the-slugs-taking-advantage-o: The Slugs, taking advantage of the firefight, have fled the system. So much for gratitude.
wiki.quests.with-help-from-the-computer-: With help from the computer, you are able to keep a comfortable distance between you and the Lanius ship, and you are able to gather resources from the debris field without conflict.
With help from the computer, you are able to keep a comfortable distance between you and the Lanius ship, and you gather a considerable amount of resources from the debris field without conflict.
wiki.quests.it-looks-like-you-interrupte: It looks like you interrupted the Lanius before they had a chance to scavenge much from the debris, and you make off with a good haul.
wiki.quests.the-competitor-gone-you-proc: The competitor gone, you proceed to investigate the field and scavenge what you can.
wiki.quests.the-competitor-gone-you-inve: The competitor gone, you investigate the debris, but it looks as if the Lanius harvested much of it before you arrived.
wiki.quests.you-move-in-and-power-up: You move in and power up your weapons. Detecting the threat, they stop what they are doing and prepare for a fight.
wiki.quests.you-ignore-the-ship-and-prep: You ignore the ship and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.your-crew-hails-their-ship-w: Your crew hails their ship, wondering if they have any extra salvage. Their crew seems happy to share.
wiki.quests.they-scoff-at-your-crewmembe: They scoff at your crewmember's request and utter something that was translated as, "Get your own, lazy solder."
wiki.quests.your-crewmember-hails-them-a: Your crewmember hails them, asking if they have any extra scrap. They state that they are extremely low and cannot spare any.
wiki.quests.you-move-in-and-power-up-2: You move in and power up your weapons. Detecting the threat, they stop what they were doing and prepare for a fight.
wiki.quests.you-ignore-their-derisive-to: You ignore their derisive tone and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.after-a-short-discussion-you:
After a short discussion you do not understand, the trader comes back with a second proposal.

{{laniusTraderOfferText}}
wiki.quests.yes-it-is-quality-our-ship: "Yes. It is quality. Our ship contains excess. Care to purchase?"
wiki.quests.your-ships-dock-and-you-are: Your ships dock and you are more than a little surprised when the Lanius you spoke with boards your ship. It appears the 'device' you purchased was one of the beings that learned your language.
wiki.quests.a-lanius-crewmember-named-tr: A Lanius crewmember named Translator joins you.
wiki.quests.no-matter-this-one-does-not: "No matter. This one does not mind this ship." They pull away and you are left to wonder what it meant by that. Perhaps the translation device has not yet been perfected?
wiki.quests.the-automated-ship-must-be-r: The automated ship must be remotely connected to the station; as soon as you attempt to log on, the ship activates and charges you.
wiki.quests.your-improved-sensors-are-ab: Your improved sensors are able to remotely access and download the public radar station's local map data.
wiki.quests.despite-your-advanced-engine: Despite your advanced engines you are unable to shake them; you turn and prepare for a fight.
wiki.quests.you-successfully-lose-the-sh: You successfully lose the ship in the storm.
wiki.quests.by-using-your-advanced-cloak: By using your advanced cloaking system you easily lose your pursuer in the storm.
wiki.quests.your-improved-sensors-indica: Your improved sensors indicate that it's safe to hack into the drone. You upload its map data to your navigation system and strip the ship of useful materials.
Your improved sensors indicate the ship is on standby, ready to activate at a moment's notice. Will you still attempt to access the ship's data?
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-ship-alone-and: You leave the ship alone and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.the-rock-grudgingly-transfer: The rock grudgingly transfer control of their helm to you and you steer them to a thinner part of the nebula. They're not sure what to think, but transfer over some supplies all the same.
wiki.quests.you-don-t-want-to-alert: You don't want to alert the Rebels of your presence and you don't want to anger the Zoltan in their territory. The best solution is to leave.
wiki.quests.alright-if-you-re-not-going: Alright... If you're not going that way I guess it can't be helped. We'll just wait for the next ship to come.
wiki.quests.we-re-receiving-your-transmi: We're receiving your transmission... Wow, I didn't know that chain-jumping was possible with this class of ship. We'll get back in a single jump! Thank you so much, please accept this.
wiki.quests.the-ship-starts-to-power-up: The ship starts to power up its FTL Drive. If it gets away, it will no doubt warn the fleet of your position!
wiki.quests.good-choice-son-we-ve-both: "Good choice, son. We've both come out of this richer."
wiki.quests.the-pirate-ship-stops-its-pu: The pirate ship stops its pursuit and locks weapons onto your ship.
wiki.quests.the-distress-signal-originat: The distress signal originates at a small Engi ship under attack by a rebel fighter - but when they see Federation markings they turn to attack!
wiki.quests.they-wouldn-t-get-more-than: They wouldn't get more than a few jumps with that load-out. You provide them with all the munitions and supplies they should need for the journey home. "Generosity magnitude unpredicted. Well-being syntax error [value too high]. Accept this token."
wiki.quests.engi-can-t-feel-fear-so: Engi can't feel fear, so they bear you no ill will when you explain you're unwilling to help. They set off on their journey and you do the same.
wiki.quests.they-hail-you-there-s-no: They hail you, "There's no need for aggression... Perhaps this would convince you to look the other way?"
wiki.quests.you-receive-medium-fuel-and-: You receive medium fuel and scrap.
wiki.quests.you-power-up-your-weapons-an: You power up your weapons and move in to engage.
wiki.quests.they-barely-hear-out-your-ap: They barely hear out your appeals before yelling, "These are the lies I sought to escape!" Looks like they're charging weapons!
wiki.quests.they-listen-to-your-appeals-: They listen to your appeals and whisper, "Traitors to truth. You're no better than them!" Chaos ensues.
wiki.quests.the-rock-captain-is-impresse: The Rock captain is impressed by the data you've collected and agrees to stay with you until they find their footing in the galaxy.
wiki.quests.the-ship-responds-yes-we-hav: The ship responds "Yes, we have an extensive stock! Come aboard and see our wares!"
wiki.quests.sir-we-can-dock-but-i: Sir: We can dock, but I sense that we better plan on making a purchase...
wiki.quests.disable-their-weapon-system-: Disable their Weapon system before docking.
wiki.quests.as-soon-as-you-start-to: As soon as you start to reverse your ship, the pirate reveals hidden weaponry and sets off in pursuit. You'll have to fight him to escape!
wiki.quests.you-receive-a-hail-as-soon: You receive a hail as soon as your Hacking system finishes: "What have you done!? You can never trust a Federation ship! Here, take your 'standard toll'. I really should do business elsewhere, scum."
wiki.quests.you-jet-toward-the-pirate-wi: You jet toward the pirate with the fuel supplies and engage - hopefully you can leave the ship in one piece!
You jet toward the pirate with the ammunition and engage - hopefully you can leave the ship in one piece!
wiki.quests.sometimes-discretion-is-the-: Sometimes discretion is the better part of valor.
wiki.quests.you-strip-the-ship-of-anythi: You strip the ship of anything useful and leave its crew to hope help arrives.
wiki.quests.hopefully-that-will-buy-you-: Hopefully that will buy you more time to get to the next sector.
wiki.quests.no-effect-in-the-last-stand: No effect in The Last Stand.
wiki.quests.the-rebel-fleet-is-delayed-f: The Rebel Fleet is delayed for 1 turn.
wiki.quests.you-immediately-slip-further: You immediately slip further into the clouds, but not quickly enough. The rebel catches sight of you and moves in to engage!
wiki.quests.fully-power-the-engines-to-o: Fully power the engines to out-run them.
wiki.quests.rebel-fleet-pursuit-is-doubl: Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled for 1 jump.
wiki.quests.the-ship-spots-you-and-gives: The ship spots you and gives chase. After some quick maneuvering you were able to lose your pursuers in the clouds. You expect they warned the fleet of your position, however.
wiki.quests.you-power-down-non-essential: You power down non-essential systems and slip into the cloud. The ship never noticed you.
wiki.quests.your-powerful-engines-allow-: Your powerful engines allow you to out-distance the ship and eventually lose it within the nebula.
wiki.quests.you-use-your-cloaking-system: You use your cloaking system to slip further into the nebula undetected.
wiki.quests.you-power-down-non-essential: You power down non-essential systems and wait for the FTL drive to charge. They either don't want to fight or have failed to notice your ship, the latter being more likely.
wiki.quests.you-quickly-cloak-the-ship-b: You quickly cloak the ship, but not quickly enough. They spot you and move in to engage.
wiki.quests.you-power-up-your-weapons-an: You power up your weapons and engage the pirate ship.
wiki.quests.the-fight-brings-them-out-of: The fight brings them out of your immediate scanning range. After a time the distress calls stop.
The fight brings them out of your immediate scanning range; however, after a time the distress calls stop.
wiki.quests.you-charge-the-weapons-which: You charge the weapons, which quickly gets the pirate ship's attention.
wiki.quests.unfortunately-it-is-not-your: Unfortunately it is not your mission to save every person affected by this war or the Lanius invasion.
wiki.quests.you-charge-your-weapons-whic: You charge your weapons, which quickly gets the Lanius ship's attention.
wiki.quests.you-move-in-to-intercept-the: You move in to intercept the ship. Detecting a greater threat, the Lanius prepare to fight.
wiki.quests.mercenaries-are-worse-than-r: Mercenaries are worse than rebels. The only honorable course is to engage the mercenary in battle.
wiki.quests.too-bad-you-will-regret-this: "Too bad... You will regret this decision!"
wiki.quests.the-rockmen-need-your-help-y: The Rockmen need your help - you target the Lanius ship and grimly prepare for battle.
wiki.quests.as-you-make-your-escape-the: As you make your escape, the Rockman's ship's engines explode, and you watch the Lanius ship slowly feed on the remains - and the crew.
wiki.quests.whatever-assistance-the-disa: Whatever assistance the disabled scout could provide is not worth the risk of fighting another Lanius. You prepare to move on.
wiki.quests.you-try-to-keep-a-low: You try to keep a low profile and quickly prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.the-mantis-take-no-interest-: The Mantis take no interest in your ship - they're lying in wait for the next Rock ship to venture through. You're able to spin up the engines and jump at your leisure.
wiki.quests.you-ignore-the-ship-s-pleas: You ignore the ship's pleas and watch as it hastily escapes. Oddly, the Lanius ship makes no move to chase it. You wonder if they were ever a threat at all.
wiki.quests.it-s-best-to-take-advantage: It's best to take advantage of the rare occasions when the Rebels aren't shooting at you. You prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-cargo-alone-an: You leave the cargo alone and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.you-assume-the-crystalline-s: You assume the Crystalline ship can handle itself. You have enough of your own problems.
wiki.quests.we-understand-not-everyone-i: "We understand. Not everyone is confident they can survive in these hostile times, let alone take the responsibility of protecting others."
wiki.quests.it-s-just-not-possible-to: It's just not possible to save every civilian affected by this war. You prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.it-jumps-away-after-a-time: It jumps away after a time.
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-platform-alone: You leave the platform alone, and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.your-ship-enters-one-of-the: Your ship enters one of the refueling station berths, grateful for a rest.
wiki.quests.secure-your-blast-doors-best: Secure your blast doors - best to be safe when docked.
wiki.quests.no-one-answers-your-hails-yo: No one answers your hails. You run some scans and discover that the station has been recently abandoned, no doubt due to the threat of the Lanius. You empty their fuel reserves before leaving.
wiki.quests.run-another-scan-at-maximum-: Run another scan at maximum sensitivity.
wiki.quests.what-seemed-to-be-a-brief: What seemed to be a brief respite turns into a Lanius trap... the first warning is an explosion from your engine room, followed moments later by detection of a Lanius ship at sensor range!
wiki.quests.your-ship-s-dash-suddenly-li: Your ship's dash suddenly lights up with warnings - a hull breach! Lanius were on board the platform and are now on board your ship. A hidden cruiser comes into view!
wiki.quests.1-lanius-boarder-beams-aboar: 1 lanius boarder beams aboard your ship.
wiki.quests.your-reinforced-doors-save-y: Your reinforced doors save you from an attempted ambush by the Lanius, who cluster around the doors and hull, attempting to consume your ship. Coldly, you wipe them out one by one with your weapon array, then take control of the station and take its fuel reserves.
wiki.quests.you-run-an-additional-more-f: You run an additional more focused scan and find one of the auxiliary refueling platforms has some unclaimed fuel.
You run an additional more focused scan and find one of the auxiliary refueling platforms has some unclaimed fuel and drone parts.
wiki.quests.as-you-prepare-to-leave-the: As you prepare to leave the system, a Pirate ship suddenly appears on scanners - it looks like it was attempting to use the platform as bait!
wiki.quests.the-automated-platform-seems: The automated platform seems to be damaged. You can likely steal as much fuel as remains.
wiki.quests.war-doesn-t-justify-abandoni: War doesn't justify abandoning one's values. You leave it alone.
wiki.quests.the-platform-seems-to-be-mal: The platform seems to be malfunctioning and could ignite at any moment.
wiki.quests.give-the-station-a-wide-bert: Give the station a wide berth and carry on.
wiki.quests.you-dock-and-signal-the-fuel: You dock and signal the fuel station's staff to begin refueling.
wiki.quests.seal-your-blast-doors-one-ca: Seal your blast doors, one can never be too careful when docked.
wiki.quests.if-you-take-the-fuel-at: If you take the fuel at least it won't fall into the hands of the Rebels. You breach the containment and access what remains of the fuel reserves.
wiki.quests.you-re-able-to-safely-refuel: You're able to safely refuel and get clear before the station explodes.
wiki.quests.just-as-you-hook-up-to: Just as you hook up to refuel, the station ignites and explodes. Your own fuel reserve ignites, losing your precious fuel and damaging your ship.
wiki.quests.you-pull-away-from-the-stati: You pull away from the station. After a short time a few silent explosions cause the depressurized tanks to implode.
wiki.quests.as-you-dock-with-the-refueli: As you dock with the refueling platform, there is an explosion from your engine room! Warning lights flash in your ship as pirates from the station swarm aboard your vessel!
wiki.quests.pirates-hidden-on-the-statio: Pirates hidden on the station are confounded by your security locks, turning an attempted ambush into a fish-in-a-barrel firefight. You take control of the station and take its fuel reserves.
wiki.quests.the-lanius-haven-t-noticed-y: The Lanius haven't noticed you yet - but they will. Launching into the fray, you target the Lanius vessel!
wiki.quests.the-mantis-ship-is-quickly-o: The Mantis ship is quickly overcome by the Lanius vessel, and you move away as the Lanius feed on the remains.
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-lanius-ship-al: You leave the Lanius ship alone, and prepare to jump to the next beacon.
wiki.quests.sometimes-you-have-to-bet-on: Sometimes you have to bet on the underdog - even on the rare occasions that the underdog is a Mantis warship. You set off for the heart of the asteroid field and engage the Zoltan there.
wiki.quests.you-overtake-the-zoltan-and-: You overtake the Zoltan and catch up with the Mantis ship in the asteroid belt. Time to make some friends.
wiki.quests.the-zoltan-know-their-busine: The Zoltan know their business better than most - best to leave them to it. You prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.you-like-a-challenge-so-be: "You like a challenge. So be it!" A wormhole forms and a confused, angry Mantis ship hurtles toward you!
wiki.quests.do-not-be-fooled-federation-: "Do not be fooled, Federation, by a soft underbelly." You detect a wormhole opening up, and seconds later a Slug ship is attacking from the other direction!
wiki.quests.a-hardened-foe-for-a-hardene: "A hardened foe for a hardened veteran." You detect a wormhole opening up, and a Rock ship appears with guns blazing. It appears they were in combat when they were thrust across space-time.
wiki.quests.interesting-so-this-metal-ma:
"Interesting. So this metal man can help us make some of these unique parts out of scrap? That would be a huge help." Your crewmember checks over the blueprints and quickly converts some of their base metal sheets into the specialized parts.

"Amazing! This robot thing could save us a ton of time. Could I buy it off you?"
wiki.quests.our-crew-is-not-for-sale: Our crew is not for sale.
wiki.quests.ask-your-crew-if-they-agree: Ask your crew if they agree.
wiki.quests.once-your-lanius-crewmember-: Once your Lanius crewmember understands the situation, it appears to like the idea of assisting with construction in deep space. Much less dangerous. They offer you some goods in exchange.
wiki.quests.a-pity-in-terms-of-payment: A pity. In terms of payment, here's some of the scrap metal we don't need, now that we've got the necessary parts.
wiki.quests.it-doesn-t-look-like-the: It doesn't look like the Fed ship can stand much more pressure. You fly in and intercept the Crystalline ship.
wiki.quests.with-the-federation-ship-dis: With the Federation ship distracting the guard, you are free to continue on your mission.
wiki.quests.to-your-surprise-one-of-the: To your surprise, one of the Engi vessels attacks! One ship detaches itself, surprisingly still quite whole, and opens fire - it looks like it's somehow identified you as hostile!
wiki.quests.the-engi-be-damned-no-one: The Engi be damned, no one threatens your ship. You prepare for a fight!
wiki.quests.wiping-your-engine-core-and-: Wiping your engine core and shields proves useless... eventually you trap the virus in the weapons systems to purge it, but before you do, the Engi grow restless and attack!
wiki.quests.very-good-then-your-shield-p: "Very good then!" Your shield power suddenly drops and they charge.
wiki.quests.a-being-that-would-choose-ss: "A being that would choose sssuffocation? Who am I to judge..." Your life support shuts off and they move in to attack.
wiki.quests.your-acceptance-of-death-is-: "Your acceptance of death is almosst admirable... Almosst." Your weapons system registers a hacking module. You hardly have time to respond before they attack.
wiki.quests.i-really-am-feeling-generous: "I really am feeling generousss..." They take the scrap and leave.
wiki.quests.sssilence-won-t-protect-you-: "Sssilence won't protect you. I'll make the choice mysself... Wait. Why isn't this working?" You cut transmission and move in to attack.
wiki.quests.you-message-the-crystalline-: You message the Crystalline ship your intentions and move in to intercept the Rebel ship.
wiki.quests.with-the-two-ships-engaged-i: With the two ships engaged in combat, you sneak by unnoticed.
wiki.quests.thankfully-your-improved-sub: Thankfully your improved subsystem is able to counter their hacking enough to keep the life support barely functional. That should keep you alive at least...
wiki.quests.your-hacking-system-automati: Your hacking system automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.
wiki.quests.you-are-able-to-undo-the: You are able to undo the damage of their remote hacking satellite but it's taking everything your hacking system has. Time to take out the enemy the old fashioned way.
wiki.quests.slug-boarders-beam-aboard-yo: slug boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.quests.fearing-the-imminent-battle-: Fearing the imminent battle you desperately try to get the medbay working again. It's lights flicker back on and you turn to face the intruders.
wiki.quests.your-mantis-crew-member-step: Your Mantis crew-member steps forward. He and KazaaakplethKilik perform a weird kind of alien haka. You, meanwhile, charge the battle systems.
wiki.quests.the-two-aliens-face-one-anot: The two aliens face one another over the vidscreen. "Cave-dwelling pebble-man!" yells the furious Mantis captain. "See, I paint my ship with your companions! I paint my ship with you!"
wiki.quests.before-they-have-a-chance-yo: Before they have a chance, you ram your ship into theirs, causing irreparable damage to their engines. Luckily, your ship's armored hull is hardly dented from the impact. The Mantis ship careens away and you move in to attack.
wiki.quests.your-hacking-system-automati: Your Hacking System automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.
wiki.quests.you-refuse-to-get-his-ship: You refuse to get his ship back, but still offer to drop him off at the next station. The Zoltan is displeased, but directs you to a nearby starbase just the same.
wiki.quests.deserters-cannot-be-tolerate: Deserters cannot be tolerated. You open fire on the cowards - though it doesn't please you to do so. The Federation needs every soldier it can get.
wiki.quests.you-send-them-a-friendly-war: You send them a friendly warning regarding the armada of Rebel ships pursuing you, and then get underway lest they catch you up.
wiki.quests.the-rebel-responds-to-your-t: The rebel responds to your threat, "I don't know who you are, but no one defies the Rebel Fleet!" They move in to engage.
wiki.quests.detecting-the-higher-threat-: Detecting the higher threat, the automated ship moves in to engage your ship.
wiki.quests.you-steer-clear-of-the-confl: You steer clear of the conflict. The outpost receives a beating but the ship stops its attack before it's destroyed.
wiki.quests.the-fight-brings-them-out-of: The fight brings them out of your immediate scanning range.
wiki.quests.the-rebel-ship-fires-some-wa: The Rebel ship fires some warning shots but eventually powers down their weapons. The outpost seems to have given them what they demanded.
wiki.quests.the-outpost-hails-you-the-po: The outpost hails you, "The pompous bastards expected free service just because they defeated the Federation. Take this for the help."
wiki.quests.you-try-to-block-out-the: You try to block out the horrors of war and focus on your mission.
wiki.quests.as-you-attempt-to-navigate-t: As you attempt to navigate the debris, you come too close to the Lanius ship - and they proceed to try to harvest you!
wiki.quests.expecting-resistance-their-e: Expecting resistance, their Energy Shield is raised and ready for combat.
wiki.quests.you-go-on-the-offensive-and: You go on the offensive and power up your weapons - with any luck, you'll soon have the mineral field all to yourself.
wiki.quests.you-charge-up-your-drive-and: You charge up your drive and prepare to make the next jump. No sense in antagonizing the Lanius if you don't need to.
wiki.quests.your-crew-seems-unhappy-to-l: Your crew seems unhappy to leave the civilians to such a fate but you try to convince them of the greater good. You don't speak of your own misgivings, however.
wiki.quests.you-power-up-your-weapons-an: You power up your weapons and engage the Rebel ship.
wiki.quests.they-are-powering-up-their-f: They are powering up their FTL! If they get away, they will no doubt warn the fleet of your position!
wiki.quests.the-rebel-s-preoccupation-wi: The Rebel's preoccupation with the Federation ship allows you to slip away undetected. However, you can't help but feel you should have helped them.
wiki.quests.you-feel-the-mission-is-the: You feel the mission is the highest priority and it's too risky to stay in such a dangerous location.
wiki.quests.they-stay-outside-your-weapo: They stay outside your weapons range, and eventually jump away.
wiki.quests.you-frown-power-up-the-weapo: You frown, power up the weapons and prepare to engage the Mantis ship. Not today.
wiki.quests.you-lock-onto-the-mantis-shi: You lock onto the Mantis ship and engage.
wiki.quests.you-move-to-finish-what-the: You move to finish what the Mantis have started.
wiki.quests.these-wretches-aren-t-worth-: These wretches aren't worth fighting. Time to spin up and jump off.
wiki.quests.after-a-few-moments-of-uncer: After a few moments of uncertainty, your crew is allowed to pass.
wiki.quests.the-zoltan-security-staff-bo: The Zoltan security staff board your ship and begin scanning the crew's faces into a computer. Suddenly alarms go off and the Zoltan leap on one of your crew! "This person is wanted on five charges of Utter Villainy! Surrender them to us!"
wiki.quests.unfortunately-your-crewmembe: Unfortunately your crewmember was taken away unharmed so your Clone Bay was unable to retrieve them.
wiki.quests.it-s-a-tough-call-but: It's a tough call, but Zoltan law holds sway here. Besides, that one always seemed a bit shifty.
wiki.quests.you-re-not-going-to-leave: You're not going to leave anyone behind. You pull away from the station with the enemy guards on board. Unfortunately, they are able to sabotage your weapon system in the chaos. It's time to leave!
wiki.quests.you-give-the-guards-permissi: You give the guards permission to dock with the ship, but before they come on board your crew member slowly advances to meet them. As far as you can tell no words were exchanged, but the guards offer you some supplies and say the ship checks out. Best to not ask questions.
wiki.quests.the-captain-of-the-guard-app: The captain of the guard appears on the vid screen "Back so soon friend! Well, no need to waste your time further. Here, take these spare fuel canisters and get on with your mission." Your ship is cleared to pass.
wiki.quests.detecting-the-greater-threat: Detecting the greater threat (and potential reward), they turn and engage your ship.
wiki.quests.it-seems-the-pirate-wasn-t: It seems the pirate wasn't looking for a fight with someone who could fight back. They leave and you move to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.before-you-can-get-close-eno: Before you can get close enough to scan the station, the automated ship detects you and moves in to attack!
wiki.quests.the-ship-patrols-wide-around: The ship patrols wide around the area, successfully approaching the station while avoiding detection.
wiki.quests.you-try-to-sneak-past-the: You try to sneak past the automated ship but it quickly turns and attacks!
wiki.quests.you-successfully-sneak-by-th: You successfully sneak by the ship and access the station undetected.
wiki.quests.you-send-a-drone-to-hack: You send a drone to hack the station but the automated ship notices and turns to attack!
wiki.quests.you-successfully-hack-into-t: You successfully hack into the station and sever the connection to the automated ship. You access the station undetected.
You successfully hack into the station and sever the connection to the automated ship, accessing the station completely undetected.
wiki.quests.before-your-drone-has-a-chan: Before your drone has a chance to attack, the automated ship activates and shoots it down. It then detects your ship and moves in on your position.
wiki.quests.you-leave-the-station-and-pr: You leave the station and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.you-successfully-hack-into-t: You successfully hack into their system and transmit false information about your location. That should hold off the fleet for at least a little while. You also are able to download data about the surrounding beacons.
wiki.quests.the-station-is-a-storage-sit: The station is a storage site for military grade weapons. You find one that can be easily attached to the ship.
wiki.quests.the-station-was-apparently-d: The station was apparently designed to outfit Rebel ships with Drone Systems. You find a functioning Schematic.
wiki.quests.the-station-is-a-storage-sit: The station is a storage site for various resources. You salvage everything possible.
wiki.quests.the-station-was-either-aband: The station was either abandoned or stripped clean. It seems to have lain unused for quite some time. You find nothing useful.
wiki.quests.once-on-board-your-crew-is: Once on board, your crew is able to access and download the long-range scanner's archived information. Your map has been updated.
wiki.quests.you-find-the-ship-has-a: You find the ship has a built-in method of warning the Rebel fleet of contact with your ship. You feed it some false data about your ship's whereabouts that should keep the fleet off your tail for a time.
wiki.quests.you-are-able-to-retrieve-a: You are able to retrieve a significant amount of data about the surrounding beacons from the scout before you scrap it.
wiki.quests.you-approach-the-ship-withou: You approach the ship without activating weapons and the civilian ship says, "Don't go any closer! Just kill them!" before hastily making their retreat.
wiki.quests.you-ask-what-they-want-and: You ask what they want and the translator chirps their response, "Explore. Assess trade potential." It appears to be a merchant ship attempting to make connections with the other races. The civilian must have simply been too scared to ask. You check what they have to sell at the moment.
wiki.quests.you-ask-what-they-are-doing: You ask what they are doing here but the translator clearly has problems with the request. The Lanius seem enraged for an indiscernible reason. They cut transmission and power their weapons. Looks like you'll have to fight after all!
wiki.quests.you-ask-what-they-are-doing-: You ask what they are doing here but the translator clearly has problems with the request. It chirps with their response, "Expunge... Floral... Proposition..." You try to clarify their answer but to no avail. Both you and the Lanius captain end the transmission despondently.
wiki.quests.your-crewmember-opens-a-chan: Your crewmember opens a channel with them. It seems they are scouting for a merchant's guild which is seeking to establish connections with other sentient races. You suggest they invest research time into developing better translators and ask to see if they are selling anything at the moment.
wiki.quests.you-power-up-your-weapons-an: You power up your weapons, and in response, the Lanius ship does the same! Prepare for a fight.
wiki.quests.you-power-up-your-weapons-bu: You power up your weapons, but don't get a response.
wiki.quests.as-soon-as-you-lock-your: As soon as you lock your weapons onto their vessel, it awakens... they must have been in hibernation and were awoken by the danger!
wiki.quests.as-you-drift-toward-the-vess: As you drift toward the vessel, your piloting skill is unable to match your intent - the Lanius ship powers up, hungry for raw materials!
wiki.quests.you-clumsily-manage-to-strip: You clumsily manage to strip some hull plating before being forced to retreat or risk collision.
wiki.quests.your-crewmember-manages-to-s: Your crewmember manages to salvage some resources without waking the hibernating crew.
wiki.quests.the-computer-matches-the-rot: The computer matches the rotation and speed of the target ship, and you take the opportunity to gather what residual scrap you can without awakening the Lanius crew. You get an excellent haul!
wiki.quests.slightly-shocked-at-your-que: Slightly shocked at your question, their leader quickly responds, "Declined offer with apologetic gratitude. Topic of discussion private matter, no concern of Federation."
wiki.quests.you-can-t-help-but-wonder: You can't help but wonder what they were discussing as you prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.your-crew-member-syncs-with-: Your crew member syncs with the comm unit to communicate with them directly. You offer your help and a summary of the ship's mission. They respond, "Our goals have analogous elements. However, not all available for disclosure, discretion necessary."
wiki.quests.he-offers-to-lead-you-to: He offers to lead you to a secret cache of scrap nearby if you let him join your crew.
wiki.quests.reluctantly-accept-his-propo: Reluctantly accept his proposal and fight the Rebel ship.
wiki.quests.reject-him-outright-and-exec: Reject him outright and execute him on the spot.
wiki.quests.attempting-to-deal-with-atta: Attempting to deal with attacks from inside and out is never easy!
wiki.quests.your-fearless-crew-easily-ov: Your fearless crew easily overcome the intruder, but the Rebel ship still needs to be dealt with.
wiki.quests.relieved-and-light-headed-yo: Relieved and light-headed, your new crew member gets to work as the Rebel ship attacks.
wiki.quests.the-dishonorable-rebel-has-d: The dishonorable Rebel has deceived you. He damages your ship and steals ship information before teleporting away. The fleet will be able to track you with ease. If they can't kill you now, that is!
wiki.quests.your-new-crew-member-smiles-: Your new crew-member smiles, then reveals a small remote trigger in the palm of his hand. Explosions rocket around the ship as more intruders teleport aboard!
wiki.quests.the-eviscerated-crewmember-s: The eviscerated crewmember's clone launches out of the clone bay, eager to seek revenge.
wiki.quests.the-rebel-makes-to-take-his: The Rebel makes to take his assigned station, then suddenly turns and eviscerates the nearest crew-member. Red Alert!
wiki.quests.you-execute-the-defector-and: You execute the defector and turn to the Rebel ship.
wiki.quests.as-you-try-to-leave-a: As you try to leave, a patrol spots you. Wailing sirens begin to blare around the camp and the ship moves in to attack!
wiki.quests.they-must-have-been-focused-: They must have been focused on setting up camp since you got far enough away to attempt a jump without being noticed.
wiki.quests.you-fire-at-their-fuel-depot: You fire at their fuel depot, but a shot from the surface rips the missile to shreds. They must have a planetary defense system set up already! You try to get away but a nearby patrol ship moves in to attack.
wiki.quests.it-appears-they-have-not-set:
It appears they have not set up a Teleporter disruption field yet. You deposit one bomb in a fuel depot and another in the barracks. Mantis comm channels fill with panicked chatter and you watch a number of structures go up in flames.

With most of their ships and forces focused on the chaos, you slip undetected to a nearby depot. You find some useful resources and an Engi slave who gladly accepts your liberation.
wiki.quests.you-move-in-to-attack-the: You move in to attack the Rebel ship that is threatening them and scanners detect weapon locks from a nearby Anti-Ship Battery. It's about to get hectic!
wiki.quests.you-apologize-but-it-s-not: You apologize but it's not worth the risk to attack a Rebel station.
