wiki.quests.amidst-the-blasts-from-the-a: Amidst the blasts from the Anti-Ship Battery, the cargo ship escaped from the station. They jettisoned some scrap towards your ship before jumping away.
wiki.quests.you-approach-cautiously-but-: You approach cautiously but you detect no danger. It appears to have been a small rest stop that was abandoned a while ago. You take what few supplies you can find.
wiki.quests.upon-closer-inspection-it-ap: Upon closer inspection it appears to have a large portion of its hull destroyed. You take what few supplies you can find.
wiki.quests.you-dock-with-the-station-to: You dock with the station to take a look inside. However no sooner do you open the airlock than pirates burst in. Meanwhile scanners pick up a previously undetected pirate ship moving in to attack!

You dock with the station to take a look inside. However no sooner do you open the airlock than pirates burst in. Meanwhile multiple warning signals go off on the bridge. The pirates have activated a remote planetary defense system and it's locking onto your ship!
wiki.quests.search-for-a-surviving-dna-b: Search for a surviving DNA bank.
wiki.quests.the-station-is-in-disarray-y: The station is in disarray. You find a cloning bay partially intact but nothing else seems to be functioning.
wiki.quests.as-you-approach-it-becomes-c: As you approach it becomes clear that the station is simply an empty shell. It has been stripped of useful materials long ago.
wiki.quests.while-the-cloning-facilities: While the cloning facilities are no longer functioning, you find someone was in queue to be cloned. You transfer their data to your Clonebay and after a time their body is rebuilt.
wiki.quests.the-clone-emerges-in-a-craze: {{rebuilt}} The clone emerges in a crazed frenzy and refuses to calm down. You have no choice but to fight.
wiki.quests.the-clone-is-extremely-confu: {{rebuilt}} The clone is extremely confused but calms down after you try to explain the situation. With no other options the clone offers to work on your ship for a time.
{{rebuilt}} The clone is extremely confused but seems to accept their new situation. With no other options the clone offers to work on your ship for a time.
wiki.quests.you-take-what-you-can-and: You take what you can and prepare to move on.
wiki.quests.you-decide-it-s-not-worth: You decide it's not worth the time to examine.
wiki.quests.great-thank-you-here-s-some: "Great, thank you. Here's some scrap metal for your troubles. Be careful out there."
wiki.quests.well-i-suppose-that-s-better: "Well, I suppose that's better than nothing. Thank you. Hopefully we can find a station at the next Beacon."
wiki.quests.you-input-their-coordinates-: You input their coordinates into your map and prepare to follow.
wiki.quests.they-re-not-worth-the-troubl: They're not worth the trouble. You prepare to leave.
wiki.quests.thank-you-for-saving-us-this: "Thank you for saving us. This ship is transporting Federation civilians on the run from the rebellion and we don't have the equipment to fight for ourselves. I don't have much to offer, but I can inform you of a hidden Federation base nearby. Perhaps they can assist you more."
wiki.quests.thanks-we-didn-t-think-there: "Thanks, we didn't think there would be Rebel ships all the way out here. They seem to be searching for something. Take some extra supplies as thanks for your aid."
wiki.quests.despite-your-efforts-the-maj: Despite your efforts the majority do not survive. The sole survivor offers to join your crew and helps you strip the now derelict ship of useful components.
wiki.quests.you-drag-the-injured-and-dyi: You drag the injured and dying crew on to your ship. The Med-bots help stabilize their condition, but most perish. The surviving shields operator offers to join your crew and helps you strip their broken ship of scrap.
wiki.quests.your-quick-reactions-allow-y: Your quick reactions allow you to stabilize a few of the seriously wounded crewmembers. An infantryman offers to join your crew and the rest tell you of a hidden Federation base a few jumps from here.
wiki.quests.your-sensors-pick-faint-sign: Your sensors pick faint signatures of what appears to be a storage space hidden under the rock. You find the access point and discover a weapons cache whose Federation signal emitter has malfunctioned.
wiki.quests.your-advanced-sensors-pick-f: Your Advanced Sensors pick faint signatures of what appears to be a storage space hidden under the rock. You find the access point and discover a supply cache whose Federation signal emitter has malfunctioned.
wiki.quests.the-automated-drone-turns-on: The automated drone turns on you.
wiki.quests.you-swoop-in-to-assist-takin: You swoop in to assist, taking down the wing leader.
wiki.quests.with-the-threat-gone-you-con: With the threat gone, you contact the Federation outpost. They respond, "Our location has been compromised! Take everything you can and please drop our survivors off at the next station." One soldier offers to stay and fight.
wiki.quests.you-contact-the-station-once: You contact the station once the Rebel ship is destroyed. The lone survivor responds, "This base is no longer safe. Let me join your crew and I'll have the station's drones patch up your ship."
wiki.quests.it-seems-almost-a-waste-for: It seems almost a waste for such a fierce foe to die in such an anticlimactic fashion. You shrug it off and take what you can.
wiki.quests.thus-ends-the-life-of-the: Thus ends the life of the famed captain, KazaaakplethKilik... You wonder what secrets went with him to the grave as you thoroughly loot his ship.
wiki.quests.in-his-dying-moments-he-give: In his dying moments he gives up the location of his secret stash. You strip the ship wondering what other secrets went with him to the grave.
wiki.quests.your-haste-has-paid-off-and: Your haste has paid off and you are able to bring him back from the brink of death. When his senses return he says, "I never thought I would see this day, but... I am willing to devote myself and my ships to your cause."
wiki.quests.your-haste-has-paid-off-and-: Your haste has paid off and you register him into the Clonebay's database. After he passes away he is quickly reconstructed on board your ship. When his senses return he says, "I never thought I would see this day, but... I am willing to devote myself and my ships to your cause."
wiki.quests.there-is-no-room-aboard-for-: There is no room aboard for Kazaaak.
wiki.quests.kazaaakplethkilik-joins-your: KazaaakplethKilik joins your crew, offers the coordinates for a nearby stash of stolen military goods and transmits the coordinates for a custom cruiser he has been working on. You forward it to the Federation, sure they can make good use of it.
wiki.quests.there-s-money-to-be-made: There's money to be made here. The Slugs know that. You turn on the pirate and intercept just before he can reach the cache!
wiki.quests.when-he-sees-you-making-for: When he sees you making for the cache the Slug captain hails: "Foolish alienss, no eye for profit. Bessst of luck to you." They jump off, leaving you toe to toe with the pirate!
wiki.quests.as-soon-as-they-see-you: As soon as they see you they power up their engines to jump away. Stop them!
wiki.quests.as-soon-as-they-see-you-2: As soon as they see you, they power up their engines to jump away.  Stop them!
wiki.quests.the-ship-turns-neutral-and-j: The ship turns neutral and jumps away.
wiki.quests.no-wait-you-cut-the-transmis: "No, wait..." You cut the transmission and continue the assault.
wiki.quests.the-mantis-escort-turns-to-m: The Mantis escort turns to meet you.
wiki.quests.likely-ploy-by-rebels-to-avo: "Likely ploy by Rebels to avoid breaking non-aggression pact with Engi. 97.56 percent likely. Your mission to assist last Federation fleet, correct? Coordinates?"
wiki.quests.satisfactory-delivery-of-tec: "Satisfactory. Delivery of tech will assist in Federation cause. Gratitude alone insufficient. Commencing ship repair and compensation." Their crews deliver a weapon for installation but you're more pleased to hear that the Federation will have an improved arsenal.
wiki.quests.you-charge-the-assault-ship-: You charge the assault ship guarding the platform.
wiki.quests.fly-slowly-toward-their-last: Fly slowly toward their last known position.
wiki.quests.wait-and-hope-the-escort-lea: Wait and hope the escort leaves.
wiki.quests.have-your-crewmember-monitor: Have your crewmember monitor their life signatures.
wiki.quests.try-to-maintain-a-lock-on: Try to maintain a lock on their ships from a distance.
wiki.quests.you-slip-into-the-nebula-und: You slip into the nebula undetected but at this rate you are likely to get lost and lose track of them.
wiki.quests.you-are-advancing-slowly-whe: You are advancing slowly when suddenly the assault ship bursts through the clouds. They must have been able to detect you with their telepathy!
wiki.quests.you-wait-for-a-time-before: You wait for a time before attempting to advance toward the platform. However, after some frantic searching you can't tell if they left or you simply miscalculated your trajectory... You give up the search and prepare to leave.
wiki.quests.you-try-to-stay-just-far:
You try to stay just far enough away that they won't detect your life signatures without actively searching for you. After a time, your Slug tells you the ship with a larger crew has jumped away. He guides the helm toward the platform...

The only ship left near the cruiser is an interceptor. This should be easy!
wiki.quests.you-overclock-your-sensors-t:
You overclock your sensors, trying to get them to function in the clouds. They work just enough to let you keep tabs on their general position. After a time, the assault ship and most of the escort jumps away from the platform. You take the opportunity and move in to attack.

The only ship left near the cruiser is an interceptor. This should be easy!
wiki.quests.the-interceptor-powers-up-it: The interceptor powers up its FTL drive in preparation to escape. At the same time, the cruiser's FTL drive does the same. They must be linked! Don't let them get away!
wiki.quests.after-a-time-the-ship-powers: After a time the ship powers down its weapons and jumps away. No life-signs are detected on the moon.
wiki.quests.you-ask-where-they-were-deli: You ask where they were delivering the weapon. "By telling you we will probably die jussst as like as not... Oh well." They give you the coordinates of the a prototype cruiser's mobile construction platform.
wiki.quests.after-the-exchange-is-comple: After the exchange is complete they leave without a word.
wiki.quests.great-take-this-bit-of-fuel:
"Great. Take this bit of fuel as a down-payment. We'll be one step behind you, following your jump signatures. Don't want to take any risks now, do we?"

{{line}}
wiki.quests.thank-you-if-you-can-just:
"Thank you! If you can just give us a count on their numbers perhaps we can get the Rebels to help."

{{line}}
wiki.quests.great-thanks-for-your-help-i:
"Great. Thanks for your help. I've marked their last known coordinates and sent over some supplies to help you get there."

{{line}}
wiki.quests.take-this-bit-of-scrap-as:
"Take this bit of scrap as a down-payment. We'll use your jump signatures to follow you. You're really helping us out here."

{{line}}
wiki.quests.the-slug-captain-offers-a-fr: {{lead}} The Slug Captain offers a free reactor upgrade for your help. It never hurts to get a little power boost!
wiki.quests.the-slug-captain-thankful-fo: {{lead}} The Slug Captain, thankful for your help, offers a reactor upgrade for your ship... for a 'fair' price.{{tail}}
wiki.quests.the-slugs-offer-their-thanks: {{lead}} The Slugs offer their thanks for your help, and jump away. Their true appreciation is questionable, but at least you can get back to your mission.
wiki.quests.you-pay-off-the-debt-the: You pay off the debt. The Rock Captain still seems annoyed at the Slug's getting their 'undeserved' scrap, but at least the situation will remain peaceful.
wiki.quests.you-let-their-team-on-board: You let their team on board and after a short time they finish their work.
wiki.quests.no-more-life-signs-detected-: No more life signs detected on the Lanius ship. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.the-lanius-craft-breaks-apar: The Lanius craft breaks apart. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.no-more-life-signs-detected-: No more life signs detected on the Lanius ship. You move to inspect the automated Rebel ship that it was absorbing.
wiki.quests.the-lanius-craft-breaks-apar: The Lanius craft breaks apart. You move to inspect the automated Rebel ship that it was absorbing.
wiki.quests.you-salvage-what-you-can-fro: You salvage what you can from the broken ship.
wiki.quests.attempt-to-manually-hack-int: Attempt to manually hack into the station.
wiki.quests.don-t-risk-it-leave-the: Don't risk it. Leave the station.
wiki.quests.use-a-drone-to-hack-into: Use a drone to hack into the station.
wiki.quests.you-salvage-what-you-can-and: You salvage what you can and approach the station. It is used to relay information to the Rebel Fleet. You could attempt to hack it to give the Rebels false information.
wiki.quests.you-successfully-hack-into-t: You successfully hack into their system and transmit false information about your location. That should hold off the fleet for at least a little while.
wiki.quests.the-firewalls-prove-too-diff: The firewalls prove too difficult to bypass. As you are about to disconnect, you stumble across unprotected information about the surrounding beacons. Your map is updated.
wiki.quests.as-you-attempt-to-hack-in: As you attempt to hack in, you set off a hidden alarm system. It seems that now the Rebels must surely be aware of your position! You hasten back to the ship to jump away.
wiki.quests.you-are-unable-to-penetrate-: You are unable to penetrate the computer's defenses. You give up and return to the ship.
wiki.quests.the-pirates-are-all-dead-lea: The pirates are all dead, leaving the ship dead in space. You scrounge what you can from their ship before contacting its former prey.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-explodes-leaving-: The pirate explodes, leaving behind a substantial collection of useful scrap material. You go to examine the ship you just saved.
wiki.quests.you-search-the-ship-and-disc: You search the ship and discover that its cargo was new military-grade weaponry! It was somehow undamaged in the fight and can easily be mounted on the ship.
wiki.quests.the-ship-was-transporting-we: The ship was transporting weaponry. You find a piece still intact, despite the battle.
wiki.quests.searching-the-remains-you-fi: Searching the remains, you find that the cargo was military-grade Drone Schematics! You bring them aboard to install in your ship.
wiki.quests.you-detect-faint-life-signat: You detect faint life signatures from an intact piece of the hull. They were transporting prisoners, and the sole survivor offers to join your crew, as a first step on his path to get revenge.
wiki.quests.this-ship-s-cargo-was-not: This ship's cargo was not salvageable. However, they seem to have been surveying the region; they possess detailed maps and data. You download what you can to the ship's map.
wiki.quests.the-ship-was-carrying-milita: The ship was carrying military supplies. You pick up anything that looks salvageable from the debris.
wiki.quests.the-debris-implies-that-the-: The debris implies that the ship was carrying Drone Schematics, but unfortunately nothing remains. You do find functioning Drone Parts, however.
wiki.quests.the-ship-was-apparently-tran: The ship was apparently transporting weaponry; however, nothing seems to have survived the battle.
wiki.quests.from-the-bits-and-pieces-you: From the bits and pieces you find, you decide that this ship was gathering information. Nothing seems useful.
wiki.quests.the-ship-appears-to-have-bee: The ship appears to have been transporting prisoners. Unfortunately they were all killed in the battle. You salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.you-search-the-remains-of-th: You search the remains of the ship, but only come across blueprints and debris from broken machinery. A shame, but you take what scrap you can salvage.
wiki.quests.with-the-crew-dead-you-searc: With the crew dead, you search the ship. You find military-grade weaponry and take what looks most useful.
wiki.quests.searching-the-remains-you-fi: Searching the remains you find that the cargo was military-grade Drone Schematics! You bring them aboard to install on your ship.
wiki.quests.the-ship-refuses-to-fight-bu: The ship refuses to fight, but you still detect life signatures. Apparently this was a prisoner transport. The single survivor offers to join your crew in exchange for their freedom.
wiki.quests.this-ship-was-apparently-car: This ship was apparently carrying information about the surrounding beacons. You download what you can to the ship's map, and scrap the rest of the ship.
wiki.quests.you-contact-the-other-ship-t: You contact the other ship, "Thank you for your assistance. It's glad to know that not all of you foreigners are so barbaric. Take this as a reward."
wiki.quests.the-crystalline-ship-hails-y: The Crystalline ship hails you, "It's a good thing you came when you did. We appreciate the assistance. Please take this for your help."
wiki.quests.you-contact-the-crystalline-: You contact the Crystalline ship to hear, "It seems you have brought war to our doorstep. I hope you're not too surprised that we don't welcome you with open arms. I should kill you myself..." They cut communications.
wiki.quests.the-crystalline-ship-message: The Crystalline ship messages you, "You're the one that opened our sector to the outside, aren't you! Bastards, my home was just overrun by your 'Rebels'. Just leave us in peace!" They quickly jump away.

The Crystalline ship messages you, "Thank you. We were not prepared for the savagery with which you aliens battle. We will give you one of our weapons if you intend on assisting our kind in the future."
wiki.quests.they-seem-tempted-by-your-of: They seem tempted by your offer, but decide they can't risk being lied to again. They close frequencies and jump away.
wiki.quests.your-promises-gain-their-att: Your promises gain their attention and they agree to serve with you, for a while.
wiki.quests.a-human-in-an-exquisite-suit: A human in an exquisite suit meets you on board. "Welcome to my ship! We specialize in drones of all kinds, can I interest you in any?"
wiki.quests.ah-i-m-sorry-to-hear: "Ah, I'm sorry to hear that! Pleasant journeys." Once back to the helm, a series of explosions rocks your ship. The pirate ship has powered its weapons! You receive a message, "You shouldn't waste people's time Captain!"
wiki.quests.these-rebels-are-easily-sway: These Rebels are easily swayed by the prospect of additional scrap. They release the civilian ships and everyone is free to go.
wiki.quests.like-most-rebels-these-are-j: Like most Rebels, these are just men trying to get by in a rough galaxy. They take your scrap and let everyone continue their journeys.
wiki.quests.as-everyone-currently-awaiti: As everyone currently awaiting inspection is human anyway, the Rebels let them go. They take your scrap and tell you to hurry along.
wiki.quests.they-eagerly-accept-your-bri: They eagerly accept your bribe, obviously revolutionaries are under paid. The civilian ships all begin to jump away.
wiki.quests.one-of-the-civilian-ships-co: One of the civilian ships contacts you and reveals they are Federation loyalists. An eavesdropping Rebel swoops in, destroys the ship, and turns to attack you!
wiki.quests.one-of-the-civilian-ships-qu: One of the civilian ships quietly teleports over a crate of Federation military supplies.
wiki.quests.some-of-the-civilians-pool-t: Some of the civilians pool together their excess scrap to try to repay you for your help.
wiki.quests.the-civilians-are-grateful-h: The civilians are grateful. However, none of them seem eager to be mistaken as Federation loyalists so they quickly jump away.
wiki.quests.with-the-crew-dead-you-take: With the crew dead you take as much salvage from the ship as possible.
wiki.quests.the-ship-explodes-and-you-sc: The ship explodes and you scrap what you can.
wiki.quests.the-mantis-defeated-you-cont: The Mantis defeated, you contact the weakened Slug vessel. "You ssseee," they begin, "we are are most grateful, but, that is, we do not currently have the liquid asssets to reward you at this time."
wiki.quests.the-slug-captain-hails-you-a: The Slug captain hails you: "A misstake! A sssimple misstake. Of course we can pay you! Ssseee? An augmentation has already transported." You allow them to leave with their lives.
wiki.quests.it-doesn-t-look-like-they: It doesn't look like they can stand much more damage. After a few shots their ship breaks apart and you move in to loot the remains.
wiki.quests.thank-you-for-the-aid-i: Thank you for the aid! I'm an arms dealer that usually only works with rebels, but considering the circumstances I'll make an exception.
wiki.quests.thank-the-heavens-you-showed: Thank the heavens you showed up! We don't have much to offer as a reward, but our engineer should be proficient enough to patch your ship up a bit after that nasty fight.
wiki.quests.upon-closer-inspection-you-r: Upon closer inspection, you realize the ship under attack was a Rebel scout! It's too damaged to put up much of a fight.
wiki.quests.destroy-the-ship-and-salvage: Destroy the ship and salvage it.
wiki.quests.use-the-leverage-you-gained-: Use the leverage you gained by saving their lives to convince them to delay the pursuing fleet.
wiki.quests.you-were-too-late-a-hull: You were too late. A hull breach deprived the crew of oxygen during your fight with the pirate. You salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-s-victim-quickly-: The pirate's victim quickly jumps away before you have a chance to speak to them.
wiki.quests.there-are-no-more-life-signs: There are no more life-signs remaining on the ship. You strip it of useful materials.
wiki.quests.the-ship-explodes-leaving-be: The ship explodes, leaving behind a collection of useful scrap material.
wiki.quests.it-looks-as-if-the-lanius:
{{text}}

It looks as if the Lanius were uninterested in the fuel reserves on the station, and there is a good amount of fuel left. You take what your ship can hold and prepare to jump to the next beacon.
wiki.quests.the-zoltan-ship-now-empty-of: The Zoltan ship, now empty of lifeforms, provides easy salvage.
wiki.quests.the-zoltan-ship-breaks-apart: The Zoltan ship breaks apart and you salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-ship-now-empty-of: The pirate ship, now empty of lifeforms, provides easy salvage.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-ship-breaks-apart: The pirate ship breaks apart and you salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.no-more-life-signs-detected-: No more life signs detected on the pirate ship. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-ship-breaks-apart: The pirate ship breaks apart. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.with-all-of-the-would-be: With all of the would-be pirates dead, you think it best not to return to the settlement... You prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.the-black-raven-breaks-apart: "The Black Raven" breaks apart and you salvage the remains.
wiki.quests.the-once-dreaded-pirate-nigh: The once-dreaded pirate Nights has been killed and you proceed to loot his ship.
wiki.quests.while-you-search-the-debris-: While you search the debris, you wonder what it was that could have provoked them to act so irrationally.
wiki.quests.while-you-scrap-their-ship-y: While you scrap their ship, you wonder what it was that could have provoked them to act so irrationally.
wiki.quests.their-ship-breaks-apart-and-: Their ship breaks apart and you move in to scrap the remains.
wiki.quests.with-no-more-crew-on-board: With no more crew on board you are free to salvage what you can from the remains.
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-destroyed-you-: With the ship destroyed, you quickly collect useful resources.
wiki.quests.with-the-crew-of-the-rebel: With the crew of the Rebel ship dead, you salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.with-the-slugs-no-longer-a: With the Slugs no longer a threat, you strip the ship and return to the Rockmen.
wiki.quests.with-the-slug-ship-destroyed: With the Slug ship destroyed, you retrieve some scrap and return to the Rock ship.
wiki.quests.it-appears-the-rock-ship-was: It appears the Rock ship was long since abandoned. You strip what you can from it.
wiki.quests.it-appears-that-the-rock-shi: It appears that the Rock ship left during your battle. You doubt they could have been more ungrateful for your assistance.
wiki.quests.after-the-battle-the-rock-sh: After the battle the Rock ship hails you. Their captain simply says, "Thanks." and jumps away. That's pretty gracious of them, considering the Rockmen's reputation.
wiki.quests.in-the-time-it-took-you: In the time it took you to eliminate the Mantis ship the Rock must have repaired their FTL drive and jumped away. You pick the bones of both Mantis vessels.
wiki.quests.you-access-the-recent-scans-: You access the recent scans from the unguarded station. Your map has been updated with details of the surrounding area.
wiki.quests.the-ship-explodes-leaving-be: The ship explodes, leaving behind a substantial collection of useful scrap material.
wiki.quests.the-crystalline-ship-shatter: The Crystalline ship shatters and you pick what you can from the debris.
wiki.quests.the-crew-of-the-enemy-ship: The crew of the enemy ship has been eliminated. You scrap what you can.
wiki.quests.the-crystalline-ship-shatter: The Crystalline ship shatters and you pick what you can from the debris. Who knows how many people you've saved by stopping this ship.
wiki.quests.the-crew-of-the-enemy-ship-2: The crew of the enemy ship has been eliminated. You scrap what you can. Who knows how many people you've saved by stopping this ship.
wiki.quests.the-crystalline-ship-shatter: The Crystalline ship shatters and you pick what you can from the debris. The rest of the convoy used the time to put a significant amount of distance between you and them. Nothing left to do but jump.
wiki.quests.the-crew-of-the-enemy-ship-3: The crew of the enemy ship has been eliminated. You scrap what you can. The rest of the convoy used the time to put a significant amount of distance between you and them. Nothing left to do but jump.
wiki.quests.with-the-rebel-ship-destroye: With the Rebel ship destroyed you are free to contact their would-be victim.
wiki.quests.with-the-rebel-ship-defeated: With the Rebel ship defeated you quickly salvage what you can and move to contact their prey.
wiki.quests.the-ship-breaks-apart-and-yo: The ship breaks apart and you quickly salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.with-the-crew-dead-you-quick: With the crew dead you quickly salvage what you can.
wiki.quests.the-rebels-destroyed-you-pic: The Rebels destroyed, you pick the bones of their ship.
wiki.quests.you-salvage-the-ship-and-con: You salvage the ship and contact the wise man.
wiki.quests.you-salvage-the-remains-and-: You salvage the remains and contact the wise man.
wiki.quests.when-he-sees-you-have-emerge: When he sees you have emerged victorious, the Zoltan wise man enters a rage. Rifts threaten to tear space apart until, instead, the Zoltan implodes, sending a blast wave of scrap and salvage dragged here from distant worlds in your direction.
wiki.quests.with-their-crew-dead-you-qui: With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your shields return to normal. You strip the ship.
wiki.quests.the-slug-ship-breaks-apart-a: The Slug ship breaks apart and your shields return to normal. You collect what you can.
wiki.quests.with-their-crew-dead-you-qui: With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your systems return to normal. You strip the ship.
wiki.quests.the-slug-ship-breaks-apart-a: The Slug ship breaks apart and your systems return to normal. You collect what you can.
wiki.quests.with-their-crew-dead-you-qui: With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your weapon system returns to normal. You strip the ship.
wiki.quests.the-slug-ship-breaks-apart-a: The Slug ship breaks apart and your weapon system returns to normal. You collect what you can.
The Slug ship breaks apart and their hacking module is destroyed. You collect what you can.
wiki.quests.with-their-crew-dead-their-h: With their crew dead, their hacking system shuts down and your systems return to normal. You strip the ship.
wiki.quests.no-more-life-signs-detected-: No more life signs detected on the Lanius ship. You decide to salvage it when the opportunity arises.
wiki.quests.the-ship-breaks-apart-you-de: The ship breaks apart. You decide to salvage it when the opportunity arises.
wiki.quests.after-your-skirmish-the-figh: {{text}} After your skirmish, the fighting dies down and you're contacted by the planetary defense team. "Sorry you got caught up in that fight, stranger. No matter how many of these monsters we blow out of the sky, they just keep coming. We can patch up your ship for you."
wiki.quests.you-finish-off-your-assailan: {{text}} You finish off your assailant with the help of the Anti-Ship Battery but the fight rages on in the distance. You'd best leave before you get dragged into it again.
wiki.quests.their-ship-breaks-apart-and-: Their ship breaks apart and you are relieved to know that you are still one step ahead of the fleet.
wiki.quests.their-ship-goes-silent-and-y: Their ship goes silent and you are relieved to know that you are still one step ahead of the fleet.
wiki.quests.the-ship-breaks-apart-and-yo: The ship breaks apart and you feel relief in the knowledge that you will hopefully still be one step ahead of the fleet.
wiki.quests.the-ship-breaks-apart-you-ha: The ship breaks apart. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.attempt-to-contact-the-civil: Attempt to contact the civilian ship.
wiki.quests.there-isn-t-time-to-salvage: There isn't time to salvage the enemy ship but your crew made off with a few nearby materials. Prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.there-s-no-time-to-salvage: There's no time to salvage all of the wreck, the fleet is still nearby. Get ready to jump!
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-in-one-piece: With the ship in one piece, you are able to salvage most of the fuel supplies before the ion storm clears and you have to jump away.
wiki.quests.the-ship-obliterated-only-sc: The ship obliterated, only scant fuel canisters can be scavenged from the wreckage before the ion storm clears and you have to jump away.
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-in-one-piece-2: With the ship in one piece, you are able to salvage most of the ammunition before the ion storm clears and you have to jump away.
wiki.quests.the-ship-obliterated-only-sc: The ship obliterated, only scant ammunition crates can be scavenged from the wreckage before the ion storm clears and you have to jump away.
wiki.quests.at-last-the-slugs-prized-pos: At last the Slugs' prized possessions are yours for the taking. After, that is, you split your takings with the Mantis.
wiki.quests.you-scrap-what-you-can-and: You scrap what you can and prepare to jump before the other guards arrive.
wiki.quests.the-outpost-hails-you-after-: The outpost hails you after the scout was destroyed, "Thanks for the help. We've been harassed non-stop by those scouts. Take this on the house."
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-disabled-the-r: With the ship disabled, the remaining Engi hails you frantically and explains the situation to you.
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-destroyed-the-: With the ship destroyed, the remaining Engi hails you frantically and explains the situation to you.
wiki.quests.apparently-you-interrupted-t: {{hail}} Apparently, you interrupted the equivalent of a "consolidation" of two ships that were using each other's parts to construct a new vessel. The Engi were not truly hostile, their targeting computers had not finished adjusting. There's nothing to be done about it now. You leave the remains for the surviving ship.
wiki.quests.with-the-rock-crew-dead-you: With the Rock crew dead, you scrap the ship for supplies.
wiki.quests.with-the-rock-ship-destroyed: With the Rock Ship destroyed, you take the time to collect what little scrap remains.
wiki.quests.kazaaakplethkilik-fights-to-: KazaaakplethKilik fights to the last, and you pick the scraps from the corpse of his ship. You sense, though, that his death has left a great mystery unresolved.
wiki.quests.move-in-to-strip-their-ship: Move in to strip their ship.
wiki.quests.quickly-teleport-additional-: Quickly teleport additional crew and check for survivors.
wiki.quests.quickly-scan-their-ship-for-: Quickly scan their ship for survivors.
wiki.quests.no-more-life-signs-are-detec: No more life signs are detected aboard their ship.  You appear to have won.
wiki.quests.with-the-patrol-ship-destroy: With the patrol ship destroyed you hasten to leave. It won't be long before the other ships catch up.
wiki.quests.with-the-patrol-ship-taken-c: With the patrol ship taken care of you hasten to leave. It won't be long before the other ships catch up.
wiki.quests.you-quickly-salvage-what-you: You quickly salvage what you can from the ship.
wiki.quests.you-find-an-intact-weapon-on: You find an intact weapon on their now empty ship. You take as much scrap from the ships as possible.
wiki.quests.their-ship-breaks-apart-and-: Their ship breaks apart and you salvage the two ships.
wiki.quests.with-the-pirate-defeated-you: With the pirate defeated you scan the debris for anything useful. The Slug ship is long gone, spoils from the cache in hand.
wiki.quests.with-the-pirate-taken-care-o: With the pirate taken care of, you search again for the cache he was protecting, but it's lost in the clouds. You console yourself with the salvage from the well-armed pirate ship.
wiki.quests.with-the-pirate-defeated-you: With the pirate defeated, you search again for the cache he was protecting, but it's lost in the clouds. You console yourself with the salvage from the well-armed pirate ship.
wiki.quests.once-their-crew-is-dead-you: Once their crew is dead you scan the log for information regarding the envoy. You're in luck! It seems ships matching the thieves' description passed through here not too long ago. You strip the ship and prepare to pursue them.
wiki.quests.you-take-what-you-can-from: You take what you can from the debris.
wiki.quests.a-quick-search-of-their-comm: A quick search of their communication logs shows that the tech you were searching for never passed through this base... It must have been a decoy! You strip what you can and prepare to jump.
wiki.quests.you-strip-what-you-can-and: You strip what you can and contact the Engi ships.
wiki.quests.with-the-assault-ship-taken-: With the assault ship taken care of, you turn your attention to the construction platform. However, you find that it has long since disappeared into the clouds. You scrap what you can and prepare to move on.
wiki.quests.with-the-escort-destroyed-yo: With the escort destroyed you take a look at your impressive prize. Your mission is too pressing to take a test flight. Before you rig the ship's computer to guide the it back to the main Federation hangar you discover a unique augment that duplicates the Slug's ability to heal breaches!
wiki.quests.the-outpost-hails-you-thank-: The outpost hails you, "Thank you! I don't know what we did to anger the Rebels, but they were ready to kill us. I'll show you our goods and patch up your hull."
wiki.quests.with-the-crew-dead-you-scrap: With the crew dead, you scrap the ship.
wiki.quests.the-pirate-has-abandoned-pur: The pirate has abandoned pursuit of both you and its former prey. You attempt to hail the damaged ship.
wiki.quests.the-lanius-ship-has-escaped-: The Lanius ship has escaped. You move to inspect the automated Rebel ship that it was absorbing.
wiki.quests.the-ship-made-an-emergency-f: The ship made an emergency FTL jump, but it looks like they didn't mask their signatures. You could easily follow them if you want.
wiki.quests.looks-like-they-got-away-at: Looks like they got away. At least you're able to scrap their abandoned fighter.
wiki.quests.with-the-ship-gone-you-searc: With the ship gone, you search through the abandoned base for any signs of their destination but find none.
With the ship gone you search through the abandoned base for any signs of their destination but find none.
wiki.quests.the-interceptor-jumps-away-w: The interceptor jumps away with the cruiser linked to its FTL signatures. You were so close...
wiki.quests.the-scout-jumps-away-they-ar:
The scout jumps away. They are sure to have informed the fleet of your position. You must get to the next Sector as soon as possible!

Rebel Fleet pursuit is doubled.

wiki.sectors.in-normal-circumstances-the: In normal circumstances the sector has 1-2 stores. Map generation leaves about 0.8% with no stores at all.
wiki.sectors.the-beacon-list-also-shows-: The beacon list also shows 0-1 stores and 1 nebula store.

wiki.sectors.only-once-per-game-and-only: Only once per game, and only through the Ancient device event. It is not technically part of the map.
wiki.sectors.it-is-a-standalone-sector-s: It is a standalone sector, separate from Rock Homeworlds. The Rebels keep following you through it.
wiki.sectors.exiting-sends-you-to-a-rand: Exiting sends you to a random sector after the Rock Homeworlds. That next sector may not be connected to the Rock Homeworlds.
wiki.sectors.stores-and-crew-kill-reward: Stores and crew-kill rewards offer only crystal weapons, including the Lockdown Bomb. Only Crystal crew can be bought or received as a crew-kill reward.
wiki.sectors.restarting-while-still-in-t: Restarting while still in this sector drops the run into a Civilian sector. The exit will not open the sector map, so sector 2 is chosen at random.
wiki.sectors.always-sector-8-as-the-fina: Always sector 8. As the final sector, it occurs only once.
wiki.sectors.at-the-start-the-ship-recei: At the start the ship receives 10 repairs and 10 fuel.
wiki.sectors.the-rebel-flagship-spawns-o: The Rebel Flagship spawns on the right and jumps every two jumps you make. A dotted or solid line shows whether it jumps this turn. Sharing its beacon starts the fight.
wiki.sectors.the-rebel-fleet-does-not-ad: The Rebel Fleet does not advance from the left. It overtakes random beacons each turn, marked by flashing red outlines. The Flagship also overtakes the beacon it is on.
wiki.sectors.the-federation-base-sits-sl: The Federation base sits slightly right of centre, and the Flagship jumps toward it. 3 consecutive jumps on the base lose the game.
wiki.sectors.the-base-is-never-overtaken: The base is never overtaken. If the Flagship is forced off, it returns to Federation control. The base acts like an empty beacon.
wiki.sectors.waiting-is-allowed-even-wit: Waiting is allowed even with fuel, and it advances the Flagship and the flashing beacons. A fight after a wait starts with full FTL charge.
wiki.sectors.each-repair-beacon-gives-15: Each repair beacon gives 15 repairs, 22-44 scrap, 5 fuel, 4 missiles, and 5 drones. Each can be used once, and it may be overtaken before you arrive.
wiki.sectors.the-beacon-list-gives-1-sto: The beacon list gives 1 store and 3 repair stations.
wiki.sectors.crew-bought-or-received-as-: Crew bought or received as a reward, common to rare: Human rarity 1, Engi and Mantis 2, Rockmen 3, Zoltan 5. Rarity only affects store assortment probability.
wiki.stores.the-number-of-guaranteed-sto: The number of guaranteed stores is determined by the sector type.
wiki.stores.additional-stores-come-from-: Additional stores come from events, and how many depends on the sector.
wiki.stores.with-advanced-edition-conten: With Advanced Edition content off, a store might sell only 2 weapons instead of a regular 3.
With Advanced Edition content off, a store might sell only 1 crew instead of a regular 3.
wiki.stores.a-regular-store-offering-is-: A regular store offering is 3 items, which the empty-slot bug can undercut.
wiki.stores.with-all-8-main-systems-inst: With all 8 main systems installed, some system slots in a store can be empty.
wiki.stores.missile-stock-varies-but-the: Missile stock varies, but the missile price is fixed.
wiki.stores.drone-part-stock-varies-but-: Drone part stock varies, but the drone part price is fixed.
wiki.stores.the-cost-of-repairing-1-hull: The cost of repairing 1 hull point of damage is determined by the sector number.
wiki.stores.stores-sell-limited-quantiti: Stores sell limited quantities of fuel, missiles, and drone parts, and that stock varies.
wiki.stores.stores-sell-2-4-slots-of: Stores sell 2-4 slots of systems, weapons, drone schematics, augmentations, and crewmembers.
wiki.stores.each-slot-contains-3-random-: Each slot contains 3 random items or crewmembers of that type.
wiki.stores.a-bought-teleporter-always-h: A bought teleporter always has 2 slots, not 4.
wiki.stores.if-a-ship-has-less-than: If a ship has less than 11 systems and subsystems, there is a 50% chance the first store slot is forced to be systems.
wiki.stores.rarity-normally-goes-from-1-: Rarity normally goes from 1 to 5, with 1 being common.
Rarity normally goes from 1 to 5, with 5 being rare.
wiki.stores.if-rarity-is-set-to-0: If rarity is set to 0, that item cannot be randomly found in game.
wiki.stores.fuel-costs-2-scrap-from-refu: Fuel costs 2 scrap from refuelling station events.
wiki.stores.each-jump-between-beacons-co: Each jump between beacons costs 1 fuel, including backtracking.
wiki.stores.out-of-fuel-enemy-ships-usua: Out of fuel, enemy ships usually jump away after 90 seconds if not stopped.
wiki.stores.out-of-fuel-the-anti-stalema: Out of fuel, the anti-stalemate hull threshold is likely below 50%.
wiki.stores.out-of-fuel-that-hull-thresh: Out of fuel, that hull threshold is closer to 30-40%.
wiki.stores.out-of-fuel-the-anti-stalema: Out of fuel, the anti-stalemate ends the fight by granting 2 fuel.
Out of fuel, the anti-stalemate waits 1 minute without further hull damage.
Out of fuel, the anti-stalemate trigger works 60 seconds after an enemy boarder dies.
wiki.stores.firing-a-missile-or-a-bomb: Firing a missile or a bomb consumes 1 missile.
wiki.stores.the-explosive-replicator-giv: The Explosive Replicator gives a 50% chance of not consuming a missile.
wiki.stores.each-drone-deployment-costs-: Each drone deployment costs 1 drone part.
wiki.surrender.we-yield-aliens-we-have-n: "We yield, aliens. We have no wish to die fighting you."
wiki.surrender.you-have-bested-us-i-will: "You have bested us! I will no longer underestimate you Outsiders. Please, let us leave in peace."
wiki.surrender.they-appear-to-be-transmi: They appear to be transmitting the universal signals for surrender. Will you let them go?
wiki.surrender.they-message-you-i-see-no: They message you, "I see now there was a misunderstanding and there is no need for more bloodshed. Will you forgive our lack of discretion?"
wiki.surrender.we-cannot-beat-you-we-sur: "We cannot beat you, we surrender. Surely there is mercy wherever you come from."
wiki.surrender.thank-you-i-hope-our-earl: "Thank you. I hope our early aggression will not prevent a future accord between our peoples." They transfer some goods as a means of compensation.
wiki.surrender.they-thank-you-for-sparin: They thank you for sparing them, their extreme aggression quickly changing to a calm acceptance. You're not sure if they're mocking you when they dryly state that "your species has a knack for warfare".
wiki.surrender.we-would-like-to-apologiz: "We would like to apologize for our xenophobia. You have shown that aliens can be compassionate, a fact unwritten in our history records. Please, take this."
wiki.surrender.thank-you-we-have-misjudg: "Thank you. We have misjudged you and will not forget your kindness." They leave without another word.
wiki.surrender.they-respond-good-i-m-gla: They respond, "Good. I'm glad to hear that there are still those who value life throughout the galaxy." They abruptly cut communications and prepare to jump away.
wiki.surrender.the-hunters-message-you-w: The hunters message you, "We surrender. Take one of these squishy meat sacks that we've captured." He must be referring to the human captives.
wiki.surrender.their-ship-seems-severely: Their ship seems severely damaged and they look to be reconsidering the fight. Should you power down your weapons and explain that you mean no threat?
wiki.surrender.they-accept-your-explanat:
They accept your explanation and allow you to approach the fleet. It appears they are miners and colonists from a fringe settlement who are fleeing to more protected space after hearing reports of pirate and rebel attacks.

They apologize for their hasty response to your presence and spend some time refueling and repairing both ships.
wiki.surrender.fine-our-previous-offer-w: "Fine! Our previous offer was not generous enough, let's improve it."
wiki.surrender.accept-the-more-generous-: Accept the more generous bribe and leave.
wiki.surrender.reject-the-offer-and-cont: Reject the offer and continue your assault.
wiki.surrender.they-hail-you-we-realize-: They hail you, "We realize our ship is no match for yours. If you let us go we can make it worth your while."
wiki.surrender.alright-we-give-up-we-re: "Alright! We give up! We're terrible at this pirating thing anyway..."
wiki.surrender.we-surrender-take-one-of-: We surrender! Take one of our slaves as tribute; if you destroy us they'll all die anyway!
wiki.surrender.you-have-besssted-us-will: "You have besssted us! Will you accept what is in our storeesss in exchange for our livess?" "Take thisss newly developed weapon we're transporting..."
wiki.surrender.let-them-live-accept-the-: Let them live. Accept the prototype weapon.
wiki.surrender.this-odd-beam-weapon-does: This odd beam weapon does no damage to ships but instead greatly hurts the crew! Diabolical!
wiki.surrender.let-them-live-we-don-t: Let them live. We don't want the weapon, we want information.
wiki.surrender.the-pirates-hail-you-enou: The pirates hail you: "Enough! Take what's left of the cargo and let us go."
wiki.surrender.they-hail-your-ship-sayin: They hail your ship saying, "You win! We're not cut out for this!"
wiki.surrender.let-them-live-and-then-re: Let them live and then return to the settlement.
wiki.surrender.with-the-pirates-dissuade: With the pirates dissuaded from their career path, you return to the settlement. "Thank you, they returned to us before you did. I don't think we'll need this anymore."
wiki.surrender.i-see-the-rumorsss-are-tr: "I see the rumorsss are true. I yield, we are no match for you. Take this and let us leave in ssshame."
wiki.surrender.he-transfers-over-the-goo: He transfers over the goods and starts to repair his ship.
wiki.surrender.the-zoltan-captain-sends-: The Zoltan captain sends an urgent hail: "Wait, this was all a test! A test that you passed! A diverse crew, working together, surely a sight to warm the heart of any dispassionate observer. Come, I shall join your crew!"
wiki.surrender.when-the-pirate-ship-look: When the pirate ship looks ready to break apart you notice the Slug ship has secured the loot and is preparing to jump away!
wiki.surrender.let-the-pirate-escape-and: Let the pirate escape and go after the Slugman ship.
wiki.surrender.the-pirate-s-too-badly-da: The pirate's too badly damaged to pursue you, and you catch up to the Slugs before they jump. "Ah, of courssse, we would never leave without providing the agreed upon ssspoils." They transfer over a decent chunk of the profits and set off.
wiki.surrender.demand-information-on-the: Demand information on the stolen technology.
wiki.surrender.of-course-that-s-why-you: "Of course, that's why you're here. Yes, they passed by here but I had nothing to do with it, I don't know what they were carrying. I'll transmit coordinates. Now just let us go..." You prepare an FTL message containing the coordinates to send to the Engies and get ready to jump.
wiki.surrender.stop-i-don-t-want-to: "Stop! I don't want to die here."
wiki.surrender.ah-so-that-s-what-you: "Ah, so that's what you're after. Too bad, you followed the wrong ship. The envoy that passed through here was a fake, to trick fools like you. Now let us go!"
wiki.surrender.look-you-proved-your-poin: "Look, you proved your point. We don't want to die... Take this and let us go. Please?"
wiki.surrender.thank-you-but-do-you-have: "Thank you. But do you have any idea how much repairing TWO ships will set us back?..." What an odd Mantis. You prepare to leave.
wiki.surrender.a-crewmember-and-scrap-wi: A {{race}} crewmember, and {{tier}} scrap with resources.
wiki.surrender.enemies-may-also-surrende: Enemies may also surrender after dropping below a hull threshold.
wiki.surrender.a-minute-without-a-hit-th: A minute without a hit. The fight breaks off. +{{STALEMATE_FUEL}} fuel.
wiki.surrender.neither-ship-can-finish-i: Neither ship can finish it. Both crews break off.
wiki.surrender.no-free-weapon-slot-is-st: No free weapon slot: {{v}} is stowed in cargo.
wiki.surrender.no-room-in-cargo-for-choo: No room in cargo for {{v}}: choose what to leave behind.
wiki.surrender.there-is-no-room-aboard-f: There is no room aboard for their crewmember.
wiki.surrender.what-appears-to-be-a-youn: What appears to be a young soldier pushes its way onto the vid screen, "A captain both able and merciful? I have always wanted to explore beyond our restricted sector... Please, permit me to join your crew?"
wiki.surrender.you-cut-off-communication: You cut off communications and prepare to finish them off.
wiki.surrender.wait-there-is-no-need-to: "Wait! There is no need to be...." You cut off the transmission and prepare to fire.
wiki.surrender.they-wanted-to-pick-a-fig: They wanted to pick a fight with you so that's what they'll get.
wiki.surrender.who-knows-how-many-humans: Who knows how many humans will be saved if you kill them now.
wiki.surrender.offer-refused-they-brace-: Offer refused. They brace for more.
wiki.surrender.they-send-one-of-their-pr: They send one of their prisoners over to your ship. They're a bit shaken up and you suspect that they were once a rebel, but they seem to be very glad to be free.
wiki.surrender.you-receive-a-human-crewm: You receive a Human crewmember and the fight continues.
wiki.surrender.a-crewmember-joins-you-th: A {{crew}} crewmember joins you. The fight continues.
wiki.surrender.no-room-aboard-the-fight-: No room aboard. The fight continues.
wiki.surrender.they-hand-over-their-carg: They hand over their cargo, and a {{weaponName}}.
They hand over their cargo and limp away.
wiki.surrender.boarders-burst-out-of-the: {{n}} boarders burst out of the crates.
wiki.surrender.human-boarders-beam-aboar: human boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.surrender.rock-boarders-beam-aboard: {{n}} rock boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.surrender.mantis-boarders-beam-aboa: {{n}} mantis boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.surrender.zoltan-boarders-beam-aboa: {{n}} zoltan boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.surrender.crystal-boarders-beam-abo: {{n}} crystal boarders beam aboard your ship.
wiki.surrender.the-cargo-appears-to-cont: The cargo appears to contain nothing of much interest. You salvage some scrap from the destroyed ship.
wiki.surrender.your-advanced-sensors-are: Your Advanced Sensors are able to breach the protective barrier and scan the cargo. It appears to be filled with military supplies! You take everything you can use.
wiki.surrender.your-advanced-sensors-pic: Your advanced sensors pick up faint life signatures inside the cargo. The life forms appear to be armed. This looks like a planned pirate ambush.
wiki.surrender.destroy-the-crates-to-pre: Destroy the crates to prevent another ship from falling victim.
wiki.surrender.leave-it-alone-and-prepar: Leave it alone and prepare to jump.
wiki.surrender.the-engi-seem-relieved-an: The Engi seem relieved, and eager to get underway. They set off without saying goodbye.
wiki.surrender.the-engi-are-satisfied-wi: The Engi are satisfied with your explanation. "Beneficial. Subject goal: long, long journey. Remains compatible with transfer of goods from Engi." They send over the gear willingly, and you feel better for it.
wiki.surrender.the-engi-obediently-trans: The Engi obediently transfer over the goods and get on their way. Money for nothing.
wiki.surrender.they-appear-to-be-filled-: They appear to be filled with military supplies! You take everything you can use and jettison the rest.
wiki.surrender.the-cargo-was-primarily-c: The cargo was primarily consumer goods and clothing, nothing particularly useful. You manage to collect some scrap.
wiki.surrender.once-you-bring-the-cargo-: Once you bring the cargo onto your ship, a pirate bursts out of one of the crates saying, "Ugh... I was getting cramped in there. Oh, yeah! Prepare to die!" Immediately after this battle-cry your ship is filled with the sound of crates breaking open...
wiki.surrender.you-bring-the-cargo-aboar: You bring the cargo aboard. Before you have a chance to open them a pirate ship appears out of hiding and charges. At the same time, the crates fly open. Intruders aboard the ship!
wiki.surrender.you-fire-on-the-crates-br: You fire on the crates, breaking them open and scattering the pirates into empty space. A pirate ship appears out of nowhere with a message, "You will pay for that!"
wiki.surrender.some-of-our-friends-have-: "Some of our friends have taken to piracy in the recent chaos of the war. We'd like you to "convince" them of their poor decision by severely damaging the ship. We'll pay you well as long as you don't kill them all."
wiki.surrender.a-space-dock-is-under-ass: "A space dock is under assault from the Rebels. Although the dock is... technically... illegal within their laws, it's very important for our trade. We'll pay you in fuel and scrap if you promise to save them."
wiki.surrender.just-be-sure-not-to-blow: "Just be sure not to blow them up!" they say nervously as they direct you to a nearby moon. You find the pirate ship docked there. They immediately respond to your appearance with, "Your money or your life!" They must be new to this.
wiki.surrender.fine-i-don-t-know-what: "Fine. I don't know what we'll do about them though..." You prepare to jump away from this sector.
wiki.surrender.they-transmit-the-space-d:
They transmit the space dock's coordinates.

wiki.surrender.well-i-have-heard-of-you: "Well I have heard of you and I must see if you are as dangerousss as they say. I challenge you!"
wiki.surrender.engage-in-a-duel-of-the: Engage in a duel of the mind.
wiki.surrender.your-slug-crewman-s-eyes-: Your Slug crewman's eyes glaze over as the two telepaths concentrate. You can only wonder what is happening. After a short time your comrade grunts in pain and collapses onto the floor, stunned. Nights responds, "Hah! It'll take more than that to defeat me! Let the real battle begin!"

Your Slug crewman's eyes glaze over as the two telepaths concentrate. You are powerless to help, but after a short time your comrade shakes off the daze and appears victorious.

His face contorted with pain, Nights concedes his defeat: "If this is the caliber of subordinatesss you keep, there iss no way we can defeat you. Take thisss and let us leave in shame."
wiki.surrender.captain-nights-accepts-th: Captain Nights accepts. The Black Raven moves in.
wiki.surrender.i-sssee-however-you-have-: "I sssee... However you have no choice in the matter!" They move in to attack.
wiki.surrender.great-as-he-brings-his-fe:
"Great!" As he brings his few belongings on board, you wonder how a being made of crystal can move with such lightness and enthusiasm.

You receive a Crystal crewmember.

"Great!" As he brings his few belongings on board, you wonder how a being made of crystal can move with such lightness and enthusiasm.

There is no room aboard for their crewmember.
wiki.surrender.i-understand-we-did-try-t: "I understand. We did try to kill you..." They transfer some materials over before leaving.
wiki.surrender.you-allow-them-to-approac: You allow them to approach, but are caught unaware when they open fire!
wiki.surrender.we-have-been-studying-the: We have been studying the relationships between the species and have determined that the 'Federation' still has potential to be a net positive for the galaxy. Please accept this gift to aid your journey.
wiki.weapons-beam.extremely-cheap-and-we: Extremely cheap and weak beam weapon.
wiki.weapons-beam.can-cut-across-entire-: Can cut across entire ships, assuming there's no shield to stop it.
wiki.weapons-beam.this-beam-is-most-powe: This beam is most powerful when targeting large, empty sections of hull.
wiki.weapons-beam.slow-but-reliably-powe: Slow but reliably powerful standard beam weapon.
wiki.weapons-beam.one-of-the-most-powerf: One of the most powerful weapons of war ever created. Known to take out some ships in a single blast.
wiki.weapons-beam.this-terrifying-beam-d: This terrifying beam does no physical damage but ignites fires.
This terrifying beam does no physical damage, but rips through organic material, dealing heavy damage to crew members.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-mini-beam: Beam (Weapons), "Mini Beam": beam length 45 (1 tile diagonally). Crew damage 15 HP per room tile. WeaponDef has no length or crew-damage field.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-pike-beam: Beam (Weapons), "Pike Beam": beam length 170 (3.8 tiles diagonally). Crew damage 15 HP per room tile. WeaponDef has no length or crew-damage field.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-hull-beam: Beam (Weapons), "Hull Beam": beam length 100 (2.2 tiles diagonally). 2 damage on systemless rooms, applied as hull damage. Each shield layer cuts that figure by one. Crew damage 15 HP per room tile. WeaponDef stores only the 1 damage per room.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-halberd-b: Beam (Weapons), "Halberd Beam": beam length 80 (1.8 tiles diagonally). Can target 3-4 rooms straight, 2-3 diagonally, 5 max. Still deals 1 damage per room through 1 shield. Crew damage 30 HP per room tile.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-glaive-be: Beam (Weapons), "Glaive Beam": beam length 80 (1.8 tiles diagonally). Still deals 1 damage per room through 2 shields, or 2 damage per room through 1 shield. Crew damage 45 HP per room tile.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-fire-beam: Beam (Weapons), "Fire Beam": beam length 140 (3.1 tiles diagonally). Deals 1 point of damage twice against Zoltan Shields. Crew damage is listed as "-". Fires: "Fire beams can be blocked by a regular shield barrier (1 is enough)".
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-anti-bio-: Beam (Weapons), "Anti-Bio Beam": beam length 140 (3.1 tiles diagonally). Crew damage 60 HP per room tile, which is not hull damage. Deals 1 point of damage twice against Zoltan Shields. Beam (Weapons): "even one shield layer is enough to block most beam weapons."
wiki.weapons-beam.lance-ts-owns-the-syst: lance.ts owns the system. Beam (Weapons), "Artillery Beam": artillery system with 4 system levels maximum. Charge time 50s for level 1, reduced by 10 seconds for each level above 1 to a minimum of 20s for level 4. Beam length 500 (12.5 tiles diagonally). Deals 1 damage per room hit and ignores all standard shields. Crew damage 15 HP per room tile. Effect: 10% chance to start fire (per tile). Pre-installed on Federation Cruiser Layout A and Layout B. Opening paragraph: pierces all regular shield layers (up to all 5).
wiki.weapons-beam.inferred-the-artillery: INFERRED: the artillery maximum is 3, stored on the WeaponDef in flagship-weapons.ts, and it is not a Weapons-pool cost. Beam (Weapons), "Boss Beam" states no power requirement. This catalog does not emit a second WeaponDef. Charge time 32.5s for level 1, 26s for level 2, 19.5s for level 3. Beam length 100 (2.2 tiles diagonally). Deals 2 damage per room hit. Artillery system with 3 system levels maximum. Only used by the Rebel Flagship in phase 1-2. The italic quote is inside an HTML comment and is not copied.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-beam-targ: Beam (Weapons), "Beam targeting and damage mechanics": the damage of a beam is reduced by one for every shield layer. Beams do not deplete regular shield layers. A 2-damage Halberd Beam deals 1 damage per room through 1 shield layer. Damage to crew drones is halved. A drone that already has health and is in the room takes half the crew damage.

Beam (Weapons), "Beam targeting and damage mechanics": the first click sets the starting point and the second click fires. Even a tiny edge of a room counts, and damage is applied when the beam first enters that room. A longer swipe stops at the printed tile length. A closer click is not stretched. Halberd's "3-4 rooms straight, 2-3 diagonally, 5 max" is not the room rule. Enemies still start in the centre of a room. INFERRED: an enemy swipe adds one door-neighbour.
wiki.weapons-beam.beam-weapons-beams-vs-: Beam (Weapons), "Beams vs Zoltan Shields": first damage instance at 33% of the beam path, second at 80%. Beams that do no hull damage do 1 damage per instance. A Halberd Beam deals 4 damage (2 x 2 instances). A Fire Beam or Anti-Bio Beam deals 2 damage (1 x 2 instances).

wiki.weapons-laser.laser-weapons-heavy-l: Laser (Weapons), "Heavy Laser Mark II": "Moderate-low chance to stun crew". No stun percent is published. WeaponDef has no stun field.
wiki.weapons-laser.laser-weapons-hull-sm: Laser (Weapons), "Hull Smasher Laser": "Damage per shot: 1 (to system rooms) or 2 (to systemless rooms)". damage stores the system-room 1. Systemless rooms take 2 hull damage. Crew damage is not increased. "Types of lasers" states both.

Laser (Weapons), "Hull Smasher Laser Mark II": "Damage per shot: 1 (to system rooms) or 2 (to systemless rooms)". damage stores the system-room 1. Systemless rooms take 2 hull damage. Crew damage is not increased. "Types of lasers" states both.
wiki.weapons-laser.laser-weapons-chain-b: Laser (Weapons), "Chain Burst Laser": "Charge-up profile: 16s/13s/10s/7s (-3s per step, 3 steps total)". charge stores the first step, 16. Later steps are 13, 10, and 7. "Charge time resets to 16 seconds if the weapon goes offline". cited-chain.ts steps combat through that profile.
wiki.weapons-laser.laser-weapons-chain-v: Laser (Weapons), "Chain Vulcan": "Charge-up profile: 11.1s / 9.1s / 7.1s / 5.1s / 3.1s / 1.1s (-2s per step, 5 steps total)". charge stores the first step, 11.1. Later steps are 9.1, 7.1, 5.1, 3.1, and 1.1. "Charge time resets to 11.1 seconds if the weapon goes offline". "It takes 35.5 seconds before the Vulcan gets up to full speed". cited-chain.ts steps combat through that profile.
wiki.weapons-laser.laser-weapons-laser-c: Laser (Weapons), "Laser Charger (S)": "Charge time: 5.5 seconds per shot, up to 2 shots". "Shots: 1-2". shots stores the full charge, 2. "Autofire" causes continuous fire, disables charging. "Weapon Pre-Igniter will only charge one shot by default".

Laser (Weapons), "Laser Charger": "Charge time: 6 seconds per shot, up to 2 shots". "Shots: 1-2". shots stores the full charge, 2. "Autofire" causes continuous fire, disables charging. "Weapon Pre-Igniter will only charge one shot by default".

Laser (Weapons), "Laser Charger Mark II": "Charge time: 5 seconds per shot, up to 4 shots". "Shots: 1-4". shots stores the full charge, 4. "Autofire" causes continuous fire, disables charging. "Weapon Pre-Igniter will only charge one shot by default".
wiki.weapons-laser.inferred-the-artiller: INFERRED: the artillery maximum is 4, stored on the WeaponDef in flagship-weapons.ts, and it is not a Weapons-pool cost. Laser (Weapons), "Boss Laser" states no power requirement. This catalog does not emit a second WeaponDef. Charge time 25s for level 1, 20s for level 2, 15s for level 3, 10s for level 4. Shots: 3. Damage per shot: 1. Artillery system with 4 system levels maximum. Only used by the Rebel Flagship in phase 1-3. Effect: low chance of fire or breach. The section gives no percent.
wiki.weapons-missile.these-missiles-are-: These missiles are designed to cause maximum destruction to ship hull armor.
wiki.weapons-missile.high-hull-damage-pl: High hull damage plus a decent breach chance.
wiki.weapons-missile.if-given-time-to-pr: If given time to prepare, the 'Swarm' launcher can replicate multiple warheads.
wiki.weapons-missile.creative-missile-de: Creative missile design allows for two projectiles for the cost of one!
