wiki.cited-missing.crystal-chat-intro: A small civilian vessel messages you, "Wow! You're that alien that opened up the portal, aren't you! Are you busy? Can I ask you a question?"
wiki.cited-missing.have-your-crew-speak: Have your crew speak to them.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-intro: Odd radar pings from a huge, orbiting asteroid here reveal a Crystalline cache of some kind. A deep crater has been sealed over with a thick layer of crystal to keep whatever's inside safe — it'd take some serious firepower to break through.
wiki.cited-missing.attempt-to-break-thro: Attempt to break through with the weapons you have.
wiki.cited-missing.recalibrate-your-weap: Have your Crystalline Being recalibrate your weapons.
wiki.cited-missing.buried-intro: A large Crystalline ship is floating in space here. They hail: "Aliens?! How curious. We request your aid. We have men buried on a nearby planet and we must dig them out."
wiki.cited-missing.research-intro: You arrive near what appears to be a Crystalline research facility. A scientist quickly messages you, "Ah! You're those aliens! Please, I've heard so much about you and I'm curious about your physiology! Would you let us run a few simple tests?"
wiki.cited-missing.allow-tests: Allow them to run tests on a crew member.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-station-intro: You arrive at a smoldering Engi research station, its distress call unanswered — attacked by pirates or Mantis most likely. There may be someone left alive, or else something of value left on board.
wiki.cited-missing.standard-gift: You receive a random amount of scrap with resources.
wiki.cited-missing.zoltan-scrap-intro: You arrive to find a lumbering Zoltan freighter with no one at the helm. It's a mystery what happened to the crew, but it'd be a shame to let the opportunity go to waste.
wiki.cited-missing.zoltan-map-body: The Zoltan stationed near this beacon are happy to receive you. As they give you the formal tour of their ship you spy some local star charts and mentally log the details.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-empty-1: You arrive at the location of the distress signal prepared for a fight, but on first glance it's entirely empty. The signal is coming from a small plastic satellite orbiting a moon. A looping message describes how settlers have recently abandoned the area due to the Lanius threat. You fail to find any other signs of a settlement nearby.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-empty-2: When you get to the beacon you quickly try to locate the source of the distress call. As you are looking, the signal blinks out. It is then that you notice the small fleet of scavenger ships absorbing debris from a large battle nearby. You can't help but wonder where the distress signal came from, but you decide not to risk pressuring the fleet.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-science-intro: A Federation science craft is docked with a few Lanius ships. You hail them and ask what is going on. "Greetings! We have been attempting to understand our region's newest visitors, the Lanius, although we have been making little headway in deciphering their language."
wiki.cited-missing.ask-for-help: Ask if they have anything that could help your mission.
wiki.cited-missing.offer-translator: Offer to copy your translator's data suite.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-intro: You find a Slug vessel broadcasting a distress signal and contact them. "Ah, yesss, we are having problems with our oxygen generation unit. Perhaps your crew can assist in repairsss?"
wiki.cited-missing.mantis-oversee: Have your Mantis oversee the repairs.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-intro: You arrive to find a small Slug repair station. "Greetingsss traveller! Care for a fix up? We could eassily patch up ssome of that damage."
wiki.cited-missing.ask-about-payment: Ask if they would like payment.
wiki.cited-missing.store-intro: A Slug transport ship is stationed near the beacon with a military escort ship. They message you, "We have been waiting for a customer for agesss. Care to see our waresss?"
wiki.cited-missing.standoff-nebula-intro: You detect multiple ships running at maximum power nearby, but you can't see anything through this thick nebula.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-gift-1: An Engi vessel hails you. "Identity: Federation? Outlier probability. Implies... revival. Implies... hope. Assistance suggested." They offer some supplies.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-gift-2: You cross paths with an Engi cargo vessel hurrying home before the Mantis fleets attempt to take over this sector. They're happy to offload some of their cargo to get home faster.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-gift-3: You make contact with an isolated Engi science station who are staying put despite the likelihood of Mantis invasion. They suggest you trial some experimental technology.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-gift-4: This was the site of a recent battle. Either a show of Mantis force, or the Engi here weren't disposed to go peacefully. You pick through the pieces.
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-1: Although this sector is still under Federation control, a small scout has slipped by the fleet. You move in to engage.
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-2: Long range scanners show this system is empty of any capital ships. Clearly it is not of strategic value. Wait... FTL signatures show a Rebel scout just jumped nearby!
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-3: Sensors indicate that the Rebels are setting up a forward Jump Beacon behind the nearby planet's moon. More importantly, a number of ships are passing by; prepare for a fight!
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-4: Federation ships are scarce in this region of space despite a number of civilian space stations. You see a small bomber squadron engaged with some Federation scouts and quickly move in to assist.
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-5: As soon as you arrive at the beacon, a Rebel scout turns to engage. Power up the weapons!
wiki.cited-missing.last-stand-6: You scan the area, finding signatures for only a small trade vessel. However, as it approaches you see the silhouette of a Rebel scout! You run the scanners again and discover their registration is fake. You move in to attack.
wiki.cited-missing.trader-off-1: A merchant ship jumps into the sector and you quickly hail them asking for help. They respond, "Perhaps we could work out an exchange..."
wiki.cited-missing.trader-off-2: A number of ships pass through the sector. You relay your message to each, and one finally responds. "I can't help much right now but perhaps we can trade."
wiki.cited-missing.trader-off-3: A nearby settlement sends a small ship in your direction. It keeps its distance and hails you, "We can give you fuel for a price. Just don't even think of doing anything rash. We've got a teleporter at our base and a squad ready to defend us."
wiki.cited-missing.trader-off-4: A large caravan of merchant ships jumps to a location near your position. Sensing an opportunity, one ship breaks off from the fleet to offer you an exchange.
wiki.cited-missing.trader-off-5: A modified YT-1300 freighter jumps to an area near your sector. Your gut tells you these people are smugglers, but they seem to be feeling altruistic and present an offer of assistance.
wiki.cited-missing.trader-on-1: A merchant ship jumps into the sector, obviously responding to your ship's distress beacon. They hail you offering a trade for fuel.
wiki.cited-missing.trader-on-2: A ship arrives at the beacon. "We noticed your distress signal. I assume you're out of fuel? We're a bit low ourselves but perhaps we can make a trade."
wiki.cited-missing.trader-on-3: A ship traveling near the beacon approaches your ship and hails you. "Out of fuel? This is a good opportunity for both of us... Care to trade?"
wiki.cited-missing.trader-on-4: A mercenary ship arrives at the beacon. "We have a bit of extra fuel we can give you... for a price."
wiki.cited-missing.clone-bay-quiet: Before preparing to jump you check the Clone Bay but there is no sign of activity.
wiki.cited-missing.unable-to-help: Before they jump away, their captain says, "I'm sorry, but we are unable to help in any other way."
wiki.cited-missing.seeing-that-youre-in-: They respond: "Seeing that you're in need, is this trade acceptable?"
wiki.cited-missing.not-for-charity: "I'm not doing this for charity, you know," says their captain. "This is the only other way I'll part with my fuel."
wiki.cited-missing.cache-trap: You send a crewmember down to check out the cache. The comm goes dead, and shortly thereafter massive gravity readings are detected on the asteroid. You must have triggered some kind of singularity booby trap! We've got to leave now before we're pulled in!
wiki.cited-missing.detonate-fuel: Detonate your entire fuel reserves to escape with your crew and the cargo.
wiki.cited-missing.beam-crew-back: Beam your crewmember back on board.
wiki.cited-missing.rescue-with-engines: Rescue your crewmember and the cargo.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-weapons: On arriving at the base of the crater, your team discovers a long-forgotten weapons cache. Most of the equipment is out of action, but not all of it!
wiki.cited-missing.buried-waited: Another cycle passes while the Rebel fleet draws ever nearer. You contact the captain again. "Alien Captain, your knowledge of our customs has most impressed us. Your crewmember is on their way back to you now, along with a token of our respect."
wiki.cited-missing.buried-dig: You do as you're asked and send a crewmember down to the planet to assist. They discover a massive Crystal excavation operation and it quickly becomes clear this is a task that will take days, not hours.
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-insult: The Crystalline captain contacts you urgently: "What is the meaning of this?! Had you no wish to aid us you might simply have declined, but THIS... is an insult!" His turns his massive ship on yours and you prepare to fight for your life.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-engines-down: As you dock with the station your readings go haywire. An EMP blast resonates throughout the ship and your engines shut down. You're a sitting duck as a ship reveals itself and silently moves in to attack!
wiki.cited-missing.repair-weapons-half: You activate your thrusters and force your way away from the station. A ship quickly moves in to engage. You'll need to get out of here fast; there may not be time to get the weapons fully operational!
wiki.cited-missing.slug-trader-intro: A poorly armed Slug ship cruises by and offers assistance. Their captain seems to be chuckling to himself, perhaps at the prices he's charging.
wiki.cited-missing.slug-makes-the-purcha: Have your Slug make the purchase.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-intro: As you await either salvation or death, your attention is drawn to a sea of debris drifting past the starboard view port. The chunks gliding by grow bigger in size until the stern of a Rock frigate, gutted in some distant war, comes into view.
wiki.cited-missing.prepare-intro: A ship approaches. They hail you saying, "You need some fuel? We'll prepare to dock to help."
wiki.cited-missing.scan-sensors: Run a detailed scan with your sensors before responding.
wiki.cited-missing.scan-lrs: Run a detailed scan before responding.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-low: A refugee ship fleeing the Rebel advance enters the system, having picked up your distress beacon. While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, it recognizes you are part of the Federation and offers to split its remaining fuel with you.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-hull: A refugee ship fleeing the Rebel advance enters the system, having picked up your distress beacon. While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, its hull looks damaged — it is in bad need of scrap and is willing to trade fuel for it.
wiki.cited-missing.attack-them: The helpless refugees make easy targets. Attack them.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-arms: A refugee ship fleeing the Rebel advance enters the system, having picked up your distress beacon. While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, it is in bad need of armaments and is willing to trade for them.
wiki.cited-missing.slug-exchange: You doubt he is trustworthy but have no choice but to make the deal. However you complete the exchange without event. You receive 5 fuel.
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-questions: "What do you eat? What is your culture like? How long do your people live?"
wiki.cited-missing.no-time: I don't have time for this.
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-busy: "I see. Oh well. Maybe the next alien I meet will be nicer..." You prepare to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-rebel: You speak at length about nothing particularly interesting. "Wow, thanks. Oh look, another alien ship! I wonder if they're as nice as you." Seeing the Rebel decals you doubt they're friendly. They spot you and move in to attack, while the Crystalline civilian jumps away.
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-supplies: You speak at length about nothing particularly interesting. "Wow, thanks! I don't know if this is of any use to you, but we have some supplies we can offer you. Perhaps you can use them on your trip!"
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-repairs: You speak at length about nothing particularly interesting. "Wow, thanks! Perhaps we can fix up a bit of your hull for sating my curiosity. We're pretty handy with repairs."
wiki.cited-missing.crystal-kin: "Wow, you're one of us! I didn't know we made an alliance with the aliens. I guess I won't bother you, but here, have some of our extra supplies!"
wiki.cited-missing.cache-holds: You fire everything you have, but the crystal barrier remains strong. After a time you give up and move on.
wiki.cited-missing.missile-spent: Your Breach warheads dislodge and shatter a massive shard of crystal, leaving your away team enough space to climb down and take a look.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-pull: You push the impulse engines to their limit and are able to break out of the gravity well. Your crewmember, along with the stockpile, is reduced to the size of a tennis ball — but you're left in one piece.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-detonate: You swoop into the heart of the distortion and pick up your crewmember and the cargo. You then eject your FTL fuel and ignite it, sending a shock wave that thrust your ship well beyond the event horizon of the singularity. That was close.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-teleport: You floor the engines to escape the gravity well while trying to get a teleporter lock on your crewmember despite the massive interference. You're barely able to get them back on board before the entire area is consumed into the singularity.
wiki.cited-missing.cache-engines: You swoop into the heart of the distortion and pick up your crewmember and the cargo. Your top of the line impulse engines are barely able to get your ship out with the gravity well before the whole ship is consumed. That was close.
wiki.cited-missing.buried-refuse: "We understand. You rely on machines for so much. Yours is a soft and weak species — we would hardly even have noticed your presence. Fly well."
wiki.cited-missing.buried-leave: You're committed to both saving the Federation and upholding the principles it worked to maintain. Your crewmember will remain and make good on the promise — you still have a galaxy to save. They give you some supplies for your trouble.
wiki.cited-missing.buried-gift: You receive Heavy Crystal Mark II.
wiki.cited-missing.research-broken: After a short time the scientist returns, "We... must regret... we have made a grave miscalculation. Your bodies are considerably more fragile than we expected and your companion is... broken. We apologize and offer a fine military-grade weapon as consolation."
wiki.cited-missing.research-scans: Your crew member is brought on board their station and forced to undergo a few quick scans and tests. "Thank you for this opportunity! We hope to learn much from your kind." They transfer some supplies as payment.
wiki.cited-missing.research-genome: The large Crystalline Beings escort your crew onto the station and gingerly help them into a scanning chamber. After a few seconds, they inform you they have mapped their entire genome and have everything they need. They give you a schematic as compensation.
wiki.cited-missing.research-shame: "I see. That is a shame. Perhaps the next aliens we meet will have some respect for the advancement of science."
wiki.cited-missing.research-submit: "I see. That is a shame. However we must not let this opportunity pass us by. Submit and you will be treated reasonably well!" A military ship docked nearby detaches and charges you.
wiki.cited-missing.research-rock: "Ah! My dear evolutionary cousin! This is truly wonderful! We have countless historical records of your kind but we lack information on the past few hundreds of years. We can learn so much from these scans, we must get to analysing them as soon as possible! Please, take this."
wiki.cited-missing.research-dna: "What is this? Full genetic and personal profiles stored digitally? I did not think this possible... This will help our research immeasurably. Please, take this in exchange for your help."
wiki.cited-missing.engi-dead: You send an away team to investigate, but there's nothing save for the acidic stench of burnt Engi parts. This place is dead.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-reactor: Your away team reports a wounded Engi and a functioning drone schematic. Then someone yells. The station reactor is overloading and they're running out of time!
wiki.cited-missing.engi-ignore: The place looks in bad state, probably nothing of use there. Time to move on.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-second-scan: Scans reveal the station's reactor is overloading! Not only that, but an injured Engi and a functioning drone schematic are still on board! There's not time for both...
wiki.cited-missing.engi-safe: Your crew return safely to the airlock with the injured Engi and you put some distance on the station before it blows. The Engi, impressed by your crew, volunteers to join you.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-sucked-out: Your away team heads home with the goods, but as they transfer back to the ship, a small explosion blows the airlock and one of the crew is sucked out into space!
wiki.cited-missing.engi-schematic-saved: The Engi don't feel things the same way other species do. They'd want the tech to be saved. Your crew return safely to the airlock with the drone control and you put some distance on the station before it blows.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-selves: It's a tough order, but your crew's lives are the priority. They drop everything and return to ship unharmed. You put some distance on the station before it blows.
wiki.cited-missing.engi-scan-saved: Your away team heads straight for the Engi and returns with time to spare. You put some distance on the station before it blows and the Engi is so impressed by your crew that they volunteer to join you!
wiki.cited-missing.engi-scan-drone: The Engi don't feel things the same way other species do. They'd want the tech to be saved. Your away team heads straight for the goods and returns with time to spare. You put some distance on the station before it blows.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-weapon: "We were doing research on some Lanius weaponry before. I hope you don't have to use it but perhaps it will aid you on your mission." You thank them and prepare to move on.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-parts: "We use drones frequently in our work and have extra parts lying around." They transfer the parts over and you thank them for their generosity.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-scrap: "There should be some extra junk metal in some cargo bay..." You thank them once they transfer the scrap and prepare to move on.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-nothing: "Sorry we don't carry much equipment that would be of use to a military vessel." You thank them and prepare to move on.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-blue: Your Lanius crew had tweaked the ship's translator to slowly improve itself over time. They are grateful for your contribution and offer you some Lanius equipment that they were previously studying.
wiki.cited-missing.lanius-leave: You wish them well and prepare to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-fixed: You cautiously board their ship and immediately smell the stale air of a malfunctioning life support. In no time at all you're able to fix up the problem and head off again with some extra scrap in your hold.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-boarded: As soon as you board their ship their hostile intentions become clear. Despite being outnumbered, your crew is able to break free of the slug trap and fight back to the airlock. You pull away from the enemy ship but not before a few Slugs make it on board.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-shot: As soon as you board their ship their hostile intentions become clear. On your way back to the airlock, one of your crewmembers is taken out by a well aimed Slug blaster shot.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-ignore: You know better than to trust the Slugs. You cut communications and prepare to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.oxygen-mantis: Once on board, it becomes clear that nothing is wrong with their O2 system. Almost expecting this, your Mantis calmly responds to the trap. Once a couple of the Slugs have been spread across the walls of their ship, the rest surrender.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-no: "Too bad! Trussst iss a rare commodity these days." You prepare to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-ambush: Just before the transmission is cut you hear, "They're not falling for it. Just kill the crew and we can ssstrip..." Looks like you're not getting out of here without a fight.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-price: "Ahhh. A fellow businessman. We offer to fix 10 damage for 50 ssscrap."
wiki.cited-missing.repair-paid: You perform the transaction and watch carefully as their machines patch the hull. However, everything seems fine. Once they're complete you get ready to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-declined: "Too bad. Farewell, traveller." Their mobile station slips into the clouds.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-fuel-demand: "We're glad you have enjoyed our servicessss. Perhaps some fuel would be an appropriate compensssation?"
wiki.cited-missing.give-15-fuel: Give them the 15 fuel they demand.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-scrap-demand: "We're glad you have enjoyed our servicessss. Now for payment. To enssssure your cooperation we've taken the liberty of installing a limiter on your weapons system."
wiki.cited-missing.give-50-scrap: Give them the 50 scrap they demand.
wiki.cited-missing.store-decline: "Oh well... We ssshall wait here then." You cautiously put distance between your ships before preparing to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.store-rules: "Before we get ahead of ourssselves, I need to explain sssome ground ruless of our transsaction. Thesse are dangerous times, yess?" "Firssst... We accept no tradesss, couponss or refundss. Purchasess are final. Underssstand?"
wiki.cited-missing.slug-senses-someone: Our Slug senses someone aboard the ship. Investigate it.
wiki.cited-missing.store-slug-caught: It looks like the merchant was trying to stall you while someone teleported on board. You catch him before he could finish and he teleports away. You immediately prepare for battle.
wiki.cited-missing.store-liability: "We hold no liability for productsss damaged post ssale. We offer no insurance or customer sservice. Not a problem?"
wiki.cited-missing.store-die: "Thank you. If you could do me one more courtesssy... please die quietly." You suddenly hear gunshots aboard the ship. He must have been stalling for time while they boarded your ship!
wiki.cited-missing.store-weapons-down: "During our discussion, my man hass taken the liberty of disabling your weaponss to prevent any complications while completing our... transssaction..." You suddenly register multiple weapon locks, but your own weapons are not responding. Get out of there!
wiki.cited-missing.store-red-alert: You prepare to leave but notice noises in your ship. It looks like the merchant was trying to stall you while they hacked into your systems. You barely have time to order a red alert before a military ship flies through the clouds intent on your destruction!
wiki.cited-missing.store-impatient: "Very well... Impatient alienss..." You prepare to jump.
wiki.cited-missing.slug-trader-ignore: You know better than to do business with a Slugman who seems like he knows something you don't. He jumps off with another chuckle.
wiki.cited-missing.slug-theft: Everything looks secure but suddenly a number of supplies disappear! He must have planted a portable teleporter into your cargo bay somehow. Before you can react the ship is long gone. You lose {{missiles}} missiles and {{scrap}} scrap.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-board: Perhaps there's some viable fuel left on board; a small away team boards the vessel.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-map: One of the crew reports that the main computer was housed in this section and is still partially operational. They're able to download local telemetry as well the location of the ship's reserve fuel! Your map has been updated.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-cell: The team returns home rather sooner than expected. Turns out just as they were making entry to the frigate, the ship's emergency fuel cell just happened to drift by!
wiki.cited-missing.debris-ammo: A short time later the team returns with a stash of ammunition and scrap — but all the fuel on board is long gone.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-ransom: The away team reports in, but then screams are heard and the comm goes dead! When it comes back online a Rockman can be heard — he's the lone survivor from the frigate's crew, and completely mad. He demands you pay a scrap ransom in return for your crew-member's life!
wiki.cited-missing.debris-paid: Despite his fragile condition, the Rockman is good to his word and returns your crew-member, who is suitably grateful. Sadly, gratitude doesn't power the FTL drive. You lose {{cost}} scrap.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-refused: It's a tough call, but it's for the Federation and the liberty of all. You set off before you can change your mind.
wiki.cited-missing.debris-scan: The ship appears to be entirely lifeless. Your crew is able to find some usable fuel cells after a brief search.
wiki.cited-missing.pity-fuel: They take pity on you and offer you some fuel free of charge.
wiki.cited-missing.discussion-ends: They end the discussion and prepare to jump away.
wiki.cited-missing.captain-leaves: Their captain disconnects from the channel and without another word their ship prepares to jump away.
wiki.cited-missing.dock-fuel: They pull close to your ship and unload some fuel saying, "Try not to run out of fuel again. These are dangerous times; who knows who could have showed up."
wiki.cited-missing.dock-and-trade: They approach and dock with your ship. On board they present an offer.
wiki.cited-missing.dock-hostile: As they approach, you detect their weapons powering up. It seems their intentions are hostile!
wiki.cited-missing.dock-boarded: As their ship pulls up next to yours, their captain continues, "Yes, we'll certainly help... Help to relieve you of that nice ship!" Sensors detect a hidden teleporter has been activated. We've been boarded!
wiki.cited-missing.distance-fuel: "I assure you that we mean no harm. See, we'll send some fuel over on a transport." A small ship docks and offloads some fuel just as they said. They leave, saying, "Stay cautious, friend."
wiki.cited-missing.distance-fight: They reply, "Keep our distance? Let's see if you can stop us!" They power up their weapons and advance.
wiki.cited-missing.distance-leave: "No one trusts anyone these days..." The ship jumps away.
wiki.cited-missing.scan-safe: Sensors indicate their ship is without military-grade weaponry, even small arms. You allow them to dock and they give you some fuel saying, "I remember a time when we didn't have to be so paranoid about each others' intentions... Stay safe."
wiki.cited-missing.scan-trap: Sensors are picking up armed crew and considerably more weaponry than is legal for a craft of this size. This is surely a trap.
wiki.cited-missing.power-weapons: Power up weapons and prepare for a fight.
wiki.cited-missing.cloak-away: Cloak and get out of scanning range before they have a chance to lock on.
wiki.cited-missing.cloak-clear: Your highly advanced cloaking system allows you to get out of range easily since they were still out of firing range. Eventually the ship jumps away.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-low-fuel: You receive a small share of their remaining fuel.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-engi: Your Engi analyzes scans of the extensive damage to their hull, calculating potential repair costs. The refugees grumble and protest, but in the end, they admit that their need for repairs is greater than their fuel surplus and offer a better trade.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-cold: The refugee ship cuts communications and jumps from the system without another word, the galactic equivalent of giving you the cold shoulder.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-desperate: The refugees become desperate at your refusal — apparently, their hull is even more damaged than it first appears. Almost begging, they offer a better trade than before.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-surrender: Panicked, the refugees immediately surrender as your weapons power up. They pass along their fuel and what few other supplies they have left in exchange for their lives.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-missile-trade: The refugee ship makes the exchange, and wishes you well on your mission. You lose 1 missile and receive {{fuel}} fuel.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-missile-trap: Having traded supplies, the ship suddenly powers up and attacks — it's a pirate ship! You lose 1 missile and receive {{fuel}} fuel.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-prey: Taking your reluctance as weakness, the refugee ship suddenly bristles with weapons — it's a pirate ship, and it believes it's found easy prey!
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-small-fuel: Sensing your reluctance, the refugee ship nevertheless parts with a small amount of fuel. It warns you to leave the sector as quickly as possible before it is overtaken by Rebels, then it jumps and vanishes to parts unknown.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-apologizes: The refugee ship apologizes, but they need their fuel. They wish you well, and then vanish from the system.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-ten: You pull up to the automatic station and after a short time they repair 10 hull damage. You begin to offer your thanks but discover that you can't detach from the station.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-one: You dock with the station hoping for a quick turnaround, but the automatic machines take their sweet time. When the process finally finishes, you notice only one damage has been repaired.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-thanks: The refugees thank you for the parts, and gladly pass along the much-needed fuel. They wish you well on your mission, and declare their support for the Federation.
wiki.cited-missing.refugee-better-done: You receive 6 fuel and lose 10 scrap.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-engines-destro: The Slug ship breaks apart and your engines return to normal. You collect what you can.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-engines-crew: With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your engines return to normal. You strip the ship.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-weapons-destro: The Slug ship breaks apart and your weapon system returns to normal. You collect what you can.
wiki.cited-missing.repair-weapons-crew: With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your weapon system returns to normal. You strip the ship.
